2410.06940.title_zh: REPA：通过表征对齐简化扩散 Transformer 训练

background.zh: 扩散模型能自行学习视觉表征，但其判别语义质量通常落后于专门训练的自监督编码器。
background.en: Diffusion models learn internal visual representations, but their semantic quality often lags behind features learned by dedicated self-supervised encoders.

challenge.zh: 仅靠去噪目标学习高质量表征可能拖慢大模型训练，需要在不替换生成主干的情况下借助外部知识。
challenge.en: Learning strong representations solely through denoising can slow training, motivating external guidance that does not replace the generative model's backbone.

method.zh: 将去噪网络的带噪隐藏状态投影到外部视觉编码器的干净图像表征，以简单正则项完成对齐。
method.en: REPA aligns projected noisy hidden states from the denoiser with clean-image features from a pretrained visual encoder through an auxiliary regularizer.

result.zh: 作者报告 DiT 和 SiT 训练效率及质量提升，特定 SiT 对照中以不到四十万步匹配七百万步效果。
result.en: The authors improve DiT and SiT efficiency and quality, with one SiT comparison matching seven-million-step performance in fewer than four hundred thousand steps.

2410.10629.title_zh: SANA：基于线性扩散 Transformer 的高效高分辨率生成

background.zh: 高分辨率文生图受到潜变量长度与注意力成本限制，消费级设备难以运行大型密集生成模型。
background.en: High resolution text-to-image generation faces long latent sequences and costly attention, limiting deployment of large dense generators on consumer devices.

challenge.zh: 降低 token 数、文本编码和采样开销需要协同设计，才能在小模型中保持提示对齐与图像细节。
challenge.en: Token count, text encoding, and sampling cost must be reduced together to preserve prompt alignment and visual detail in a smaller model.

method.zh: 结合深压缩自编码器、线性 DiT、小型解码式语言编码器，以及高效描述选择和 Flow-DPM-Solver。
method.en: SANA combines a deeply compressive autoencoder, linear-attention DiT, compact decoder-only text encoder, efficient caption selection, and Flow-DPM-Solver sampling.

result.zh: 作者报告 0.6B 模型具有竞争力的生成质量，并在所测 16GB 笔记本 GPU 上亚秒生成 1024 图像。
result.en: The authors report competitive quality from a 0.6B model and subsecond 1024-image generation on the evaluated laptop GPU with 16GB memory.

2501.18427.title_zh: SANA 1.5：高效扩展训练与推理计算预算

background.zh: 文生图模型需要适配不同训练和部署预算，模型容量与测试时计算都可影响最终生成质量。
background.en: Text-to-image models must adapt to different training and deployment budgets, with both model capacity and test-time computation affecting final quality.

challenge.zh: 直接扩大模型训练成本高，压缩后又可能损失质量，需要统一处理增长、裁剪和重复采样。
challenge.en: Direct scaling is costly and compression can reduce quality, requiring coordinated approaches to model growth, pruning, and repeated generation at inference.

method.zh: 采用深度增长与八位优化器训练，通过块重要性裁剪压缩，并用重复采样和评审扩大推理计算。
method.en: SANA 1.5 combines depth growth and an eight-bit optimizer, block-importance pruning, and repeated sampling evaluated by a judge at inference.

result.zh: 作者报告 GenEval 0.81，加入 VILA-Judge 推理扩展后达 0.96，后者包含额外采样与评审成本。

2312.06662.title_zh: W.A.L.T.：使用扩散模型生成逼真视频

background.zh: 图像与视频生成可共享视觉知识，但联合建模必须处理额外时间维度和较长时空序列。
background.en: Image and video generation can share visual knowledge, but joint modeling must handle temporal structure and much longer spatiotemporal sequences.

challenge.zh: 模型需要在统一潜空间保持重建质量，同时限制 Transformer 的显存和训练成本以支持视频生成。
challenge.en: The model needs a shared latent space with strong reconstruction while controlling transformer memory and training cost for video generation.

method.zh: 采用因果编码器联合压缩图像视频，配合空间与时空窗口注意力，并以级联模型实现文生视频。
method.en: W.A.L.T. combines a causal image-video encoder with spatial and spatiotemporal window attention, and uses a model cascade for text-to-video generation.

result.zh: 作者在图像和视频基准上报告较强结果，并展示 512×896、每秒八帧的文本条件视频输出。
result.en: The authors report strong image and video benchmark results and demonstrate text-conditioned video output at 512×896 resolution and eight frames per second.

background.en: Video latents contain many spatiotemporal tokens, requiring transformers to model both motion across frames and visual content within each frame.

challenge.en: Spatial-temporal decomposition, positional encoding, and conditioning choices affect performance, requiring controlled comparisons rather than directly copying image-generation architectures to video.

method.en: Latte evaluates four spatial-temporal transformer variants and studies clip embeddings, timestep and class conditioning, temporal positions, and learning strategies.

2408.06072.title_zh: CogVideoX：采用专家 Transformer 的文生视频模型

background.zh: 文生视频需要同时延长时长、增强运动并忠实表达提示语义，早期系统常缺乏连贯叙事。
background.en: Text-to-video models must extend duration, capture substantial motion, and follow prompts, while earlier systems often struggle with coherent visual narratives.

challenge.zh: 更长高分辨率序列增加计算与训练难度，文本和视频表征也需要更充分地融合。
challenge.en: Longer high resolution sequences increase training and computation demands, while text and video representations need stronger interactions for semantic alignment.

method.zh: 结合时空三维 VAE、专家自适应归一化 Transformer、渐进训练、多分辨率帧打包和视频描述数据流程。
method.en: CogVideoX combines a spatiotemporal VAE, expert adaptive-normalization transformer, progressive training, multiresolution frame packing, and a dedicated video-captioning pipeline.

2412.03603.title_zh: HunyuanVideo：大规模视频生成模型的系统框架

background.en: Leading video models have often remained closed, leaving a substantial gap between publicly available research systems and commercial generation capabilities.

challenge.zh: 缩小差距需要数据、架构、规模训练和推理基础设施协同优化，不能只扩大单个模型的参数量。
challenge.en: Closing the gap requires coordinated data, architecture, scaling, and infrastructure improvements rather than increasing model parameter count alone.

method.zh: 整合数据筛选、架构设计、渐进扩展与训练推理基础设施，训练超过 13B 参数的视频基础模型。
method.en: HunyuanVideo integrates data curation, architectural design, progressive scaling, and training-inference infrastructure in a video model exceeding thirteen billion parameters.

background.zh: 视频 VAE 与去噪主干通常独立设计，较长潜序列使时空全注意力推理开销较高。
background.en: Video VAEs and denoising backbones are commonly designed independently, while long latent sequences make full spatiotemporal attention expensive at inference.

challenge.zh: 提高压缩率会损失精细内容，需要重新分配解码与去噪职责，避免额外超分辨率模块的运行成本。
challenge.en: Higher compression can lose fine detail, requiring a redistribution of decoding and denoising responsibilities without introducing a separate super-resolution runtime.

method.zh: 以高压缩视频 VAE 缩短潜序列，将最后去噪步骤交给像素解码器，联合优化表示与生成过程。
method.en: LTX-Video compresses latent sequences aggressively and assigns the final denoising step to the pixel decoder, jointly designing representation and generation stages.

challenge.zh: 视频长度带来巨大时空计算负担，生成伪影和偏好对齐也不能仅靠预训练规模解决。

2402.19481.title_zh: DistriFusion：高分辨率扩散模型的分布式并行推理

background.zh: 高分辨率扩散图像生成计算量大，多 GPU 图块并行是降低交互延迟的一种直接路线。
background.en: High resolution diffusion image generation is expensive, making multi-GPU patch parallelism an attractive route to lower interactive generation latency.

challenge.zh: 独立处理图块会破坏跨区域上下文，而同步交换完整特征又可能产生较高通信开销。
challenge.en: Processing patches independently loses global context, but synchronously exchanging the required feature maps can introduce large communication overhead on every step.

method.zh: 用前一步特征提供当前图块上下文，形成位移图块并行，使异步通信可与当前计算流水重叠。
method.en: DistriFusion supplies patch context from previous-step feature maps, enabling displaced patch parallelism with asynchronous communication overlapped by current computation.

result.zh: 作者报告八张 A100 上最高 6.1 倍加速且测试质量未下降，但方法本身采用旧特征近似。
result.en: The authors report up to 6.1-fold speedup on eight A100s with no measured quality loss, although execution uses previous-step feature approximations.

2405.14430.title_zh: PipeFusion：用于 DiT 推理的图块级流水并行

background.zh: 高分辨率 DiT 推理需要同时分担模型权重和图像序列，现有并行方式可能受通信量限制。
background.en: High resolution DiT inference needs to distribute both model weights and image sequences, while conventional parallel strategies can become communication-bound.

challenge.zh: 流水层间依赖与图块上下文交换难以同时高效处理，大模型还需要避免在各设备复制全部权重。
challenge.en: Layer dependencies and cross-patch context are difficult to pipeline efficiently, while large models also benefit from distributing rather than replicating all weights.

method.zh: 同时按图块和网络层分割工作，用前一步旧特征补足上下文，构建低通信量图块级流水。
method.en: PipeFusion partitions image patches and model layers, using one-step-stale context features to construct a pipeline with reduced communication requirements.

result.zh: 作者在八张 PCIe L40 上报告较强性能和显存效率，结果采用旧特征近似而非逐步数值等价执行。
result.en: The authors report strong performance and memory efficiency on eight PCIe L40s, using stale-feature approximation rather than stepwise numerically equivalent execution.

background.en: Long-sequence DiT generation needs distributed inference, but one parallel strategy cannot efficiently cover every model scale and GPU interconnect configuration.

challenge.zh: 节点内外带宽、模型大小和序列长度相互影响，需要灵活组合并行方法才能获得稳定扩展能力。
challenge.en: Bandwidth, model size, and sequence length interact, requiring flexible combinations of parallel techniques to achieve useful scaling across hardware configurations.

method.zh: 组合序列并行、PipeFusion 图块流水和 CFG 并行，作为可灵活配置的混合分布式推理引擎。
method.en: xDiT combines sequence parallelism, PipeFusion patch pipelining, and classifier-free-guidance parallelism in a configurable distributed inference engine for diffusion transformers.

result.zh: 作者在 NVLink 与以太网连接的 GPU 系统上展示多模型扩展；使用 PipeFusion 时继承其旧特征近似。
result.en: The authors demonstrate scaling across multiple models on NVLink and Ethernet GPU systems; configurations using PipeFusion inherit its stale-feature approximation.

2411.19108.title_zh: TeaCache：利用时间步嵌入指导视频扩散缓存

background.zh: 视频扩散缓存可减少重复计算，但均匀选择复用步数忽略了不同时间步输出变化的不均匀性。
background.en: Caching can reduce repeated video diffusion computation, but uniformly selected reuse steps ignore how output changes vary throughout the denoising trajectory.

challenge.zh: 直接测量完整输出差异需要先运行模型，无法节省计算，因此需要便宜且可靠的变化代理。
challenge.en: Directly measuring output differences requires evaluating the denoiser first, so an inexpensive proxy is needed to decide when computation can be skipped.

method.zh: 用时间步嵌入调制带噪输入，并重缩放其差异以估计输出变化，动态决定是否复用缓存结果。
method.en: TeaCache modulates noisy inputs with timestep embeddings and rescales their differences to estimate output variation and guide dynamic approximate cache reuse.

result.zh: 作者在 Open-Sora-Plan 上报告最高 4.41 倍加速，所测 VBench 变化很小，但不承诺数值等价。
result.en: The authors report up to 4.41-fold acceleration on Open-Sora-Plan with a small measured VBench change, without claiming numerically identical outputs.

2602.02204.title_zh: vLLM-Omni：面向任意模态模型的完全解耦服务

background.zh: 任意模态模型通常串联语言模型、扩散主干和专用模块，单范式推理引擎难以优化整个流程。
background.en: Any-to-any models combine language models, diffusion backbones, and specialized components, making entire pipelines difficult to optimize with a single-paradigm serving engine.

challenge.zh: 各阶段负载和执行机制不同，手工处理阶段间数据交互容易降低吞吐并浪费 GPU 资源。
challenge.en: Stages have different workloads and execution mechanisms, while manually coordinating their data exchanges can reduce throughput and waste GPU resources.

method.zh: 将模型表示为阶段图，各阶段独立批处理和分配 GPU，再通过统一连接器路由中间数据。
method.en: vLLM-Omni represents models as stage graphs, with independent batching and GPU allocation for each stage connected through standardized data-routing interfaces.

result.zh: 作者在所测任意模态流水上报告作业完成时间最高降低 91.4%，具体收益取决于模型与基线配置。
result.en: For evaluated multimodal pipelines, the authors report job completion time reductions up to 91.4%, with gains depending on the model and baseline configuration.

background.en: Robot demonstrations can contain multiple valid actions, requiring policies that model high dimensional continuous control and condition action sequences on visual observations.

challenge.zh: 简单动作回归难以表达多模态分布，真实控制还要求稳定训练、时序一致性和滚动执行。
challenge.en: Simple action regression struggles with multimodal distributions, while practical control also requires stable learning, temporal coherence, and receding-horizon execution.

method.en: Diffusion Policy models actions through conditional denoising and integrates visual conditioning, receding-horizon control, and a time-series diffusion transformer for action generation.

challenge.zh: 跨机器人数据需要足够容量的动作建模，同时还要把预训练收益迁移到新环境和真实机械臂。
challenge.en: Diverse robot datasets require expressive action modeling that can transfer pretraining gains to new environments and physical robot manipulation tasks.

2506.10100.title_zh: EfficientVLA：无需训练的 VLA 加速与压缩

2509.25681.title_zh: dVLA：具有多模态思维链的扩散视觉语言动作模型

background.zh: 机器人任务需要视觉感知、语言推理和动作控制协作，统一扩散模型可提供跨模态联合建模途径。
background.en: Robot tasks require visual perception, language reasoning, and action control to cooperate, motivating joint modeling through a unified diffusion framework.

challenge.zh: 复杂指令和新物体需要跨模态推理，同时扩散推理延迟必须降低才能适合真实机器人部署。
challenge.en: Novel instructions and objects demand cross-modal reasoning, while diffusion inference latency must be reduced for practical deployment on real robots.

method.zh: 以多模态思维链和单一扩散目标联合训练感知语言动作，并用前缀注意力掩码与 KV 缓存加速。
method.en: dVLA jointly trains perception, language, and actions with multimodal chain-of-thought under one diffusion objective, using prefix masking and KV caching for inference.

result.zh: 作者报告 LIBERO 平均成功率 96.4%，并在 Franka 上展示包含多步规划和箱内抓取的真实任务。
result.en: The authors report 96.4% average LIBERO success and demonstrate varied real Franka tasks, including bin picking that requires multistep planning.

2509.25681.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。 存档摘要的加速倍率缺失，卡片未填入推测数字。

2512.22615.title_zh: Dream-VL 与 Dream-VLA：基于扩散语言主干的开放多模态模型

background.zh: 自回归视觉语言模型顺序生成输出，可能限制视觉规划与需要并行动作块的机器人控制效率。
background.en: Autoregressive vision-language models generate outputs sequentially, potentially limiting visual planning and robot control that benefits from parallel action-chunk generation.

challenge.zh: 需要验证扩散语言主干的双向性是否能同时支持理解与动作，并保留开放数据训练的可比能力。
challenge.en: The study tests whether a bidirectional diffusion-language backbone can support both understanding and actions while remaining competitive under open-data training.

method.zh: 先构建扩散视觉语言模型 Dream-VL，再在开放机器人数据上继续预训练得到支持动作块生成的 Dream-VLA。
method.en: The authors build Dream-VL on a diffusion language model and continue pretraining on open robot data to obtain action-generating Dream-VLA.

result.zh: 作者报告较快下游微调收敛及 LIBERO 平均 97.2% 成功率，并在 SimplerEnv 等任务中验证能力。
result.en: The authors report faster downstream fine-tuning convergence and 97.2% average LIBERO success, with additional evaluations on SimplerEnv and other tasks.

2512.22615.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2602.18397.title_zh: VLA-Perf：解析视觉语言动作模型的推理性能

background.zh: 真实机器人对响应时间要求严格，但 VLA 架构、上下文与部署系统的组合空间难以逐个实测。
background.en: Real robots have strict response-time requirements, but the space of VLA architectures, contexts, and deployment systems is too broad to characterize manually.

challenge.zh: 模型规模、异步执行、双系统流水及网络传输共同决定延迟，需要统一分析而非孤立比较单一算子。
challenge.en: Model scale, asynchronous execution, dual-system pipelines, and network transfers jointly determine latency, requiring analysis beyond isolated operator measurements or model comparisons.

method.zh: 构建解析性能模型，系统比较不同 VLA 架构与推理系统，并评估端侧、边缘和云部署条件。
method.en: VLA-Perf builds an analytical performance model to compare VLA architectures and inference systems across on-device, edge, and cloud deployment scenarios.

result.zh: 论文汇总十五项设计观察，说明硬件与网络如何共同影响实时能力，目标是指导模型和系统设计。
result.en: The study distills fifteen design observations showing how hardware and networks jointly determine real-time feasibility, providing guidance for future models and serving systems.

2602.18397.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2602.20309.title_zh: QuantVLA：针对 VLA 的尺度校准训练后量化

background.zh: VLA 模型扩大主干和任务时域后，计算与显存需求上升，低比特执行可降低实际部署压力。
background.en: As VLA backbones and task horizons grow, computation and memory demand increase, making low-bit execution attractive for practical robotic deployment.

challenge.zh: 量化误差可能扰乱注意力温度和残差能量，动作扩散头对这些尺度变化也需要针对性校准。
challenge.en: Quantization can disturb attention temperature and residual energy, requiring scale-aware calibration for both language backbones and diffusion action heads.

method.zh: 结合选择性量化布局、逐头注意力温度匹配及输出残差接口校准，使用少量无标签数据完成训练后量化。
method.en: QuantVLA combines selective quantization, per-head attention temperature matching, and output residual calibration using a small unlabeled buffer without additional training.

result.zh: 作者在 LIBERO 测试中报告量化组件约七成显存节省，并保持或超过对应全精度基线的任务成功率。
result.en: On LIBERO, the authors report roughly seventy percent memory savings for quantized components while matching or exceeding corresponding full-precision task success rates.

2602.20309.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2605.13778.title_zh: Realtime-VLA FLASH：用于扩散 VLA 的投机推理框架

background.zh: 扩散 VLA 的完整推理延迟妨碍高频重新规划，动态机器人任务需要更短的控制反馈间隔。
background.en: Full diffusion-VLA inference limits frequent replanning, while dynamic manipulation tasks require shorter delays between observations and updated control actions.

challenge.zh: 轻量模型可快速产生候选动作，但必须检验其可靠性，并在任务阶段变化时及时回退完整流程。
challenge.en: A lightweight model can propose actions quickly, but reliability requires verification and timely fallback when the current task phase demands full inference.

method.zh: 使用草稿模型生成动作，由主模型动作专家并行验证，并以阶段感知回退机制决定是否完整重算。
method.en: FLASH generates draft actions, verifies them in parallel through the main model's action expert, and uses phase-aware fallback to full inference.

result.zh: 作者在 LIBERO 上报告任务平均延迟降至 19.1 毫秒并大致保留成功率，同时验证传送带分拣场景。
result.en: On LIBERO, the authors report average task inference latency of 19.1 milliseconds with largely preserved success, and demonstrate conveyor-belt sorting.

2605.13778.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2606.08094.title_zh: vla.cpp：统一的视觉语言动作模型推理运行时

background.zh: 机器人端硬件往往无法满足常见 Python 与 PyTorch VLA 部署栈的工作站级 GPU 假设。
background.en: Robot hardware often cannot meet the workstation-class GPU assumptions of common Python and PyTorch deployment stacks for vision-language-action policies.

challenge.zh: 统一运行时需要支持缓存视觉语言前缀与多步动作专家，并在不同模型架构和硬件档次间移植。
challenge.en: A portable runtime must support cached visual-language prefixes and iterative action experts across different model architectures and hardware performance tiers.

method.zh: 基于 llama.cpp 构建 C++ VLA 运行时，统一模型包与请求接口，并依据 roofline 分析优化整数 GEMM。
method.en: vla.cpp builds on llama.cpp with unified model bundles and request protocols, and applies roofline-guided integer GEMM optimization to VLA inference.

result.zh: 作者展示多架构跨硬件运行及接近参考策略的成功率；特定 BitVLA 算子优化取得 4.5 倍每步加速。
result.en: The authors demonstrate cross-hardware execution and success close to reference policies, with a specific BitVLA optimization yielding 4.5-fold per-step acceleration.

2606.08094.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2607.01586.title_zh: VLAFlow：通过共同训练与未来潜变量对齐比较 VLA 学习

background.zh: 不同 VLA 的架构、数据和动作空间经常同时变化，使机器人预训练目标的实际作用难以比较。
background.en: VLA models often differ simultaneously in architecture, data, and action space, making the effect of robot pretraining objectives difficult to isolate.

challenge.zh: 需要固定训练与评估条件，区分动作监督、语言共同训练和未来状态预测各自对泛化的贡献。
challenge.en: Controlled training and evaluation are needed to separate the generalization contributions of action supervision, language co-training, and future-state representation learning.

method.zh: 在统一 π0 风格架构和 OXEMix 数据下，对照动作学习、语言监督、未来潜变量对齐及其组合。
method.en: VLAFlow compares action-only training, language co-training, future latent alignment, and their combination under one π0-style architecture and shared OXEMix data.

result.zh: 作者发现语言与未来潜变量监督具有互补作用，组合方法在多个机器人基准上表现出最稳定的总体迁移。
result.en: The authors find complementary benefits from language and future-latent supervision, with their combination showing the most stable overall transfer across evaluated benchmarks.

2607.01586.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2607.06370.title_zh: ActionCache：通过动作缓存与精化加速 VLA

background.zh: 流匹配 VLA 能产生平滑连续动作，但动作头的反复去噪仍可能成为实时控制的主要瓶颈。
background.en: Flow-matching VLAs generate smooth continuous actions, but repeated denoising in the action head can dominate latency in real-time control systems.

challenge.zh: 相似场景中的历史动作可提供起点，但需要紧凑检索条件并允许跨任务复用而保持操作成功率。
challenge.en: Past actions can provide useful starting points in similar contexts, requiring compact retrieval keys and reliable reuse across episodes or tasks.

method.zh: 用多模态键缓存历史中间动作，检索相近上下文后以缓存动作热启动，再用较少计算继续精化。
method.en: ActionCache stores intermediate actions with multimodal keys, retrieves matching contexts, and warm-starts action generation before refining the reused candidates.

result.zh: 作者在仿真和真实环境中报告低延迟下保持较高成功率，特定模型配置取得最高十余至三十余倍加速。
result.en: Simulation and real-world experiments retain high success at low latency, with peak speedups above tenfold or thirtyfold for particular evaluated model configurations.

2607.06370.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2310.07896.title_zh: NoMaD：统一目标导航与探索的目标掩码扩散策略

background.zh: 陌生环境中的机器人既要寻找尚未定位的目标，也要在目标已知后可靠导航到指定位置。
background.en: Robots in unfamiliar environments need both exploration to locate an unknown goal and reliable navigation once that goal has been identified.

challenge.zh: 分别训练探索与导航策略增加系统复杂度，单一策略又必须表达目标条件与无目标行为的多样性。
challenge.en: Separate exploration and navigation policies increase complexity, while a unified policy must express both goal-conditioned actions and diverse goal-agnostic exploration behavior.

method.zh: 使用目标掩码统一条件任务，以多机器人数据训练 Transformer 策略和扩散动作解码器。
method.en: NoMaD uses goal masking to unify conditioning regimes and trains a transformer policy with a diffusion action decoder on data from multiple robots.

result.zh: 真实移动机器人实验报告在未见环境中更好的导航表现与更低碰撞率，同时使用较小模型。
result.en: Real mobile-robot experiments report better navigation and lower collision rates in unseen environments while using smaller models than the compared strong approaches.

2310.07896.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。 正式会议为 ICRA 2024；2023年CoRL/NeurIPS仅workshop，修正旧CSV误标。

2402.10885.title_zh: 3D Diffuser Actor：采用三维场景表征的策略扩散

background.zh: 扩散策略善于建模多样动作，三维场景表征则能改善视角变化下的机器人策略泛化。
background.en: Diffusion policies represent diverse actions, while three-dimensional scene representations improve policy generalization when observations come from different camera viewpoints.

challenge.zh: 需要将三维视觉、语言与本体状态有效融合，以生成精确动作轨迹并利用有限真实示范学习。
challenge.en: The policy must fuse three-dimensional vision, language, and proprioception to generate precise trajectories and learn effectively from limited real demonstrations.

method.zh: 构建三维去噪 Transformer，融合场景特征与指令状态，预测带噪三维机器人位姿轨迹中的噪声。
method.en: A three-dimensional denoising transformer combines scene features, instructions, and proprioception to predict noise in corrupted robot pose trajectories.

result.zh: 作者在 RLBench 和 CALVIN 上报告优于比较策略，并展示从少量示范学习真实机器人操作。
result.en: The authors report improvements over compared policies on RLBench and CALVIN and demonstrate learning physical robot manipulation from a small set of demonstrations.

2402.10885.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。 作者项目明确 CoRL 2024，PMLR 卷270于2025出版；修正旧CSV的CVPR2024误标。

background.zh: 互联网视频包含丰富的环境变化，可为无需手工搭建的交互世界模型提供训练数据。
background.en: Internet videos contain diverse environmental transitions that could support interactive world models without manually constructed environments or action annotations.

challenge.zh: 无标签视频缺少动作信息，模型仍需学到可由用户逐帧控制且跨场景一致的行为接口。
challenge.en: Unlabeled videos provide no explicit actions, yet an interactive model must learn controls that remain meaningful across generated environments.

method.zh: 将时空视频分词、自回归动力学与潜动作模型结合，在无动作标签的视频上共同学习。
method.en: Genie combines a spatiotemporal video tokenizer, an autoregressive dynamics model, and a latent action model trained without ground-truth action labels.

result.zh: 模型展示从图像等提示生成可交互世界，学得的潜动作还可用于模仿未见视频中的行为。
result.en: The model demonstrates controllable environments from visual prompts, while its learned latent actions support imitation of behaviors in previously unseen videos.

2403.03954.title_zh: 三维扩散策略：通过简单三维表示实现泛化控制

background.zh: 视觉模仿学习能够教授机器人技能，但复杂操作通常需要大量演示才能获得可靠泛化。
background.en: Visual imitation learning can teach robotic skills, but complex manipulation often requires substantial demonstrations to achieve reliable generalization.

challenge.zh: 二维视觉容易受外观和视角变化影响，需要紧凑且有效的三维条件来提升动作生成。
challenge.en: Appearance and viewpoint changes challenge visual policies, motivating compact three-dimensional conditioning that preserves geometry without making policy learning prohibitively expensive.

method.zh: 用高效点编码器从稀疏点云提取三维表示，并以该表示条件化动作扩散策略。
method.en: DP3 extracts compact geometric features from sparse point clouds using an efficient point encoder and conditions an action diffusion policy on them.

result.zh: 在仿真与四项真机任务中优于比较基线，并展示空间、视角、外观和实例变化下的泛化。
result.en: Experiments across simulated tasks and four real-robot tasks report improved control and generalization across spatial arrangements, viewpoints, appearances, and object instances.

background.zh: 跨机器人数据预训练可减少每个新任务从零学习策略的成本，并复用已有操作知识。
background.en: Pretraining policies on diverse robot datasets can reduce the cost of learning each new task and reuse knowledge across platforms.

challenge.zh: 通用策略必须兼容不同传感器、动作空间和任务条件，还需支持成本可控的下游微调。
challenge.en: A broadly useful policy must accommodate heterogeneous sensors, action spaces, and task conditions while remaining practical to fine-tune on new robots.

method.zh: 在大规模跨本体轨迹上训练支持语言和目标图像条件的Transformer策略，并开放微调流程。
method.en: Octo trains a Transformer policy on large-scale cross-embodiment trajectories, supports language or goal-image conditioning, and provides an accessible adaptation pipeline.

result.zh: 九种机器人平台的实验表明，预训练策略可高效适配新的观测空间和动作空间。
result.en: Experiments on nine robot platforms show that the pretrained policy can be efficiently adapted to new observation spaces and action configurations.

2405.12399.title_zh: DIAMOND：扩散世界模型中的视觉细节对Atari决策很重要

background.zh: 在学习出的世界模型内训练智能体，有望减少真实交互数据需求并支持安全的策略学习。
background.en: Training agents inside learned world models offers a route to sample-efficient reinforcement learning with reduced dependence on direct environmental interaction.

challenge.zh: 离散潜变量压缩可能丢掉决定奖励与行为的视觉细节，损害模拟环境中的策略学习。
challenge.en: Compact discrete representations can discard visual details that matter for rewards and decisions, undermining policy learning inside imagined environments.

method.zh: 构建以扩散模型预测环境画面的世界模型，并在其中训练强化学习智能体和分析设计选择。
method.en: DIAMOND models environment observations with diffusion and trains reinforcement learning agents within that model while analyzing the required architectural and sampling choices.

result.zh: 在Atari 100k中取得较强的人类归一化分数，并展示游戏视频训练得到的交互式神经引擎。
result.en: The approach achieves strong human-normalized performance on Atari 100k and demonstrates an interactive neural game engine trained from recorded gameplay.

2406.09455.title_zh: Pandora：以自然语言动作为条件的视频世界模型

background.zh: 世界模型需要根据用户行动预测环境变化，才能支持交互内容生成和长时域推理。
background.en: World models must predict environmental changes in response to actions to support interactive content creation and grounded long-horizon reasoning.

challenge.zh: 语言模型缺乏视觉状态模拟，而普通视频生成器又难以接受自由文本动作进行持续控制。
challenge.en: Language models lack direct visual simulation, while conventional video generators provide limited support for continuing interaction through free-form textual actions.

method.zh: 结合预训练语言与视频模型，采用混合自回归扩散结构及轻量指令微调实现文本动作控制。
method.en: Pandora combines pretrained language and video models through a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion design, using lightweight instruction tuning to support textual action control.

result.zh: 展示多种室内外和人机场景的视频交互结果，证明复用预训练模型构建通用接口的可行性。
result.en: Demonstrations span diverse indoor, outdoor, human, and robotic scenarios, illustrating the feasibility of building interactive interfaces by adapting pretrained models.

2408.11039.title_zh: Transfusion：在同一多模态模型中预测文本并扩散图像

background.zh: 文本与图像分别适合离散自回归和连续扩散目标，统一模型需要兼顾两种数据形态。
background.en: Text and images favor different modeling objectives, creating an opportunity to combine discrete autoregression and continuous diffusion within one multimodal model.

challenge.zh: 将图像离散化可能限制生成质量与扩展性，而完全分离的骨干又难以统一混合模态序列。
challenge.en: Discretizing images can limit generation quality and scaling, whereas separate backbones complicate the unified modeling of interleaved multimodal sequences.

method.zh: 用单个Transformer联合下一词元预测与图像扩散损失，并加入模态专属的编码和解码层。
method.en: Transfusion jointly trains next-token prediction and image diffusion losses in a shared Transformer, supplemented by modality-specific encoding and decoding layers.

result.zh: 规模化实验显示相较离散图像词元建模具有更好扩展性，同时保持有竞争力的图像和文本生成。
result.en: Scaling experiments show advantages over discrete image-token modeling while retaining competitive image and text generation within the same multimodal architecture.

2408.11039.review_note: Publication is confirmed by the official OpenReview paper header; the forum currently presents a browser-verification challenge, so the verified paper URL is used.

2408.12528.title_zh: Show-o：统一多模态理解与生成的单一Transformer

background.zh: 多模态理解和视觉生成常由独立模型承担，统一架构有望支持更灵活的混合模态任务。
background.en: Multimodal understanding and visual generation are often handled by separate models, motivating unified architectures capable of flexible mixed-modality tasks.

challenge.zh: 单纯自回归生成难以同时兼顾不同模态的生成机制和多样化输入输出形式。
challenge.en: A purely autoregressive formulation must reconcile distinct modality requirements and diverse input-output structures when supporting both understanding and generation tasks.

method.zh: 在同一个Transformer中统一自回归与离散扩散建模，按任务处理文本及混合视觉序列。
method.en: Show-o integrates autoregressive and discrete diffusion modeling in one Transformer, enabling flexible processing of textual, visual, and interleaved sequences.

result.zh: 在视觉问答、文生图、图像修补和混合生成中取得与专用比较模型相当或更好的结果。
result.en: Evaluations cover visual question answering, text-to-image generation, inpainting, and mixed generation, with results competitive with the compared specialized models.

2408.12528.review_note: Publication is confirmed by the official OpenReview paper header; the forum currently presents a browser-verification challenge, so the verified paper URL is used.

2408.14837.title_zh: GameNGen：扩散模型作为实时游戏引擎

background.zh: 神经生成模型有潜力直接模拟可交互游戏，但需要持续响应动作并维持长轨迹稳定。
background.en: Generative neural models could simulate interactive games directly, provided they respond to player actions and remain stable over long trajectories.

challenge.zh: 自回归生成会积累误差，复杂游戏中的细小视觉元素还必须在实时运行时保持可辨。
challenge.en: Autoregressive errors accumulate over time, while small visual elements in complex games must remain recognizable under real-time execution constraints.

method.zh: 先记录强化学习智能体的游戏过程，再训练动作条件扩散预测下一帧，并用条件增强稳定轨迹。
method.en: GameNGen learns from reinforcement-learning gameplay, trains action-conditioned diffusion for next-frame prediction, and uses conditioning augmentation to stabilize extended trajectories.

result.zh: 在DOOM上展示实时且持续数分钟的交互模拟，论文报告单个TPU上达到每秒20帧。
result.en: The system demonstrates sustained interactive DOOM simulation, with the paper reporting twenty frames per second on a single TPU.

2408.14837.review_note: Publication is confirmed by the official OpenReview paper header; the forum currently presents a browser-verification challenge, so the verified paper URL is used.

background.zh: 现有多模态系统常拆分文本与图像骨干，或为统一训练而把视觉内容离散化。
background.en: Many multimodal systems separate text and image backbones or discretize visual content to support a single autoregressive training framework.

challenge.zh: 需要在共享参数下兼容文本因果建模与图像扩散的双向上下文，同时保持两类生成能力。
challenge.en: Parameter sharing must accommodate causal text modeling and bidirectional visual diffusion without sacrificing the generation capabilities of either modality.

method.zh: 让自回归与扩散共享Transformer骨干，并通过相应的注意力掩码支持不同生成目标。
method.en: MonoFormer shares a Transformer backbone between autoregressive and diffusion modeling while using appropriate attention masks for their distinct generation objectives.

result.zh: 实验显示模型保持文本生成能力，同时达到与比较方法有竞争力的图像生成效果。
result.en: Experiments show that the shared architecture retains text generation capabilities while delivering image synthesis performance competitive with the compared methods.

2410.06158.title_zh: GR-2：利用互联网知识进行机器人操作的视频语言动作模型

background.zh: 互联网视频包含丰富动作与环境变化，预训练可为机器人策略提供超出专用示范的知识。
background.en: Internet videos contain rich motion and environmental information that can provide robot policies with knowledge beyond task-specific demonstrations.

challenge.zh: 视频知识需要迁移为可执行动作，并在新背景、物体和任务中保持多任务控制能力。
challenge.en: Knowledge learned from videos must transfer into executable actions while preserving control across unfamiliar backgrounds, objects, environments, and tasks.

method.zh: 先进行大规模互联网视频预训练，再用机器人轨迹联合微调视频生成与动作预测能力。
method.en: GR-2 first pretrains on large-scale internet videos, then jointly fine-tunes video generation and action prediction using robot trajectories.

result.zh: 论文在百余项任务和多种未见场景中报告较高成功率，并展示随模型规模增长的改善。
result.en: The paper reports strong success across more than one hundred tasks and unseen scenarios, alongside improvements as model scale increases.

2410.07864.title_zh: RDT-1B：面向双臂操作的扩散基础模型

background.zh: 双臂机器人需要协调多模态连续动作，但跨机器人数据稀缺且动作表示通常不兼容。
background.en: Bimanual manipulation requires coordinated multimodal actions, while limited data and incompatible action representations hinder the development of general robotic foundation models.

challenge.zh: 模型必须同时处理异构感知输入、复杂动作分布和不同本体之间的知识迁移。
challenge.en: A scalable policy must reconcile heterogeneous inputs, complex action distributions, and transferable knowledge across robots with different physical embodiments.

method.zh: 设计可扩展扩散Transformer和保留物理意义的统一动作空间，并用多机器人数据预训练后微调。
method.en: RDT combines a scalable diffusion Transformer with a physically interpretable unified action space, followed by multi-robot pretraining and bimanual fine-tuning.

result.zh: 真机实验展示对未见物体和场景的泛化，以及少量示范学习新技能和复杂双臂操作的能力。
result.en: Real-robot experiments demonstrate generalization to unseen objects and scenes, few-demonstration skill adaptation, and the execution of complex bimanual manipulation tasks.

2411.07975.title_zh: JanusFlow：统一理解与生成的自回归整流流模型

background.zh: 统一视觉语言模型希望兼具图像理解和生成能力，而两种任务对视觉表征的需求不同。
background.en: Unified vision-language models aim to support both image understanding and generation, although these tasks impose different requirements on visual representations.

challenge.zh: 如何在语言模型框架中引入连续流生成，并减少理解与生成表征之间的相互干扰。
challenge.en: The challenge is to integrate continuous flow generation into a language-model framework while reducing interference between understanding and generation representations.

method.zh: 结合自回归语言建模与整流流，解耦视觉编码器并在联合训练中对齐两种表征。
method.en: JanusFlow combines autoregressive language modeling with rectified flow, decouples visual encoders, and aligns understanding and generation representations during joint training.

result.zh: 在标准理解与生成基准中取得有竞争力的结果，并优于论文比较的既有统一模型。
result.en: Standard understanding and generation benchmarks show competitive performance, with improvements over the unified multimodal baselines evaluated in the paper.

2412.01169.title_zh: OmniFlow：多模态整流流的任意到任意生成

background.zh: 文本、图像和音频的任意条件生成需要共同建模多种模态及其相互关系。
background.en: Any-to-any generation across text, images, and audio requires joint modeling of multiple modalities and their conditional relationships within one framework.

challenge.zh: 传统文生图流模型难以直接扩展到多模态联合分布，也缺少灵活控制跨模态对齐的方式。
challenge.en: Conventional text-to-image flow models do not directly address multimodal joint distributions or flexible control over alignment among generated modalities.

method.zh: 扩展MMDiT与整流流框架，引入模态模块和引导机制，并通过独立预训练后联合微调实现融合。
method.en: OmniFlow extends MMDiT and rectified flows with modality-specific modules and guidance, combining separate pretraining with subsequent joint multimodal fine-tuning.

result.zh: 在文生图、文生音频等任务中优于比较的任意到任意模型，并分析各模态设计选择。
result.en: Evaluations report improvements over compared any-to-any models on image and audio generation tasks, together with analyses of modality-specific design choices.

2412.03568.title_zh: The Matrix：支持实时移动控制的无限时域世界生成

background.zh: 交互世界生成希望从静态视频合成扩展到可持续移动和探索的高保真环境。
background.en: Interactive world generation seeks to move beyond static video synthesis toward high-fidelity environments that support sustained navigation and exploration.

challenge.zh: 连续生成必须同时维持长期视觉一致性、实时响应和从游戏场景到现实画面的迁移。
challenge.en: Continuous generation must reconcile long-term visual consistency, responsive control, and transfer from game-derived environments to realistic visual settings.

method.zh: 结合有控制监督的游戏数据与无监督真实视频，构建支持移动控制的连续视频世界模拟器。
method.en: The Matrix combines controlled gameplay data with unsupervised real-world video to train a continuous visual world simulator responsive to movement inputs.

result.zh: 论文展示高分辨率实时探索和长时连续序列，并呈现跨场景的零样本生成示例。
result.en: The paper demonstrates high-resolution interactive exploration and extended continuous sequences, together with examples of zero-shot generation across different environments.

2501.03575.title_zh: Cosmos：面向物理人工智能的世界基础模型平台

background.zh: 物理智能开发需要可适配的数字环境模型，以支持机器人与其他实体系统的训练和验证。
background.en: Physical AI development requires adaptable digital world models to support the training and evaluation of robots and other embodied systems.

challenge.zh: 构建专用世界模型不仅需要生成骨干，还涉及视频整理、分词表示和下游适配流程。
challenge.en: Building specialized world models requires more than a generative backbone, including video curation, tokenization, and practical downstream adaptation workflows.

method.zh: 提供视频数据流水线、预训练世界模型、视频分词器和后训练示例组成的开放平台。
method.en: Cosmos provides an integrated platform comprising video curation pipelines, pretrained world models, video tokenizers, and examples of downstream post-training.

result.zh: 发布模型与工具链，展示面向物理智能任务定制世界模型的基础设施和适配路径。
result.en: The release supplies models and supporting tools, illustrating infrastructure and adaptation pathways for constructing world models tailored to physical AI applications.

2503.06134.title_zh: X2I：通过注意力蒸馏把多模态理解接入扩散Transformer

background.zh: 多模态语言模型擅长理解多种输入，而高质量文生图模型通常只接受有限的文本条件。
background.en: Multimodal language models understand diverse inputs, whereas high-quality text-to-image generators typically accept a much narrower range of conditioning modalities.

challenge.zh: 需要以较低训练成本把理解能力连接到已有DiT，同时尽量保留生成质量与适配能力。
challenge.en: The challenge is to connect multimodal understanding to an existing DiT at low training cost while preserving generation quality and adaptability.

method.zh: 以轻量AlignNet桥接多模态表示与DiT，并通过注意力蒸馏和LightControl支持生成及编辑。
method.en: X2I bridges multimodal representations and DiT using a lightweight AlignNet, attention distillation, and an additional LightControl mechanism for editing tasks.

result.zh: 论文展示文本、图像、视频和音频条件生成，在有限额外训练下保留接近教师的生成表现。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate generation conditioned on text, images, video, and audio while retaining performance close to the teacher with limited additional training.

2505.08712.title_zh: NavDP：利用特权信息学习可迁移的导航扩散策略

background.zh: 自主机器人需要在复杂环境中导航，但真实演示有限，传统模块化流程又需要大量调参。
background.en: Autonomous robots must navigate complex environments despite limited real demonstrations and the extensive tuning often required by modular navigation pipelines.

challenge.zh: 仅凭部署时局部RGB-D观察，需要学会生成可行轨迹并区分危险与安全行为。
challenge.en: Using only local RGB-D observations at deployment, a policy must generate feasible trajectories and distinguish safe behaviors from hazardous alternatives.

method.zh: 以统一Transformer学习扩散轨迹生成和评论家评估，并用仿真特权信息监督对比轨迹。
method.en: NavDP jointly learns diffusion-based trajectory generation and critic evaluation in a unified Transformer, guided by privileged information available during simulation training.

result.zh: 在仿真和真机导航中优于比较基线，并展示跨环境与机器人形态的零样本迁移。
result.en: Simulation and real-world evaluations report improvements over compared baselines and demonstrate zero-shot transfer across environments and different robot embodiments.

2505.08712.review_note: ICRA 2026 acceptance is confirmed by the author page; a dedicated official proceedings page was not verified, so the reading link remains arXiv.

2505.09568.title_zh: BLIP3-o：开放的统一多模态模型、训练方法与数据

background.zh: 图像理解与生成的统一模型快速发展，但共享架构、视觉表示和训练顺序仍缺少系统研究。
background.en: Unified image understanding and generation models are advancing rapidly, but their architectures, visual representations, and training schedules remain insufficiently understood.

challenge.zh: 模型需要在培养图像生成能力时保留理解能力，并选择适合统一学习的视觉生成空间。
challenge.en: A unified model must acquire image generation capabilities without losing understanding performance while selecting a suitable visual representation for generation.

method.zh: 用DiT生成语义丰富的CLIP特征，采用先理解后生成的顺序预训练，并构建高质量指令数据。
method.en: BLIP3-o generates semantic CLIP features with DiT, uses sequential understanding-then-generation pretraining, and introduces a curated image-generation instruction dataset.

result.zh: 在多项理解与生成基准中取得较强表现，并开放模型、代码、训练脚本及相关数据。
result.en: The model family achieves strong results across understanding and generation benchmarks and releases models, code, training scripts, and supporting datasets.

2505.14683.title_zh: BAGEL：统一多模态预训练中的涌现能力

background.zh: 统一模型有望在同一系统内完成多模态理解、生成和更复杂的视觉推理任务。
background.en: Unified multimodal models could combine understanding, generation, and more complex forms of visual reasoning within a single learned system.

challenge.zh: 需要在大规模交错文本、图像和视频数据上扩展训练，并保留不同任务间的协同能力。
challenge.en: Scaling on interleaved text, images, and videos requires a model and training recipe that preserve useful interactions among heterogeneous tasks.

method.zh: 以统一解码器模型在大规模交错多模态数据上预训练，并公开数据构建与训练细节。
method.en: BAGEL pretrains a unified decoder-only model on large-scale interleaved multimodal data and documents its data construction and training procedures.

result.zh: 基准评测和示例展示理解、生成及图像操控等能力，作者同时发布代码和模型检查点。
result.en: Benchmarks and demonstrations show understanding, generation, and image-manipulation capabilities, with code and model checkpoints released to support further research.

2506.00613.title_zh: WorldGym：将世界模型用作机器人策略评估环境

background.zh: 真实机器人策略测试昂贵，而手工仿真环境需要投入大量人力才能覆盖多样任务。
background.en: Evaluating robot policies in the real world is expensive, while manually constructed simulators require substantial effort to cover diverse tasks.

challenge.zh: 生成式环境必须保留策略间相对表现，而不能只产生视觉上合理却误导评价的未来。
challenge.en: A generative evaluation environment must preserve relative policy performance rather than merely produce visually plausible futures that distort assessment.

method.zh: 用动作条件自回归视频模型模拟策略rollout，并通过视觉语言模型评估奖励和任务完成情况。
method.en: WorldGym simulates policy rollouts with an action-conditioned autoregressive video model and uses a vision-language model to evaluate rewards and task outcomes.

result.zh: 在所测机器人策略中，模型内成功率与真机表现相关，并能维持不同版本和规模的相对排名。
result.en: For evaluated robot policies, simulated success correlates with real-world performance and preserves relative rankings across policy versions, sizes, and training checkpoints.

2506.05284.title_zh: 利用长期空间记忆实现一致的交互式视频生成

background.zh: 交互式视频世界需要在离开并重新访问场景后，仍保持空间布局和物体外观的一致性。
background.en: Interactive video worlds need persistent spatial structure so that revisiting previously observed locations preserves scene layout and appearance.

challenge.zh: 有限时间上下文会遗忘远处历史，单纯延长视频上下文又会增加计算与存储开销。
challenge.en: Finite temporal context forgets distant observations, while simply extending the video context increases computation and memory requirements during generation.

method.zh: 方法建立具有几何依据的长期三维记忆，并在生成过程中存储、检索与利用相关历史信息。
method.en: The method builds geometrically grounded long-term three-dimensional memory and retrieves relevant stored observations to condition subsequent video generation.

result.zh: 作者在构建的数据集上报告更好的视觉质量、空间一致性与长上下文能力，支持重复访问场景。
result.en: Experiments on the curated dataset report improved visual quality, spatial consistency, and long-context behavior when generated trajectories revisit earlier scenes.

2506.17201.title_zh: Hunyuan-GameCraft：基于动作条件的高动态交互游戏视频生成

background.zh: 游戏视频世界模型需要根据玩家输入持续生成画面，同时维持动作响应和跨片段内容一致性。
background.en: Game video world models must continually respond to player inputs while preserving dynamic motion and consistent content across generated segments.

challenge.zh: 复杂游戏运动与长时间自回归生成相互作用，容易造成控制不准确和历史场景信息丢失。
challenge.en: Complex game dynamics interact with long autoregressive generation, making precise control and preservation of historical scene information difficult.

method.zh: 方法统一键鼠与相机控制表示，结合混合历史训练、自回归扩展及蒸馏加速交互式生成。
method.en: The system unifies keyboard, mouse, and camera controls, combining hybrid history training, autoregressive extension, and distillation for interactive generation.

result.zh: 作者基于大规模游戏视频与合成数据评测，报告动态表现、控制能力和长序列一致性的改善。
result.en: Evaluations using large-scale game videos and synthetic data report improvements in motion dynamics, controllability, and consistency during extended generation.

2508.13009.title_zh: Matrix-Game 2.0：实时自回归交互世界模型

background.zh: 实时交互世界模型需要逐帧响应键鼠输入，并在较长运行过程中持续产生连贯的视频内容。
background.en: Real-time interactive world models must respond to frame-level keyboard and mouse inputs while producing coherent video throughout extended sessions.

challenge.zh: 高质量视频扩散推理成本较高，长时间运行还会放大动作控制误差与视觉质量退化。
challenge.en: High-quality video diffusion is computationally expensive, and extended operation amplifies control errors and degradation of generated visual content.

method.zh: 方法利用大规模游戏与引擎数据训练动作条件模型，再通过因果少步蒸馏支持流式自回归生成。
method.en: The method trains action-conditioned models on large-scale game and engine data, then applies causal few-step distillation for streaming autoregressive generation.

result.zh: 作者报告每秒二十五帧的实时生成和分钟级交互视频，展示跨场景的动作控制能力。
result.en: The authors report real-time generation at twenty-five frames per second and minute-long interactive videos with action control across different environments.

2512.22096.title_zh: Yume-1.5：具有控制与记忆的交互世界生成模型

background.zh: 交互世界生成希望从图像或文本出发，让用户通过键盘和事件描述持续探索生成环境。
background.en: Interactive world generation aims to let users explore environments initialized from images or text through keyboard controls and event descriptions.

challenge.zh: 持续探索要求同时保存历史信息、降低注意力成本，并让文本事件稳定影响后续视频内容。
challenge.en: Continued exploration requires preserving historical information, reducing attention costs, and reliably grounding textual events in subsequent generated video content.

method.zh: 方法结合统一上下文压缩、线性注意力、双向注意力蒸馏和增强文本表示实现可控世界生成。
method.en: The system combines unified context compression, linear attention, bidirectional attention distillation, and enhanced text representations to support controllable world generation.

result.zh: 作者展示由图文初始化、键盘探索和文本事件共同驱动的交互视频，验证框架的可控生成能力。
result.en: The authors demonstrate interactive videos driven by image or text initialization, keyboard exploration, and textual events, illustrating the framework's controllable generation capabilities.

2603.00825.title_zh: COMBAT：面向实时格斗游戏的可控世界模型

background.zh: 格斗游戏世界模型需要在玩家连续操作下生成高速运动，同时让对手表现出合理的即时反应。
background.en: Fighting-game world models must generate rapid motion under continuous player control while producing plausible, responsive behavior from an opposing character.

challenge.zh: 缺少对手动作标签与实时延迟要求，使多角色交互建模和高质量视频扩散难以同时实现。
challenge.en: Missing opponent-action annotations and stringent latency requirements make it difficult to combine multi-character interaction modeling with high-quality diffusion video generation.

method.zh: 方法在压缩潜空间中训练动作条件扩散模型，结合因果蒸馏与扩散强制实现实时闭环生成。
method.en: The method trains an action-conditioned diffusion model in a compressed latent space, combining causal distillation and diffusion forcing for real-time closed-loop generation.

result.zh: 在《铁拳三》场景中，作者展示实时可控画面及无显式对手动作监督下形成的反应行为。
result.en: Experiments in Tekken 3 demonstrate real-time controllable visuals and responsive opponent behavior learned without explicit supervision of the opponent's actions.

2604.22152.title_zh: dWorldEval：用于机器人策略评估的离散扩散世界模型

background.zh: 机器人策略的离线评估需要能够根据候选动作预测环境变化，并区分不同策略的任务表现。
background.en: Offline robot-policy evaluation needs models that predict environmental changes under candidate actions and distinguish the task performance of different policies.

challenge.zh: 长轨迹中的记忆丢失和视觉、语言、动作表示不统一，会削弱预测与策略排序的可靠性。
challenge.en: Memory loss across long trajectories and incompatible visual, language, and action representations can undermine prediction accuracy and reliable policy ranking.

method.zh: 方法以离散扩散统一多模态标记，结合稀疏关键帧记忆和进度标记联合预测未来演化。
method.en: The method unifies multimodal tokens through discrete diffusion and combines sparse keyframe memory with progress tokens to predict future trajectory evolution.

result.zh: 作者在仿真和真实机器人评估中报告较强的策略评估表现，并与多种已有世界模型进行比较。
result.en: Experiments in simulation and real-robot settings report strong policy-evaluation performance compared with several existing world models for robot evaluation.

2606.04463.title_zh: OSCAR：面向机器人评估的动作可控世界模型

background.zh: 机器人世界模型希望利用机器人和人类第一视角视频，构建能够支持动作预测与策略评估的模拟器。
background.en: Robot world models seek to combine robot demonstrations and human egocentric videos into simulators that support action prediction and policy evaluation.

challenge.zh: 不同数据源具有不同身体形态和动作空间，难以形成统一且准确遵循动作的生成条件。
challenge.en: Different embodiments and action spaces across data sources complicate the construction of a unified conditioning interface that reliably follows actions.

method.zh: 方法标准化机器人与人类数据，用运动学渲染的二维骨架统一条件，并微调预训练视频模型。
method.en: The method standardizes robot and human data, uses kinematically rendered two-dimensional skeletons as unified conditions, and fine-tunes a pretrained video model.

result.zh: 作者报告动作跟随、视觉质量和运动表现改善，虚拟评估中的策略表现与真实机器人结果相关。
result.en: The authors report improved action following, visual quality, and motion, with virtual policy evaluations correlating with performance measured on real robots.

2606.05558.title_zh: ADWM：用于语言智能体离线策略评估的动作依赖世界模型

background.zh: 语言智能体的离线策略评估需要利用已收集交互数据，估计新策略在环境中的长期回报。
background.en: Offline evaluation of language agents seeks to estimate a new policy's long-term return using previously collected interactions with its environment.

challenge.zh: 联合生成整条轨迹可能破坏先观察再选择动作的因果关系，从而错误估计候选策略价值。
challenge.en: Jointly generating entire trajectories can violate the causal order of observing states before choosing actions, producing inaccurate estimates of policy value.

method.zh: 方法以逐转移潜扩散模型交替生成环境反馈和策略动作，并使用策略条件分数引导预测。
method.en: The method alternates transition-level latent diffusion with actions sampled from the evaluated policy, using policy-conditioned score guidance during prediction.

result.zh: 作者在智能体评估基准上报告更准确的策略价值估计，支持保持动作依赖关系的模拟过程。
result.en: Results on agent-evaluation benchmarks report more accurate policy-value estimates, supporting simulation that preserves the dependence between observations and policy actions.

2606.12987.title_zh: 面向自动驾驶的世界—动作扩散 Transformer

background.zh: 自动驾驶世界模型需要从当前摄像头观测与自车动作预测未来视觉变化，以支持动作条件分析。
background.en: Autonomous-driving world models predict future visual changes from current camera observations and ego actions to support action-conditioned analysis and simulation.

challenge.zh: 有限训练数据下，低失真指标可能偏好模糊预测，难以同时反映视觉真实性与动作响应。
challenge.en: With limited training data, distortion metrics may favor blurry predictions and fail to jointly reflect perceptual realism and responsiveness to actions.

method.zh: 方法使用世界—动作扩散 Transformer，结合空间标记、残差锚定和不确定性匹配采样生成未来潜变量。
method.en: The approach uses a world-action diffusion transformer with spatial tokens, residual anchoring, and uncertainty-matched sampling to generate future visual latents.

result.zh: 作者展示动作条件未来预测，并分析失真与感知指标之间的差异及采样校准对结果的影响。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate action-conditioned future prediction and analyze differences between distortion and perceptual metrics, including the effects of calibrated sampling choices.

2606.29501.title_zh: A2World：统一机器人世界模拟与动作策略

background.zh: 机器人学习既需要可控的世界模拟器，也需要能从视觉观测直接产生动作的策略模型。
background.en: Robot learning needs both controllable world simulators and policies that produce actions directly from visual observations in diverse manipulation tasks.

challenge.zh: 将视频预测与动作学习分开训练，难以充分利用带动作标注、多视角机器人数据的共同结构。
challenge.en: Training video prediction and action learning separately can fail to exploit shared structure in action-annotated, multiview robot interaction data.

method.zh: 方法利用动作标注的多视角数据进行预训练，并分别适配为世界模拟器和联合视频动作策略。
method.en: The method pretrains on action-annotated multiview robot data and adapts the shared model into a world simulator and a joint video-action policy.

result.zh: 作者报告世界模拟、策略评估及真实与仿真机器人控制的改善，展示统一预训练的多用途价值。
result.en: The authors report improvements in world simulation, policy evaluation, and both simulated and real-robot control, demonstrating multiple uses of shared pretraining.

2312.04429.title_zh: Nirvana：通过近似计算缓存加速文本到图像生成

background.zh: 在线文本到图像服务反复执行昂贵的扩散去噪，而相似提示可能对应可复用的中间生成状态。
background.en: Online text-to-image services repeatedly execute expensive diffusion denoising, while similar prompts may offer opportunities to reuse intermediate generation states.

challenge.zh: 跨提示复用需要在生成质量、缓存命中和存储成本之间取舍，普通完整结果缓存覆盖有限。
challenge.en: Cross-prompt reuse must balance generation quality, cache hit rate, and storage cost, whereas caching complete outputs covers only limited request similarity.

method.zh: 系统缓存近似可复用的中间噪声状态，并通过专门的缓存替换策略减少后续请求的去噪计算。
method.en: The system caches approximately reusable intermediate noise states and applies a dedicated replacement policy to reduce denoising work for subsequent requests.

result.zh: 生产工作负载评估显示该近似缓存设计降低生成延迟与服务成本，收益取决于请求相似性和质量约束。
result.en: Production-workload evaluations show lower generation latency and serving cost from approximate caching, with benefits depending on request similarity and quality constraints.

2407.02031.title_zh: Katz：优化扩散图像生成服务

background.zh: 生产图像生成工作流通常组合基础扩散模型、控制网络和个性化模块，形成不同的资源需求。
background.en: Production image-generation workflows combine base diffusion models, control networks, and personalization modules with distinct computational demands and resource requirements.

challenge.zh: 整体部署限制模块共享与独立扩缩容，控制网络计算和个性化权重加载还会增加请求延迟。
challenge.en: Monolithic deployment limits component sharing and independent scaling, while control-network execution and loading personalized weights further increase request latency.

method.zh: 系统分离控制网络服务并共享缓存，结合有界异步个性化加载与潜变量并行优化生成流程。
method.en: The system separates control-network serving with shared caching, combines bounded asynchronous personalization loading, and uses latent parallelism to optimize generation workflows.

result.zh: 作者在扩散模型服务评估中报告更低延迟与更高吞吐，并分析不同优化机制的贡献。
result.en: Evaluations of diffusion-model serving report lower latency and higher throughput, with component analyses showing the contribution of individual optimization mechanisms.

2411.15381.title_zh: DiffServe：基于模型级联的高效扩散服务

background.zh: 不同文本到图像请求对模型能力的需求不同，统一使用昂贵模型可能浪费在线服务计算资源。
background.en: Text-to-image requests differ in their required model capability, so using the same expensive model for every request can waste serving resources.

challenge.zh: 轻量模型与高质量模型之间的选择，需要同时满足输出质量、到达负载和延迟服务目标。
challenge.en: Choosing between lightweight and higher-quality models requires jointly accounting for output quality, request load, and latency service-level objectives during operation.

method.zh: 系统自动构建扩散模型级联，并按请求难度与运行负载分配模型执行和服务资源。
method.en: The system automatically constructs diffusion-model cascades and allocates model execution and serving resources according to request difficulty and runtime load.

result.zh: 实验显示模型级联与资源分配结合能够减少延迟违约，并在评估工作负载中维持目标生成质量。
result.en: Experiments show that combining model cascades with resource allocation reduces latency violations while maintaining the target generation quality on evaluated workloads.

2501.09253.title_zh: PatchedServe：面向异构分辨率的扩散模型服务

background.zh: 扩散服务需要同时处理不同分辨率的图像和视频请求，而整图批处理难以充分共享执行资源。
background.en: Diffusion serving handles image and video requests with heterogeneous resolutions, making whole-image batching inefficient for sharing available execution resources.

challenge.zh: 不同请求的计算规模与延迟要求差异，会导致批处理效率下降并增加服务目标违约风险。
challenge.en: Differences in computational size and latency requirements reduce batching efficiency and increase the risk of violating service-level objectives across concurrent requests.

method.zh: 系统以图像块组织执行与缓存，结合轻量延迟预测和面向服务目标的调度处理混合请求。
method.en: The system organizes execution and caching around patches, combining lightweight latency prediction with service-level-objective-aware scheduling for heterogeneous concurrent requests.

result.zh: 作者在混合分辨率工作负载中报告更高的服务目标达成率，验证图像块粒度的调度收益。
result.en: Evaluations with mixed-resolution workloads report improved service-level-objective attainment, demonstrating the benefits of scheduling and processing requests at patch granularity.

2505.20600.title_zh: FlashPS：通过掩码感知缓存与调度高效服务生成式图像编辑

background.zh: 生成式图像编辑通常只修改掩码指定区域并保留其余内容，但在线服务仍需执行较多全图扩散计算。
background.en: Generative image editing typically modifies only masked regions while preserving surrounding content, yet online services still perform substantial full-image diffusion computation.

challenge.zh: 未编辑区域的重复计算形成浪费，不同掩码大小又导致请求负载不均，缓存读取也可能抵消加速收益。
challenge.en: Repeated computation on unedited regions wastes resources, varying mask sizes create imbalanced requests, and cache retrieval can offset the intended acceleration gains.

method.zh: 系统利用掩码感知缓存复用未编辑区域计算，重叠缓存读取与执行，并通过持续批处理平衡不同编辑请求。
method.en: The system reuses computation for unedited regions through mask-aware caching, overlaps cache retrieval with execution, and balances editing requests using continuous batching.

result.zh: 图像编辑服务评估显示延迟与吞吐改善，表明利用掩码结构并协调缓存与调度能够降低实际服务成本。
result.en: Image-editing serving evaluations show improved latency and throughput, demonstrating how mask structure and coordinated caching and scheduling reduce practical serving costs.

socc25-diffusion-serving.title_zh: 生产环境中的扩散模型服务：工作负载与系统优化

background.zh: 大规模生产扩散服务面对多样工作流与突发请求，需要同时管理模型加载、缓存和在线调度。
background.en: Large production diffusion services face diverse workflows and bursty requests, requiring coordinated management of model loading, caching, and online scheduling.

challenge.zh: 请求分布偏斜与多级管理开销，使单独优化模型推理不足以解决端到端延迟和资源利用问题。
challenge.en: Skewed demand and overhead across multiple management layers mean optimizing model inference alone cannot resolve end-to-end latency and resource-utilization problems.

method.zh: 论文分析生产请求与集群行为，提出协调缓存、扩缩容、实例输入输出及分层预取的系统优化。
method.en: The study analyzes production requests and cluster behavior, proposing coordinated optimizations for caching, autoscaling, instance input-output, and hierarchical model prefetching.

result.zh: 生产规模评估显示端到端延迟和模型加载时间下降，强调跨层优化对真实扩散服务的重要性。
result.en: Production-scale evaluations show reduced end-to-end latency and model-loading time, demonstrating the importance of coordinated optimizations across the diffusion-serving software stack.

2604.08123.title_zh: LegoDiffusion：文本到图像工作流的微服务化

background.zh: 文本到图像工作流通常由多个模型组成，不同请求之间可能共享模型但具有不同资源需求。
background.en: Text-to-image workflows contain multiple models that may be shared across requests while exhibiting distinct compute, memory, and scaling requirements.

challenge.zh: 将工作流视为整体会隐藏内部数据流，阻碍模型共享，并迫使所有模块采用粗粒度资源配置。
challenge.en: Treating workflows as opaque monoliths hides their internal dataflow, prevents model sharing, and forces coarse-grained provisioning and resource management.

method.zh: 系统把工作流拆为松耦合模型执行节点，独立调度模型并支持逐模型扩缩容与自适应并行。
method.en: The system decomposes workflows into loosely coupled model-execution nodes, enabling independent scheduling, per-model scaling, model sharing, and adaptive model parallelism.

result.zh: 作者报告在评估工作负载下可支持更高请求速率和更强突发流量，优于整体式工作流服务。
result.en: Evaluations report higher sustainable request rates and greater tolerance of burst traffic compared with existing systems that serve diffusion workflows monolithically.

2605.25550.title_zh: DisagFusion：分离式扩散服务的异步流水线与弹性调度

background.zh: 扩散工作流的编码器、去噪模型和解码器资源需求不同，适合部署为异构设备上的独立服务。
background.en: Encoders, denoising models, and decoders have different resource demands, motivating disaggregated diffusion serving across heterogeneous devices and independently managed stages.

challenge.zh: 阶段交接通信与快速变化的负载会产生流水线气泡，使固定实例配比难以持续保持效率。
challenge.en: Stage-handoff communication and rapidly changing workloads create pipeline bubbles, making fixed instance ratios ineffective for maintaining efficiency under changing demand.

method.zh: 系统以异步流水线重叠计算和通信，再结合性能预测与运行反馈动态调整各阶段实例配比。
method.en: The system overlaps computation and communication through asynchronous pipelining and combines performance prediction with runtime feedback to rebalance stage-instance ratios.

result.zh: 作者相对整体式基线报告吞吐与延迟改善，展示异构部署下分阶段资源调度的实际价值。
result.en: Compared with a monolithic baseline, evaluations report improved throughput and latency, demonstrating the practical value of stage-level resource scheduling across heterogeneous deployments.

2606.19271.title_zh: TurboServe：高效且经济的流式视频生成服务

background.zh: 流式视频服务需要长期维护用户会话，并在用户交互和空闲之间持续按时交付视频片段。
background.en: Streaming video services maintain long-lived user sessions and must deliver chunks on time as users alternate between interaction and idle periods.

challenge.zh: 会话持续时间与活跃需求的差异，会让原有放置失衡，同时造成高峰延迟和空闲设备浪费。
challenge.en: Heterogeneous session durations and fluctuating active demand make placement progressively imbalanced, increasing peak latency while wasting resources during idle periods.

method.zh: 系统联合迁移感知放置与负载驱动扩缩容，辅以片段批处理、会话卸载和设备间迁移。
method.en: The system combines migration-aware placement and load-driven autoscaling with chunk batching, session offloading, and GPU-to-GPU migration for online rebalancing.

result.zh: 生产轨迹评估显示最坏片段延迟和总设备成本降低，说明会话状态管理能支持经济的流式服务。
result.en: Evaluations using production traces report lower worst-case chunk latency and total GPU cost, demonstrating economical streaming serving through coordinated session-state management.

2607.12121.title_zh: FlashDiff：扩散服务的区域执行与调度

background.zh: 扩散生成在多个去噪步骤反复更新全部潜变量，但不同空间或时间区域的收敛速度并不相同。
background.en: Diffusion generation repeatedly updates all latent regions, even though spatial and temporal regions stabilize at different rates across denoising steps.

challenge.zh: 完整区域执行浪费计算，而多设备并行产生的激活交换又可能抵消区域划分带来的效率收益。
challenge.en: Executing every region wastes computation, while activation exchange across devices can offset the efficiency gains expected from finer-grained regional parallelism.

method.zh: 系统用早期注意力划分区域，估计活跃度并跳过低影响更新，再以亲和性感知调度复用算力。
method.en: The system partitions regions using early attention, estimates activity to skip low-impact updates, and uses affinity-aware scheduling to reassign reclaimed compute capacity.

result.zh: 作者在图像、视频和音频任务中报告延迟与吞吐改善，其加速依赖区域级近似执行策略。
result.en: Evaluations across image, video, and audio workloads report improved latency and throughput, with acceleration relying on approximate execution at regional granularity.

2607.26566.title_zh: ServerlessT2I：无服务器平台上的高效文本到图像工作流服务

background.zh: 用户常以间歇方式调用自定义生成工作流，因此文本到图像服务需要灵活共享和按需配置资源。
background.en: Users often invoke customized generation workflows intermittently, motivating flexible resource sharing and on-demand provisioning for serverless text-to-image serving platforms.

challenge.zh: 整体部署工作流增加扩缩容成本，隐藏模型共享机会，并限制多租户环境中的细粒度公平调度。
challenge.en: Monolithic workflow deployment increases scaling overhead, hides opportunities for model sharing, and limits fine-grained fairness in multi-tenant GPU-serving environments.

method.zh: 系统把工作流拆为模型函数，利用空闲显存构建数据通路，并联合逐模型扩缩容与公平调度。
method.en: The system decomposes workflows into model functions, builds a data plane from spare GPU memory, and combines per-model scaling with fairness-aware scheduling.

result.zh: 生产轨迹实验显示相同设备预算下可支持更高请求速率，并能在满足服务目标时减少资源消耗。
result.en: Production-trace evaluations show higher sustainable request rates under the same GPU budget and reduced resource consumption while meeting service-level objectives.

2508.03680.title_zh: Agent Lightning：使用强化学习训练多样化智能体

background.zh: 智能体通常依赖不同框架组织工具调用与控制流程，而强化学习训练需要统一的数据与优化接口。
background.en: Agents use diverse frameworks to organize tool calls and control flow, while reinforcement learning requires consistent data interfaces and optimization procedures.

challenge.zh: 执行逻辑与训练引擎紧耦合，会让复杂工作流和多智能体系统难以接入通用强化学习框架。
challenge.en: Tight coupling between agent execution and training engines makes complex workflows and multi-agent systems difficult to integrate into general reinforcement-learning frameworks.

method.zh: 框架分离智能体执行与训练，通过统一转移接口和分层信用分配，将交互轨迹转化为学习样本。
method.en: The framework disaggregates agent execution from training, using unified transitions and hierarchical credit assignment to convert interaction trajectories into learning samples.

result.zh: 文本到 SQL、检索增强和数学工具任务中，作者报告持续性能改善，并展示对多种智能体实现的兼容性。
result.en: Experiments on text-to-SQL, retrieval augmentation, and mathematical tool use report sustained improvements and demonstrate compatibility with multiple agent implementations.

2608.17528.title_zh: Agent Lightning v1.0：面向原生运行框架的智能体强化学习

background.zh: 部署时的智能体运行框架负责工具、上下文和控制流程，因此也应直接参与模型的强化学习训练。
background.en: Deployment-time agent harnesses manage tools, context, and control flow, making them an important part of reinforcement-learning post-training for agent models.

challenge.zh: 训练器仅观察模型请求与响应时，重新分词、样本合并、优势计算和损失归一化会影响训练稳定性。
challenge.en: When trainers observe only model requests and responses, retokenization, sample merging, advantage estimation, and loss normalization can materially affect training stability.

method.zh: 框架通过模型端点代理连接原生运行框架与训练，提供轻量实现及完整可复现的代码智能体训练流程。
method.en: The framework connects native harnesses to training through a model-endpoint proxy, providing a lightweight implementation and a reproducible coding-agent training pipeline.

result.zh: 作者在指令、搜索与代码任务中验证方法，并报告有限训练数据下代码智能体基准成绩显著提升。
result.en: Evaluations cover instruction following, search, and coding, reporting substantial coding-agent benchmark improvements from a limited set of reinforcement-learning training examples.

2505.24298.title_zh: AReaL：面向语言推理的大规模异步强化学习系统

background.zh: 语言模型强化学习需要大量并行生成与训练，而同步批次容易受到最长生成轨迹的拖累。
background.en: Language-model reinforcement learning requires extensive parallel generation and training, but synchronous batches are delayed by the longest generated trajectories within each batch.

challenge.zh: 完全分离生成和训练能提高利用率，却会引入旧策略数据，影响优化稳定性与最终模型表现。
challenge.en: Fully separating generation from training improves utilization but introduces stale-policy data that can affect optimization stability and final model performance.

method.zh: 系统让生成与训练持续异步运行，通过负载平衡限制数据陈旧度，并采用针对陈旧样本调整的 PPO。
method.en: The system continuously runs generation and training asynchronously, balances their workloads to control staleness, and uses PPO adapted to outdated training samples.

result.zh: 数学与代码推理评估显示相同设备数量下训练加速，最终任务表现与同步系统相当或更好。
result.en: Math and code-reasoning evaluations show faster training with the same GPU count and final task performance matching or exceeding synchronous systems.

2603.13019.title_zh: ARL-Tangram：提升智能体强化学习的资源效率

background.zh: 智能体强化学习除训练设备外，还依赖代码执行容器、奖励模型等多种外部计算与环境资源。
background.en: Agentic reinforcement learning depends on external resources such as code-execution containers and reward models in addition to the main training accelerators.

challenge.zh: 把外部资源长期绑定到轨迹或任务，会在交互等待期间造成过度配置和资源利用率下降。
challenge.en: Binding external resources to long-lived trajectories or individual tasks causes overprovisioning and poor utilization during interactions and periods of waiting.

method.zh: 系统按动作粒度统一编排资源，结合弹性调度及适配异构资源和拓扑的执行管理器。
method.en: The system orchestrates resources at action granularity, combining elastic scheduling with execution managers tailored to heterogeneous resource characteristics and hardware topologies.

result.zh: 真实智能体训练任务显示动作完成时间与训练步长下降，外部资源开销减少，并支持工业模型训练。
result.en: Real agent-training workloads show shorter action completion times and training steps with lower external resource consumption, alongside deployment for industrial model training.

2608.14635.title_zh: Belayer：智能体强化学习的高效容错

background.zh: 长时程智能体训练同时依赖生成引擎和有状态环境，故障可能丢失已经完成的交互与工具副作用。
background.en: Long-horizon agent training depends on rollout engines and stateful environments, where failures can discard completed interactions and invalidate accumulated tool side effects.

challenge.zh: 单独恢复模型或容器可能造成上下文与环境不一致，而完整冷启动和频繁检查点又代价高昂。
challenge.en: Recovering only the model or container can leave context and environment inconsistent, while full cold starts and frequent checkpoints impose substantial overhead.

method.zh: 系统复用通过健康检查的设备状态，重建请求缓存，并联合恢复容器文件与运行状态以保持前缀一致。
method.en: The system reuses health-checked GPU state, rebuilds request caches, and jointly restores container filesystem and runtime state to preserve context-prefix consistency.

result.zh: 作者报告较低无故障开销及更快的工作进程和环境恢复，同时在自然推理空隙重叠检查点操作。
result.en: Experiments report low failure-free overhead and faster worker and environment recovery, with checkpoint operations overlapped opportunistically during natural inference gaps.

2609.36899.title_zh: CadenceRL：重塑异构加速器上的异步强化学习生成负载

background.zh: 长时程多轮强化学习需要异构设备持续生成轨迹，同时兼顾整体吞吐与单条轨迹的完成时间。
background.en: Long-horizon multi-turn reinforcement learning requires heterogeneous accelerators to generate trajectories continuously while balancing aggregate throughput against individual trajectory completion times.

challenge.zh: 大批次提升权重读取效率却拉长单轨迹延迟，而动态迁移收益又依赖后续难以预测的放置决策。
challenge.en: Large batches amortize weight reads but increase individual latency, while the benefit of dynamic migration depends on difficult-to-predict subsequent placement decisions.

method.zh: 系统通过节奏控制维持短上下文大批次，将陈旧长尾集中到适合设备，并延后绑定缓存准备目的地。
method.en: The system paces short-context work to maintain large batches, concentrates stale long tails on suitable workers, and prepares caches with late-bound destinations.

result.zh: 异构生成池评估显示解码吞吐与轨迹尾延迟改善，不同类型加速器可分别贡献吞吐和长尾处理能力。
result.en: Evaluations on heterogeneous rollout pools show improved decoding throughput and trajectory tail latency, with different accelerator types contributing complementary serving capabilities.

chandy-lamport.title_zh: 分布式快照：确定分布式系统的全局状态

background.zh: 分布式系统中的终止、死锁和检查点等任务，需要了解多个进程与通信信道共同形成的全局状态。
background.en: Tasks such as termination detection, deadlock detection, and checkpointing require knowledge of the global state formed by distributed processes and communication channels.

challenge.zh: 进程没有统一瞬时时钟，局部状态记录与在途消息必须协调，才能获得一致而有意义的系统快照。
challenge.en: Processes lack a shared instantaneous clock, so local-state recording and in-transit messages must be coordinated to obtain a meaningful, consistent global snapshot.

method.zh: 算法通过特殊标记协调进程状态与信道状态的记录，在正常分布式计算进行期间收集全局快照。
method.en: The algorithm coordinates process-state and channel-state recording through special markers, collecting a global snapshot while the underlying distributed computation continues normally.

result.zh: 论文给出全局状态记录算法及其性质，并说明如何用于检测持续成立的稳定性质和支持检查点。
result.en: The paper establishes a global-state recording algorithm and its properties, showing applications to stable-property detection and checkpointing in distributed systems.

2606.24369.title_zh: DigenRL：通过扩散并行与训练器辅助生成加速分离式强化学习

background.zh: 视觉生成模型的强化学习包含昂贵扩散采样与训练，需要支持异构设备和独立配置的执行资源。
background.en: Reinforcement learning for visual generative models combines expensive diffusion sampling and training, motivating heterogeneous hardware support and independently configurable execution resources.

challenge.zh: 整体部署限制资源伸缩，而分离之后生成与训练之间的等待和长尾气泡仍会浪费设备算力。
challenge.en: Colocated deployment restricts resource scaling, while disaggregation still leaves waiting periods and long-tail bubbles between generation and training that waste accelerator capacity.

method.zh: 框架结合生成轴流水线、时间步并行、训练器辅助采样及一步受限异步执行，减少分离架构中的空隙。
method.en: The framework combines generation-axis pipelining, timestep parallelism, trainer-assisted sampling, and one-step-bounded asynchronous execution to reduce idle periods in disaggregated training.

result.zh: 多个图像和视频模型及硬件平台的评估显示训练吞吐改善，验证不同扩散模型上的系统加速能力。
result.en: Evaluations across image and video models and multiple hardware platforms report higher training throughput, demonstrating system acceleration across different diffusion-model architectures.

2604.26256.title_zh: DORA：可扩展的异步语言模型强化学习系统

background.zh: 语言模型强化学习的生成轨迹具有明显长尾，少量慢轨迹可能阻塞整个训练流水线。
background.en: Language-model reinforcement learning produces long-tailed rollout durations, allowing a small number of slow trajectories to block the entire training pipeline.

challenge.zh: 异步化需要同时维持轨迹内策略一致、数据完整与有限陈旧度，否则系统效率可能以收敛质量为代价。
challenge.en: Asynchrony must preserve within-trajectory policy consistency, data integrity, and bounded staleness, or improved system efficiency may come at the expense of convergence.

method.zh: 系统同时维护多个策略版本进行流式生成，通过动态编排减少长尾气泡并满足所列训练约束。
method.en: The system maintains multiple policy versions for streaming rollout generation, dynamically orchestrating work to reduce long-tail bubbles while satisfying the stated training constraints.

result.zh: 公开基准与大规模工业训练报告更高吞吐和更短训练时间，并展示保持模型收敛的实验结果。
result.en: Public benchmarks and large-scale industrial training report higher throughput and shorter training time, with experimental results showing preserved model convergence.

dynarl.title_zh: DynaRL：大规模强化学习训练的灵活动态调度

background.zh: 现代强化学习包含长尾生成、工具交互与不断变化的阶段瓶颈，使固定资源配置容易产生设备空闲。
background.en: Modern reinforcement learning combines long-tailed generation, tool interactions, and changing stage bottlenecks, causing fixed resource allocations to leave accelerators idle.

challenge.zh: 计算、内存和通信资源跨组件耦合，动态迁移还必须维持正确数据路由并控制在线调度开销。
challenge.en: Computation, memory, and communication resources interact across components, while dynamic migration must preserve data routing and keep online scheduling overhead low.

method.zh: 系统以动态超图表示训练流水线，通过统一迁移接口、上下文感知路由和多层调度重分配资源。
method.en: The system represents the training pipeline with a dynamic hypergraph and reallocates resources through unified migration interfaces, context-aware routing, and multilevel scheduling.

result.zh: 数学推理与智能体强化学习评估显示端到端吞吐提高，在线调度开销在实验中保持较低。
result.en: Evaluations on mathematical-reasoning and agentic reinforcement-learning workloads report improved end-to-end throughput with low online scheduling overhead in the measured experiments.

gcr.title_zh: GCR：快速轻量的 GPU 检查点与恢复

background.zh: 透明设备检查点可以支持弹性伸缩、任务切换和容错，为不同 GPU 应用提供统一状态迁移能力。
background.en: Transparent GPU checkpointing supports elastic scaling, task switching, and fault tolerance, providing a unified state-migration mechanism for different accelerator applications.

challenge.zh: 已有方案难以同时降低保存恢复延迟和正常执行开销，增量检查点的脏数据识别也可能成本较高。
challenge.en: Existing approaches struggle to combine low checkpoint-restore latency with low normal-execution overhead, while identifying dirty data can make incremental checkpointing expensive.

method.zh: 系统分离控制与数据状态，利用轻量处理器影子执行和脏模板识别变化缓冲区，支持混合增量检查点。
method.en: The system separates control and data state and uses lightweight CPU shadow execution with dirty templates to identify modified buffers for incremental checkpointing.

result.zh: 实验显示检查点与恢复延迟降低，正常运行额外开销较小，增量保存还可减少检查点大小和传输时间。
result.en: Experiments show lower checkpoint and restoration latency with little normal-execution overhead, while incremental checkpointing further reduces checkpoint size and transfer time.

2510.12633.title_zh: Laminar：可扩展的异步RL后训练框架

background.zh: 大模型RL需要在大规模集群持续生成轨迹并更新参数，而生成长度往往存在明显长尾。
background.en: Large-scale reinforcement learning repeatedly generates trajectories and updates model parameters, while highly skewed generation lengths create expensive stragglers.

challenge.zh: 全局权重同步与长轨迹拖尾造成GPU等待，还使长时间训练中的局部失败影响其他角色。
challenge.en: Global weight synchronization and long-tail trajectories leave GPUs waiting and couple failures across otherwise independent roles in prolonged training.

method.zh: 采用分布式参数中继和细粒度异步同步，将长尾轨迹动态重打包到专用生成工作器。
method.en: Laminar uses distributed parameter relays for asynchronous synchronization and dynamically repacks long-tail trajectories onto dedicated rollout workers to improve utilization.

result.zh: 作者在1024张GPU上报告最高5.48倍训练吞吐提升，并观察到更短的模型收敛时间。
result.en: On a 1,024-GPU cluster, the authors report up to 5.48 times higher training throughput and reduced time to model convergence.

2610.08430.title_zh: NeMo-DCR：逐位精确的增量压缩权重同步

background.zh: 分离式智能体RL必须把每次训练后的新策略传给生成集群，万亿参数权重的完整传输成本很高。
background.en: Disaggregated agentic RL must distribute updated policies to rollout clusters, making full transfers of trillion-parameter checkpoints prohibitively expensive.

challenge.zh: 压缩传输还需保持接收权重与dense refit逐位一致，并正确处理分片加载、部分写入和重试。
challenge.en: Compression must preserve stored weight bits across loading and sharding while handling partial writes, failures and synchronization baselines correctly.

method.zh: 按权重变化构造XOR增量与覆盖数据，结合原生loader、原地应用、流式分发和联合版本提交。
method.en: NeMo-DCR combines XOR deltas and overwrites with native loaders, in-place application, streamed distribution and joint policy-baseline commits.

result.zh: 作者在30B至1T模型上报告12至40倍同步加速，1T模型3%变化率时由87.5分钟降至150秒。
result.en: For evaluated 30B–1T models, the authors report 12–40-fold faster refits; a 1T example drops from 87.5 minutes to 150 seconds.

2610.08430.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2609.35158.title_zh: PEARL：智能体RL中的弹性预填充与解码执行

background.zh: 多轮rollout常占智能体RL的大部分成本，而训练GPU在更新之间可能闲置并具有临时借用价值。
background.en: Multi-turn rollouts dominate agentic RL costs, while training GPUs may remain idle between updates and offer temporary additional capacity.

challenge.zh: 简单增加生成副本收益递减，环境等待、prefill/decode配置及角色切换成本共同影响资源利用。
challenge.en: Adding rollout replicas has diminishing returns because environment waits, prefill-decode configuration and role-switching overhead jointly shape useful resource capacity.

method.zh: 在当前 GPU 预算下选择预填充解码模式与配比，按收益门控训练卡借用，并以增量转换抑制无益切换。
method.en: PEARL selects prefill-decode modes and ratios within the current GPU budget, gates trainer borrowing by expected benefit, and minimizes reconfiguration through incremental transitions.

result.zh: 作者报告相对固定资源ROLL获得2.17至2.79倍吞吐，并在所测模型上优于RLBoost增强基线。
result.en: The authors report 2.17–2.79 times the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL and improvements over an enhanced RLBoost baseline on evaluated models.

2609.35158.review_note: The worker budget is supplied by an external resource manager; reported throughput combines rollout-generated and training tokens per step.

2510.19225.title_zh: RLBoost：利用可抢占资源降低大模型RL成本

background.zh: RL训练的rollout具有高度并行性，而机会GPU价格较低，适合补充长期保留的训练资源。
background.en: RL rollouts are highly parallel, making inexpensive preemptible GPUs a potential complement to reserved resources used for tightly coupled training.

challenge.zh: 机会资源随时加入或被回收，若加载权重和恢复轨迹成本过高，会抵消可抢占GPU的收益。
challenge.en: Frequent resource arrivals and revocations can erase savings if provisioning weights and recovering generation progress impose substantial overhead.

method.zh: 保留紧耦合训练集群，自适应卸载rollout，并用拉取式权重传输和token级响应迁移处理回收。
method.en: RLBoost retains a reserved training cluster and combines adaptive rollout offloading, pull-based weight transfer and token-level response collection and migration.

result.zh: 作者报告训练吞吐提高1.51至1.97倍，成本效率比仅使用按需GPU提高28%至49%。
result.en: The authors report 1.51–1.97 times higher throughput and 28–49% better cost efficiency than relying exclusively on on-demand GPU resources.

2512.22492.title_zh: RobustRL：按角色恢复的大模型RL容错

background.zh: 大规模RL后训练包含训练与生成等不同角色，长期运行会遭遇局部机器或工作器故障。
background.en: Large-scale RL post-training comprises distinct training and rollout roles and must withstand localized failures during long-running jobs.

challenge.zh: 全作业重启浪费健康角色的进度，静态集合通信又使恢复后的角色难以快速重连。
challenge.en: Restarting the entire job wastes healthy workers' progress, while static collective groups complicate rapid reconnection of recovered roles.

method.zh: 按失败角色隔离重启，用生成侧状态作训练热备，并通过动态UCX点对点通信恢复权重同步。
method.en: RobustRL performs role-specific recovery, uses rollout-held state as trainer warm standbys and reconnects roles through dynamic UCX point-to-point communication.

result.zh: 作者在256GPU故障注入实验中报告ETTR超过80%，端到端训练时间缩短8.4%至17.4%。
result.en: In a 256-GPU failure-injection evaluation, the authors report ETTR above 80% and 8.4–17.4% shorter end-to-end training time.

2512.22492.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

rollart.title_zh: RollArt：大规模分离式多任务智能体RL训练

background.zh: 多任务智能体RL同时执行生成、环境交互、奖励和训练，各阶段的硬件需求及完成时间差异显著。
background.en: Multi-task agentic RL combines generation, environment interaction, reward scoring and training, whose hardware needs and completion times vary substantially.

challenge.zh: 慢环境和任务长尾会阻塞统一流水，把所有组件放在相同资源上也容易造成浪费。
challenge.en: Slow environments and trajectory stragglers can block shared pipelines, while homogeneous placement wastes resources across stages with different requirements.
