method.zh: 按硬件亲和性分离各阶段，以轨迹为单位独立推进，结合无服务器奖励与有界陈旧度权重同步。
method.en: RollArt disaggregates stages by hardware affinity, advances trajectories independently and combines serverless rewards with staleness-bounded asynchronous weight synchronization.

result.zh: 作者报告训练时间降低1.31至2.05倍，并在超过3000张GPU的生产MoE训练中验证扩展性。
result.en: The authors report 1.31–2.05-fold training-time reductions and demonstrate scalability in production MoE training involving more than three thousand GPUs.

2605.06534.title_zh: ROSE：借用在线服务GPU的协同弹性RL

background.zh: 在线服务集群存在可借用容量，而智能体RL需要大量rollout算力，可通过共享资源降低训练成本。
background.en: Online serving clusters contain opportunistic capacity, while agentic RL demands substantial rollout computation that could benefit from cooperative sharing.

challenge.zh: 借用资源必须保护线上SLO，并处理异构模型的显存竞争、跨集群权重同步和机会容量变化。
challenge.en: Borrowing capacity must protect serving SLOs while handling heterogeneous model memory demands, cross-cluster weight synchronization and changing resource availability.

method.zh: 结合SLO安全共置、分片与稀疏感知权重传输，以及在专用和服务GPU间动态路由的生成调度。
method.en: ROSE combines SLO-safe colocation, shard-aware sparse weight transfer and elastic routing of rollouts across dedicated and opportunistic serving GPUs.

result.zh: 作者报告较固定资源基线吞吐提升1.3至3.3倍，实验中未出现线上服务SLO违约。
result.en: The authors report 1.3–3.3 times higher throughput than fixed-resource baselines, with no serving SLO violations in their evaluations.

2605.06534.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

spotcheck.title_zh: SpotCheck：基于竞价实例构建衍生IaaS云

background.zh: 竞价云实例价格低但随时可能被回收，交互应用通常难以直接承受由此带来的服务中断。
background.en: Spot instances offer lower prices but can be revoked, making them difficult to use directly for applications requiring continuous availability.

challenge.zh: 若要提供接近按需实例的可用性，系统需要在回收期限内保留状态，并平衡风险与迁移成本。
challenge.en: Providing near-on-demand availability requires preserving machine state within revocation deadlines while balancing migration overhead against cost and availability risks.

method.zh: 用嵌套虚拟机、有界时间在线迁移和服务器池管理，为用户屏蔽底层竞价实例的不稳定性。
method.en: SpotCheck combines nested virtual machines, bounded-time live migration and server-pool management to hide underlying spot-instance revocations from applications.

result.zh: 作者在EC2上报告99.9989%的虚拟机可用性和接近五倍成本节省，结论依赖对应回收与迁移条件。
result.en: The EC2 evaluation reports 99.9989% virtual-machine availability and nearly fivefold cost savings under the paper's revocation and migration conditions.

2601.09083.title_zh: SRT：基于树状缓存的投机Rollout加速

background.zh: 强化学习多次针对相同提示生成回答，相邻训练步的延续常有相似性，可为投机解码提供草稿。
background.en: Reinforcement learning repeatedly generates responses for the same prompts, and similar continuations across updates can provide useful speculative drafts.

challenge.zh: 历史草稿会随策略更新陈旧，缓存既要保持高命中率，也不能改变当前策略的生成分布。
challenge.en: Historical drafts become stale as policies change, so caching must maintain useful predictions without changing the current policy's sampling distribution.

method.zh: 为每个提示维护树状延续缓存，随rollout更新树，并在GPU空隙提前生成后续草稿。
method.en: SRT maintains per-prompt continuation trees, updates them from ongoing rollouts and performs run-ahead generation during otherwise idle GPU periods.

result.zh: 作者在PPO、GRPO、DAPO及多轮设置中报告最高2.08倍rollout加速，并保持目标分布正确性。
result.en: Across PPO, GRPO, DAPO and multi-turn settings, the authors report rollout speedups up to 2.08 times while preserving distributional correctness.

2601.09083.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2601.12784.title_zh: StaleFlow：缓解分离式RL数据偏斜的陈旧度感知管理

background.zh: 完全分离的RL系统可以提高并行度，但轨迹生成长尾和持续策略更新同时带来偏斜与数据陈旧。
background.en: Fully disaggregated RL increases parallelism, but long-tailed trajectory generation and continuing policy updates create both workload skew and stale data.

challenge.zh: 仅追求吞吐可能让过旧轨迹进入训练，过强全局同步又会重新引入等待和资源闲置。
challenge.en: Optimizing throughput alone may admit excessively stale trajectories, whereas strong global synchronization reintroduces waiting and underutilized resources.

method.zh: 用全局一致性协议追踪轨迹生命周期，建立轨迹与参数数据服务器，并实施陈旧度感知协调策略。
method.en: StaleFlow tracks trajectory lifecycles with a consistency protocol and coordinates rollout work through trajectory and parameter servers using staleness-aware strategies.

result.zh: 作者报告相对现有系统最高1.42至2.68倍吞吐提升，并在所评测任务中保持收敛表现。
result.en: The authors report peak throughput improvements ranging from 1.42 to 2.68 times over evaluated systems without compromising convergence in their experiments.

venue.name: SIGMOD 2027（作者声明；正式页面未核实）

2601.12784.review_note: arXiv comments 标注 SIGMOD 2027；本次未核实正式会议或期刊论文页面，不按已出版处理。

2610.03286.title_zh: VenusRL：采用优先调度与可扩展交互的解耦智能体训练

background.zh: 多轮智能体 RL 的下一训练步依赖轨迹组完成，环境沙箱又常按内存上限静态预留资源。
background.en: Multi-turn agentic RL waits for complete trajectory groups before training, while tool sandboxes often reserve memory according to conservative declared ceilings.

challenge.zh: 只提高单 GPU 利用率会分散组进度，重复沙箱状态与过度预留也限制环境并发和成本效率。
challenge.en: Optimizing individual GPU utilization can scatter group progress, while duplicated sandbox states and excessive reservations limit environment concurrency and cost efficiency.

method.zh: 跨批准入、KV 驻留及 worker 编排优先推进关键组，并用内存阈值和写时复制页面共享扩展沙箱。
method.en: VenusRL prioritizes groups across admission, KV residency, and workers, while memory-aware admission and copy-on-write page sharing increase sandbox density.

result.zh: 作者在代表性智能体负载上报告最高 4.24 倍端到端训练加速，并将环境成本最多降低 89%。
result.en: The authors report end-to-end training speedups up to 4.24 times on representative agentic workloads and environment-cost reductions up to 89%.

2610.03286.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2608.00881.title_zh: AOSpec：低延迟智能体服务的动作与观察联合推测

background.zh: 智能体在模型生成和有状态工具执行之间反复串行等待，模型加速后工具延迟的重要性进一步上升。
background.en: Agents repeatedly serialize model generation and stateful tool execution, making tool latency increasingly important as language-model decoding becomes faster.

challenge.zh: 仅推测动作或观察难以隐藏长工具调用，而多步推测必须验证动作来源状态以保持串行语义。
challenge.en: Speculating only actions or observations leaves expensive calls exposed, while longer lookahead must validate the action's originating state to preserve serial semantics.

method.zh: 框架按预期延迟收益推测观察，在隔离分支执行关键动作，并联合验证动作与原始状态后复用结果。
method.en: The framework prioritizes observation speculation by expected latency benefit, executes critical actions in isolated forks, and verifies both actions and originating states before reuse.

result.zh: 多种智能体框架与模型的评估显示平均和尾部延迟下降，同时通过验证机制保持提交执行的语义。
result.en: Evaluations across multiple harnesses and models show reduced average and tail latency while verification preserves the semantics of committed agent execution.

2609.18849.title_zh: 询问工具而非猜测：用执行进度指导智能体服务

background.zh: 智能体等待工具时仍需管理上下文缓存，而工具内部往往已经持有反映剩余执行工作的进度信息。
background.en: Agents need context-cache management while waiting for tools, and running tools often already expose information about their remaining execution progress.

challenge.zh: 工具启动前的时长估计无法准确适应运行中变化，容易造成缓存驻留与预取决策失误。
challenge.en: Duration estimates fixed before tool execution cannot reliably adapt to runtime variation, leading to poor cache-residency and prefetching decisions.

method.zh: 论文为工具执行暴露工作进度与临近结束信号，将这些实时提示接入缓存保留和恢复策略。
method.en: The paper exposes work-progress and near-completion signals from running tools and integrates these runtime hints into cache retention and restoration policies.

result.zh: 公开智能体语料分析与服务实验显示进度信号更准确，并降低工具返回后的尾部首标记延迟。
result.en: Analysis of public agent corpora and serving experiments shows more accurate progress information and lower tail time-to-first-token after tool completion.

2507.01663.title_zh: AsyncFlow：用于高效语言模型后训练的异步流式强化学习框架

background.zh: 语言模型强化学习包含生成、奖励与训练等阶段，需要高效传递数据并协调不同执行引擎。
background.en: Language-model reinforcement learning contains generation, reward, and training stages that require efficient data transfer and coordination across different execution engines.

challenge.zh: 阶段分离后的复杂数据流和资源空闲会限制扩展，而紧耦合引擎接口又妨碍定制后端。
challenge.en: Complex dataflow and idle resources limit scalability after task separation, while tightly coupled engine interfaces make it difficult to support customized backends.

method.zh: 框架以分布式流式存储与传输连接各阶段，并通过受陈旧度约束的异步生产消费流程重叠执行。
method.en: The framework connects stages through distributed streaming storage and transfer, overlapping execution with an asynchronous producer-consumer workflow constrained by data staleness.

result.zh: 作者报告相较已有系统更高的平均吞吐，并展示流式数据层与训练、推理引擎解耦的能力。
result.en: The authors report higher average throughput than existing systems and demonstrate a streaming data layer decoupled from the underlying training and inference engines.

2405.16444.title_zh: CacheBlend：通过缓存知识融合加速检索增强语言模型服务

background.zh: 检索增强生成经常重复使用多个文本片段，预先计算其键值缓存有望降低长输入的预填充成本。
background.en: Retrieval-augmented generation repeatedly uses multiple text chunks, creating opportunities to reduce long-input prefill costs by reusing their precomputed key-value caches.

challenge.zh: 非前缀片段的缓存缺少与此前文本的交互，直接拼接无法重现完整上下文中的注意力表示。
challenge.en: Caches for non-prefix chunks omit interactions with preceding text, so directly concatenating them cannot reproduce attention representations computed in the full context.

method.zh: 方法复用各片段缓存，选择性重算少量标记修正跨片段交互，并将重算与缓存读取流水重叠。
method.en: The method reuses chunk caches, selectively recomputes a small token subset to restore cross-chunk interactions, and pipelines recomputation with cache retrieval.

result.zh: 多个语言模型与任务基准显示首标记延迟降低、吞吐提升，作者报告评估中的生成质量得到保持。
result.en: Evaluations across multiple language models and task benchmarks show lower first-token latency and higher throughput, with generation quality maintained in the reported experiments.

2601.22705.title_zh: CONCUR：通过拥塞控制提升智能体批量推理吞吐

background.zh: 长时间运行的智能体不断积累上下文缓存，使批量推理的资源压力随执行过程逐渐变化。
background.en: Long-running agents accumulate context caches over time, causing resource pressure during batch inference to evolve throughout the execution of agent workloads.

challenge.zh: 缓存尚未完全耗尽前就可能出现中期抖动，单纯反应式的请求级缓存管理难以避免吞吐崩溃。
challenge.en: Middle-phase thrashing can occur before cache capacity is exhausted, making purely reactive request-level cache management insufficient to prevent severe throughput degradation.

method.zh: 系统将缓存视作共享拥塞资源，根据运行时缓存反馈动态调节活跃智能体数量并控制准入。
method.en: The system treats cache capacity as a shared congestible resource and dynamically regulates active-agent counts through admission control driven by runtime cache feedback.

result.zh: 多个模型和真实智能体负载显示抖动得到抑制、吞吐提高，控制层可与已有语言模型服务引擎结合。
result.en: Evaluations across models and real agent workloads show reduced thrashing and higher throughput, with the control layer remaining compatible with existing serving engines.

2410.01228.title_zh: ConServe：细粒度回收 GPU 空隙以共同服务在线与离线任务

background.zh: 在线语言模型请求要求低延迟，离线推理任务则更重视吞吐，两者具有可互补的服务需求。
background.en: Online language-model requests require low latency, while offline inference prioritizes throughput, creating complementary opportunities for sharing the same GPU resources.

challenge.zh: 请求级或迭代级调度过粗，难以利用毫秒级空隙而不干扰在线请求的延迟目标。
challenge.en: Request-level or iteration-level scheduling is too coarse to exploit millisecond-scale idle periods without interfering with latency objectives for online requests.

method.zh: 系统结合延迟感知的标记调度、层级抢占和增量缓存管理，让离线执行及时让出在线请求所需资源。
method.en: The system combines latency-aware token scheduling, layer-wise preemption, and incremental cache management so offline execution can promptly yield resources to online requests.

result.zh: 真实工作负载评估显示整体吞吐提高且在线尾延迟降低，验证细粒度抢占与缓存恢复的联合收益。
result.en: Real-workload evaluations show higher overall throughput and lower online tail latency, validating the combined benefits of fine-grained preemption and efficient cache restoration.

2609.31551.title_zh: EAServe：编码感知的多模态语言模型分离式服务

background.zh: 多模态模型在预填充和解码之前还需编码图像、视频或音频，形成具有不同资源需求的三阶段流水线。
background.en: Multimodal models encode images, video, or audio before prefill and decode, creating a three-stage pipeline with distinct resource demands.

challenge.zh: 编码设备利用不足可能让下游缺少输入，而单纯拆分编码服务不能自动调节请求流量与设备共享。
challenge.en: Underutilized encoding devices can starve downstream workers, and simply separating encoding does not automatically regulate request flow or coordinate device sharing.

method.zh: 系统以编码阶段控制微批次、部分预填充卸载和动态计算单元分区，再搜索联合资源配置。
method.en: The system uses encoding to control microbatching, partial prefill offload, and dynamic compute-unit partitioning, then searches jointly over resource configurations.

result.zh: 图像、视频和音频模型评估显示相同服务目标下更高有效吞吐，并改善流水线负载平衡与配置搜索效率。
result.en: Evaluations across image, video, and audio models report higher goodput under identical service objectives, with improved pipeline balance and configuration-search efficiency.

2610.19822.title_zh: JointServe：显存受限GPU上的多模型智能体服务

background.zh: 多模型智能体调用不同专家权重，而边缘GPU通常无法让所有模型和会话缓存同时驻留。
background.en: Multi-model agents invoke experts with different weights, while edge GPUs cannot keep all model weights and active session caches resident.

challenge.zh: 整模型换入换出延长会话，并与活跃KV缓存争用有限显存及主机与GPU之间的带宽。
challenge.en: Whole-model swapping delays sessions and competes with live KV caches for limited GPU memory and host-to-device transfer bandwidth.

method.zh: 统一管理权重分片和KV预算，结合调用意图预取、部分层驻留及可抢占传输调度。
method.en: JointServe combines unified weight and KV budgeting, intent-driven prefetching, partial layer residency and preemptive transfer scheduling with bandwidth guarantees.

result.zh: 作者报告较最强整模型交换基线缩短会话时间21.7%，并改善重放工作负载的SLO达成率。
result.en: The authors report 21.7% shorter session completion time than the strongest whole-model swapping baseline and improved SLO attainment on replayed workloads.

2610.19822.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2609.03335.title_zh: 异构GPU上的多智能体工作流时延感知编排

background.zh: 智能体工作流暴露未来任务依赖，而异构GPU池的负载、模型驻留和资源状态持续变化。
background.en: Concurrent agent workflows reveal future dependencies while heterogeneous GPU pools continuously change their load, model residency and available resources.

challenge.zh: 逻辑执行图不能直接确定高效物理方案，模型加载开销和依赖就绪时间也影响调度。
challenge.en: Logical execution graphs alone cannot determine efficient physical plans, because model-loading costs and dependency readiness affect downstream scheduling decisions.

method.zh: 预测算子和加载成本，构造保持语义的融合与生命周期方案，再联合选择放置和执行次序。
method.en: The system predicts operator and loading costs, constructs semantics-preserving fusion and lifecycle alternatives, then jointly selects placement and execution order.

result.zh: 作者报告完成总时长与突发负载p95延迟最高分别降低36.8%和25.9%，并减少GPU时间。
result.en: The authors report reductions up to 36.8% in makespan and 25.9% in burst-load p95 completion latency, alongside lower GPU-time consumption.

2609.03335.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2507.07966.title_zh: 将强化学习扩展到长视频

background.zh: 长视频理解要求VLM跨大量帧进行推理，训练数据、强化学习流程和基础设施都需要扩展。
background.en: Long-video understanding requires vision-language models to reason across many frames, demanding coordinated improvements in data, reinforcement-learning methods and systems.

challenge.zh: 长视觉上下文增大预处理、缓存及序列计算开销，普通RL实现难以容纳小时级视频训练。
challenge.en: Large visual contexts increase preprocessing, caching and sequence-computation costs, making hour-long video training difficult to support in conventional RL implementations.

method.zh: 结合LongVideo-Reason数据、两阶段训练和MR-SP系统，复用视频嵌入并支持长序列并行。
method.en: The framework combines LongVideo-Reason data, two-stage training and MR-SP infrastructure with visual embedding reuse and long-sequence parallel processing.

result.zh: 作者报告长视频RL训练最高2.1倍加速，单个八卡A100节点支持约3600帧的小时级视频。
result.en: The authors report up to 2.1 times faster long-video RL training and support for approximately 3,600-frame videos on eight A100 GPUs.

2606.12688.title_zh: M*：模块化可扩展多模态模型服务

background.zh: 复合多模态模型包含视觉编码器、语言骨干、扩散头和动作模块，执行流程日益复杂。
background.en: Composite multimodal models integrate vision encoders, language backbones, diffusion heads and action generators, creating increasingly complex serving workflows.

challenge.zh: 固定线性服务流水难以表达循环与动态组件调用，模型开发者也要承担大量分布式运行负担。
challenge.en: Fixed linear pipelines struggle with loops and dynamic component calls, while model developers must otherwise implement substantial distributed-runtime machinery.

method.zh: 用Walk Graph描述复合模型的数据流和控制流，在分布式运行时组合模块、放置与传输机制。
method.en: M* describes model dataflow and control flow with Walk Graphs, composing component placement and communication within a modular distributed runtime.

result.zh: 作者报告BAGEL文生图平均时延比vLLM-Omni低20%，并在语音和机器人规划中展示收益。
result.en: The authors report 20% lower average BAGEL text-to-image latency than vLLM-Omni, with additional gains in speech generation and robotic planning.

venue.name: arXiv 预印本；未核实正式发表

2609.32395.title_zh: 让记忆成为缓存：构造性精确复用与删除

background.zh: 标准Transformer的每个KV表示都依赖此前整个前缀，限制上下文块的独立复用和删除。
background.en: Standard Transformer KV representations depend on their entire preceding context, limiting the independent reuse and deletion of cached memory blocks.

challenge.zh: 改变前缀或删除中间内容会使后续表示失效，单纯保留旧KV不能保证精确上下文结果。
challenge.en: Changing prefixes or removing intermediate passages invalidates downstream representations, so retaining previous KV tensors alone cannot guarantee exact contextual computation.

method.zh: SMem用块内编码器独立构造记忆，再以cross-attention读取记忆集合，移除跨块前缀纠缠。
method.en: SMem independently encodes memory blocks and reads their collection through cross-attention, removing cross-block prefix entanglement by architectural construction.

result.zh: 作者在160M至1.5B模型上报告可比较的困惑度与精确可编辑缓存，并分析长记忆下的成本。
result.en: Experiments on 160-million- to 1.5-billion-parameter models report comparable perplexity and exactly editable caches, alongside cost analyses for extended memory.

venue.name: arXiv 预印本；未核实正式发表

2609.32395.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2407.00079.title_zh: Mooncake：以KV缓存为中心的分离式服务架构

background.zh: 大模型长上下文服务需要兼顾首token时延、持续解码速度和高并发下的资源利用效率。
background.en: Long-context language-model serving must balance first-token latency, decoding performance and efficient resource use under high concurrent demand.

challenge.zh: 预填充与解码的资源需求不同，过载请求还会争夺KV容量并降低其他请求的服务质量。
challenge.en: Prefill and decoding have different resource requirements, while overloaded requests compete for KV capacity and degrade other requests' service quality.

method.zh: 分离prefill和decode集群，利用CPU内存及SSD组织分层KV缓存，并结合缓存感知调度和提前拒收。
method.en: Mooncake separates prefill and decoding clusters, organizes tiered KV storage and combines cache-aware scheduling with prediction-based early rejection.

result.zh: 作者报告生产负载下Kimi可处理的请求增加75%，其他吞吐收益对应论文的特定模拟场景。
result.en: The authors report that Kimi handles 75% more requests under production workloads, with additional throughput gains measured in specific simulated scenarios.

2603.18897.title_zh: PASTE：并行工具执行与语言生成的智能体服务

background.zh: LLM智能体通常在文本生成与工具调用之间串行切换，使工具延迟直接进入任务关键路径。
background.en: Language-model agents typically serialize model generation and tool execution, exposing tool delays directly on the task's critical path.

challenge.zh: 提前执行未知工具调用可能产生错误结果或副作用，还可能把隐藏的等待转化成GPU拥塞。
challenge.en: Premature tool execution can produce incorrect speculative results, while indiscriminate overlap may merely shift the bottleneck back to GPU serving.

method.zh: 从重复智能体模式预测具体调用并投机执行，结果确认后才交付，同时联合调度工具和返回会话。
method.en: PASTE predicts concrete calls from recurring patterns, isolates speculative results until confirmation and jointly schedules tools and returning model sessions.

result.zh: 作者在研究、编码与科学智能体负载中报告平均任务时间降低43.5%，观察到的工具延迟降至约原来的1/1.8。
result.en: Across research, coding and scientific-agent workloads, the authors report 43.5% lower average task completion time and observed tool latency reduced to approximately 1/1.8 of the baseline.

venue.name: arXiv 预印本；未核实正式发表

2505.04021.title_zh: Prism：通过GPU显存弹性分配降低多模型服务成本

background.zh: 多模型服务的活跃模型集合随时间成组变化，固定显存划分难以同时满足效率与服务约束。
background.en: Multi-model serving experiences shifting bursts of jointly active models, making fixed memory partitions inefficient under changing service-level requirements.

challenge.zh: 独立的空间共享或时间共享机制不能灵活适应突发模型组，权重和KV空间需要动态回收。
challenge.en: Separate spatial-sharing and temporal-sharing mechanisms cannot flexibly accommodate bursty model groups whose weights and KV caches compete for capacity.

method.zh: 以GPU memory ballooning统一两种共享方式，kvcached分离虚拟地址与物理分配并调整模型间内存。
method.en: Prism uses GPU memory ballooning to unify spatial and temporal sharing, dynamically reclaiming and reallocating physical memory across models.

result.zh: 论文公开kvcached驱动，并报告相关机制已部署到超过一万张GPU的生产环境。
result.en: The paper releases the kvcached balloon driver and reports production deployment of the underlying mechanisms across more than ten thousand GPUs.

2509.24381.title_zh: RServe：重叠编码与预填充的高效多模态推理

background.zh: 多模态大模型请求需要先进行视觉等模态编码，再由语言骨干处理生成所需的上下文。
background.en: Multimodal requests require modality encoding before language-backbone computation, creating opportunities to overlap work within and across requests.

challenge.zh: 把完整编码和语言预填充串行执行暴露等待，而仅跨请求流水又可能形成microbatch负载失衡。
challenge.en: Serializing complete encoding and prefill exposes waiting, while inter-request pipelining alone can leave microbatches computationally imbalanced.

method.zh: 分离编码器与语言模型，按细粒度编码就绪推进单请求，并用可调度token预算协调请求间流水。
method.en: RServe disaggregates encoders and language models, advancing ready tokens within requests and coordinating cross-request pipelines through schedulable-token budgets.

result.zh: 作者报告代表性多模态模型时延最高降低66%、吞吐最高提高109%，名称在摘要中亦写作REDServe。
result.en: The authors report up to 66% lower latency and 109% higher throughput on evaluated multimodal models; the abstract also names the system REDServe.

2610.15186.title_zh: SAFE-KV：保持行为的非前缀缓存复用与后缀修复

background.zh: 检索增强生成希望复用已编码文档，但不同文档上下文会改变后续KV状态，影响最终回答。
background.en: Retrieval-augmented generation aims to reuse encoded documents, but changed document contexts alter downstream KV states and can change generated answers.

challenge.zh: 只修复被插入文档或固定窗口不能消除更后方状态中的旧历史，精确恢复可能需要重算大部分上下文。
challenge.en: Repairing only inserted documents or fixed windows leaves stale histories elsewhere, and faithful recovery may require recomputing most of the context.

method.zh: 以完整prefill为参考，从选定文档边界重编码因果后缀，并用风险引导规则选择修复范围。
method.en: SAFE-KV re-encodes causal suffixes from selected document boundaries, using full prefill as the behavioral reference and risk-guided repair selection.

result.zh: 作者在两项问答测试恢复约98%至100%的答案行为，但单请求L40S实验中的运行规则退回完整prefill。
result.en: The authors recover approximately 98–100% answer agreement in evaluated settings, but their single-request L40S operating rule falls back to full prefill.

venue.name: Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026（作者声明已接收）

2312.07104.title_zh: SGLang：高效执行结构化语言模型程序

background.zh: 智能体、检索增强生成和多轮对话把多次语言模型调用组织成结构化程序，而非单次独立请求。
background.en: Agents, retrieval-augmented generation and conversations organize multiple model calls into structured programs rather than independent one-shot requests.

challenge.zh: 复杂控制流与共享前缀会造成重复计算，约束输出解码也可能引入额外的逐token执行开销。
challenge.en: Complex control flow and shared prefixes create redundant computation, while constrained output decoding can add substantial per-token execution overhead.

method.zh: 以前端语言表达生成和并行控制，运行时用RadixAttention共享KV，并以压缩状态机加速结构化输出。
method.en: SGLang combines a generation-control frontend with RadixAttention for KV reuse and compressed finite-state machines for structured output decoding.

result.zh: 作者在语言与多模态工作负载上报告最高6.4倍吞吐提升，覆盖智能体、JSON解码和多轮任务。
result.en: The authors report up to 6.4 times higher throughput across language and multimodal workloads including agent control, JSON decoding and multi-turn interaction.

2311.15566.title_zh: SpotServe：在可抢占实例上服务生成式大模型

background.zh: 可抢占GPU有成本优势，但大模型推理持有权重、KV和生成进度，不能简单视作无状态任务。
background.en: Preemptible GPUs reduce serving costs, but language-model inference carries weights, KV caches and generation progress that must survive resource changes.

challenge.zh: 实例数量变化要求重新选择模型并行配置，状态搬迁与回收后的恢复还会放大尾延迟。
challenge.en: Changing instance counts require new parallel configurations, while state migration and recovery overhead can substantially increase request tail latency.

method.zh: 动态重并行，用二分图匹配减少迁移通信，并利用回收预告期保存细粒度推理进度。
method.en: SpotServe dynamically selects parallelism, minimizes migration communication through bipartite matching and uses revocation grace periods to preserve fine-grained inference progress.

result.zh: 作者在真实回收轨迹上报告p99时延比基线改善2.4至9.1倍，较纯按需实例节省54%成本。
result.en: Evaluations using real revocation traces report 2.4–9.1-fold improvements in p99 latency and 54% lower monetary cost than on-demand-only serving.

2510.18586.title_zh: TokenCake：面向多智能体应用的 KV 缓存中心服务框架

background.zh: 多智能体应用包含耗时外部函数调用，等待中的缓存占据显存，关键路径智能体又可能被驱逐。
background.en: Multi-agent applications make slow external calls, leaving idle caches in GPU memory while caches belonging to critical-path agents may be evicted.

challenge.zh: 需要同时安排缓存的时间卸载与空间保留，既隐藏传输延迟，又避免关键智能体缺少驻留容量。
challenge.en: The system must coordinate when caches are offloaded and where memory is reserved, hiding transfers while protecting critical agents from capacity shortages.

method.zh: 在函数等待时机会式卸载并预测上传，通过结合图结构与运行状态的优先级动态划分显存。
method.en: TokenCake opportunistically offloads caches during function calls, predicts uploads, and partitions memory using priorities derived from graph structure and runtime state.

result.zh: 作者在显存受限多智能体测试中报告最高 47.06% 延迟降低，并相对 vLLM 改善有效 GPU 利用率。
result.en: In memory-constrained multi-agent evaluations, the authors report latency reductions up to 47.06% and improved effective GPU utilization compared with vLLM.

2510.18586.review_note: 四句依据原始摘要；EuroSys2027接收状态来自作者官方仓库，尚未核验正式论文集。

2309.06180.title_zh: PagedAttention：用于大语言模型服务的高效显存管理

background.zh: LLM 服务吞吐依赖足够大的请求批次，但动态增长的 KV 缓存占用大量显存并容易造成碎片。
background.en: LLM serving throughput depends on sufficiently large request batches, while dynamically growing KV caches consume substantial memory and create allocation fragmentation.

challenge.zh: 连续分配与重复复制限制可服务请求数，需要让缓存灵活增长并支持跨请求共享而不浪费容量。
challenge.en: Contiguous allocation and redundant duplication limit concurrency, requiring flexible cache growth and sharing across requests without wasting available memory capacity.

method.zh: 借鉴操作系统分页，将 KV 缓存分块映射，以 PagedAttention 执行非连续注意力并构建 vLLM 服务系统。
method.en: PagedAttention maps KV caches into noncontiguous blocks inspired by operating-system paging, enabling flexible sharing in the vLLM serving system.

result.zh: 作者报告在相近延迟下吞吐为所比较系统的二至四倍，长序列、大模型和复杂解码的收益更明显。
result.en: The authors report twofold to fourfold throughput at comparable latency, with greater benefits for longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding.

2309.06180.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2610.09307.title_zh: vLLM-Omni 技术报告：统一的全模态生成服务运行时

background.zh: 语音、图像、视频和机器人动作生成需要不同执行引擎，服务形态也从文本解码扩展为多阶段交互流程。
background.en: Speech, image, video, and robot-action generation require different execution engines, expanding serving beyond text decoding into heterogeneous multistage interactive workflows.

challenge.zh: 独立推理栈缺少统一请求控制，跨阶段大数据传输、流式输出与长时会话状态难以协调管理。
challenge.en: Separate inference stacks lack shared request control, making it difficult to coordinate large cross-stage payloads, streaming outputs, and long-lived session state.

method.zh: 运行时以统一编排器连接专用阶段引擎与副本池，通过独立数据通路传输负载并提供会话控制接口。
method.en: The runtime connects specialized stage engines and replica pools through a shared orchestrator, separating payload transfer from session-oriented request control.

result.zh: 报告展示多模态和机器人等接口支持，并以持续集成与重点模型实验验证统一运行时的功能及效率。
result.en: The report demonstrates interfaces for multimodal and robot workloads and uses continuous-integration testing and focused model evaluations to assess runtime functionality and efficiency.

2604.09073.title_zh: DRIFT：利用固有容错性实现高效可靠扩散推理

background.zh: 扩散推理具有较高延迟和能耗，设备电压与频率调节提供了降低成本或提升速度的机会。
background.en: Diffusion inference incurs substantial latency and energy consumption, creating opportunities to reduce costs or increase speed through accelerator voltage and frequency control.

challenge.zh: 不同网络模块和时间步对硬件错误敏感程度不同，统一调节可能收益有限或破坏生成质量。
challenge.en: Network blocks and timesteps differ in their sensitivity to hardware errors, so uniform adjustment may provide limited gains or damage generation quality.

method.zh: 框架先分析模型韧性，再按敏感度调节电压频率，并用自适应回滚纠正关键错误及优化状态保存。
method.en: The framework analyzes model resilience, adjusts voltage and frequency according to sensitivity, and uses adaptive rollback to correct critical errors while optimizing saved state.

result.zh: 多模型数据集实验报告节能或超频加速收益，并在所评估配置中维持生成质量与可靠性。
result.en: Experiments across models and datasets report energy savings or overclocking speedups while maintaining generation quality and reliability in the evaluated configurations.

2604.04335.title_zh: GENSERVE：异构扩散模型工作负载的高效协同服务

background.zh: 图像与视频生成平台需要在共享 GPU 集群上同时服务不同模态，并满足各自的延迟目标。
background.en: Image and video generation platforms share GPU clusters while serving requests with different latency targets.

challenge.zh: 图像和视频请求的计算量、并行收益和延迟要求差异很大，现有共用资源方式容易违反服务目标。
challenge.en: Large differences in compute demand, useful parallelism and deadlines make conventional resource sharing violate latency objectives.

method.zh: 利用扩散步边界的可预测性与可抢占性，联动视频抢占、弹性序列并行、动态批处理和 SLO 调度。
method.en: GENSERVE coordinates video preemption, elastic sequence parallelism, dynamic batching and SLO scheduling at predictable diffusion-step boundaries.

result.zh: 论文在多种配置下报告，相比最强比较基线，SLO 达成率的提升最高为 44%。
result.en: Across the evaluated configurations, the paper reports up to 44% improvement in SLO attainment over its strongest baseline.

2509.04719.title_zh: 异构多GPU扩散推理的时空并行

background.zh: 扩散模型推理成本高，多GPU并行可以加速生成，但实际集群经常包含不同速度的设备。
background.en: Diffusion inference is expensive, and multi-GPU execution must often operate across devices with substantially different processing capabilities.

challenge.zh: 均匀patch划分和统一进度让慢设备成为同步瓶颈，使同构集群方案在异构场景下利用率下降。
challenge.en: Uniform patch assignments and synchronized progress make slower devices bottlenecks, reducing the efficiency of approaches designed for homogeneous clusters.

method.zh: Orchestra组合非均匀patch分配与时间维适应，另提供保持固定步数的纯空间适应消融。
method.en: Orchestra combines nonuniform spatial patch allocation with temporal adaptation, and separately evaluates spatial adaptation while keeping denoising-step counts fixed.

result.zh: 作者报告相对patch并行最高45%的端到端时延下降，完整方案的收益包含时间步调整。
result.en: The authors report up to 45% lower end-to-end latency than patch parallelism; full-system results also include temporal step adaptation.

2503.06923.title_zh: TaylorSeer：从复用转向预测的扩散加速

background.zh: 特征缓存利用扩散相邻步的重复性，但间隔拉大后直接沿用旧特征会显著增加近似误差。
background.en: Feature caching exploits repetition across diffusion steps, but directly reusing old features introduces growing approximation error as skipped intervals become longer.

challenge.zh: 需要利用特征连续变化规律预测未来状态，使较高加速倍率下仍能维持可接受的生成质量。
challenge.en: Higher acceleration ratios require predicting how features evolve, rather than assuming they remain unchanged across increasingly distant sampling steps.

method.zh: 由历史特征差分近似高阶导数，通过泰勒展开预测后续时间步特征，以替代部分完整前向计算。
method.en: TaylorSeer estimates higher-order feature derivatives from historical differences and uses Taylor expansions to forecast features for subsequent denoising steps.

result.zh: 作者在 FLUX 和 HunyuanVideo 上报告约五倍加速且测试质量变化较小，但其本质仍为近似预测。
result.en: The authors report roughly fivefold acceleration on FLUX and HunyuanVideo with small measured quality changes, while the method remains an approximate prediction scheme.

2503.06923.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2606.10135.title_zh: BiWM：通过双向自回归推进开源交互视频世界模型

background.zh: 预训练双向视频生成模型具有丰富生成能力，但改造成低延迟可控世界模型通常需要复杂训练流程。
background.en: Pretrained bidirectional video generators provide strong visual capabilities, but converting them into low-latency controllable world models typically requires complex training pipelines.

challenge.zh: 冻结的因果历史容易累积误差，繁多训练阶段也增加复现成本，并可能损害场景动态表现。
challenge.en: Frozen causal histories accumulate errors, while numerous training stages increase reproducibility costs and can degrade the dynamics of generated scenes.

method.zh: 框架保留片段内部全注意力，仅结合控制微调与少步分布匹配蒸馏，并加入监督及前向散度锚定。
method.en: The framework retains full attention within chunks, combining control fine-tuning and few-step distribution-matching distillation with supervised and forward-divergence anchoring objectives.

result.zh: 作者在多个公开视频骨干上展示可控交互生成，为复现双向自回归世界模型提供较精简的训练流程。
result.en: The authors demonstrate controllable interactive generation across several open video backbones, providing a comparatively compact training pipeline for reproducible bidirectional autoregressive world models.

2609.32540.title_zh: FlashForward：利用在线缓存与干净锚点加速自回归视频扩散

background.zh: 自回归视频扩散逐片段生成内容，常需额外模型前向构建历史缓存，增加低步数推理的固定开销。
background.en: Autoregressive video diffusion generates temporal chunks sequentially and often performs extra forwards to construct history caches, adding overhead to few-step inference.

challenge.zh: 直接复用去噪中缓存能够提前释放流水机会，但含噪历史会导致跨片段的外观和运动漂移。
challenge.en: Reusing caches produced during denoising enables earlier pipelining, but noisy historical states can cause appearance and motion drift between generated chunks.

method.zh: 方法复用分阶段在线键值缓存，并提前生成稀疏干净锚点，在多设备上重叠不同片段的去噪阶段。
method.en: The method reuses stage-specific in-flight key-value caches, generates sparse clean anchors in advance, and overlaps denoising stages for different chunks across devices.

result.zh: 多个规模和分辨率的视频模型评估显示生成加速，干净锚点在实验中改善长视频质量与时间一致性。
result.en: Evaluations across model sizes and resolutions show faster generation, with clean anchors improving long-video quality and temporal consistency in the reported experiments.

2602.10825.title_zh: FlowCache：自回归视频生成的流缓存

background.zh: 自回归视频模型通过连续生成片段扩展视频长度，但逐片段反复去噪使长视频生成速度受限。
background.en: Autoregressive video models extend duration by generating chunks sequentially, but repeated chunk-level denoising limits the speed of long-video generation.

challenge.zh: 不同片段在相同时间步的冗余模式并不一致，传统统一缓存策略难以兼顾加速、内存和质量。
challenge.en: Different chunks exhibit different redundancy patterns at identical timesteps, making uniform caching policies unsuitable for balancing speed, memory usage, and output quality.

method.zh: 框架为每个片段独立调整缓存策略，并联合重要性与冗余信息压缩历史键值缓存以限制内存。
method.en: The framework independently adapts caching policies for each chunk and compresses historical key-value caches using both importance and redundancy to bound memory consumption.

result.zh: 作者在两个自回归视频模型上报告明显加速，所评估质量指标变化较小，但方法采用近似缓存复用。
result.en: The authors report substantial speedups on two autoregressive video models with small changes in measured quality, using approximate cache reuse and compression.

2605.09681.title_zh: Forcing-KV：自回归视频扩散的混合键值缓存压缩

background.zh: 流式视频扩散需要读取大量历史键值缓存，长时间生成会受到注意力计算和缓存内存开销限制。
background.en: Streaming video diffusion reads substantial historical key-value state, making long-duration generation limited by attention computation and the memory cost of retained caches.

challenge.zh: 不同注意力头承担画面保真、片段衔接和运动一致性等不同作用，统一裁剪容易损害视频质量。
challenge.en: Attention heads play different roles in visual fidelity, chunk transitions, and motion consistency, making uniform pruning likely to damage generated video quality.

method.zh: 方法按头部功能划分静态与动态类型，分别采用结构化裁剪和基于片段相似性的动态缓存裁剪。
method.en: The method classifies heads by function and applies structured pruning to static heads while dynamically pruning other caches based on segment-wise similarity.

result.zh: 多个分辨率与自回归模型的实验显示缓存减少和生成加速，并在所评估条件下保持较好的视觉质量。
result.en: Experiments across resolutions and autoregressive models show reduced cache usage and faster generation while maintaining strong visual quality under the evaluated conditions.

2610.36729.title_zh: Hy-Nomas：面向自由形式交互的世界生成

background.zh: 交互式世界模型需要连续接受文本和相机控制，并在多轮视频生成中保留历史与动作后果。
background.en: Interactive world models must follow successive text and camera commands while preserving history and action consequences across generated segments.

challenge.zh: 历史描述需要长期可见，而一次动作指令只应作用于目标时间段，混用两者会干扰后续生成。
challenge.en: Descriptive history should remain available, whereas action instructions should affect only their intended time windows across interaction turns.

method.zh: 以 8B 扩散骨干结合动作感知因果注意力、VLM 提示增强、多阶段课程与扩散蒸馏生成可变长片段。
method.en: An 8B diffusion backbone combines action-aware causal attention, VLM prompt enhancement, staged training and diffusion distillation for variable-length segment generation.

result.zh: 论文报告在人类评测中优于所比较世界模型，并公开权重与基准，结果不构成任意交互的实时保证。
result.en: The paper reports better human-evaluation results than compared world models and releases weights and benchmarks, without guaranteeing real-time execution for arbitrary interactions.

2607.07534.title_zh: 具备多样交互的无限世界

background.zh: 交互视频世界模型需要在持续动作和事件驱动下生成一致场景，并支持长期实时用户体验。
background.en: Interactive video world models must maintain coherent scenes under continuous actions and events while providing sustained, real-time user experiences.

challenge.zh: 有限生成时域、推理开销和受限动作类型妨碍持续探索，也限制多角色共享世界的互动。
challenge.en: Limited generation horizons, inference costs and narrow action vocabularies constrain continuous exploration and interactions among multiple participants in shared worlds.

method.zh: LingBot-World2结合因果预训练与蒸馏，加入pilot和director智能体、文本事件及多人接口。
method.en: LingBot-World2 combines causal pretraining and distillation with pilot and director agents, richer text events and a multiplayer interaction interface.

result.zh: 作者提供14B主模型与可单GPU部署的1.3B版本，展示更丰富动作、文本事件和持续交互。
result.en: The authors provide a fourteen-billion-parameter model and a 1.3-billion-parameter single-GPU variant, demonstrating richer actions, textual events and sustained interactive generation.

2607.07534.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2606.05773.title_zh: PiL-World：用于VLA闭环评估的分块世界模型

background.zh: 真实VLA以观察、动作块执行和新观察构成闭环，因此评估模型也需要生成与策略交互的未来。
background.en: Real VLA policies repeatedly observe scenes, execute action chunks and react to new observations, requiring genuinely closed-loop evaluation.

challenge.zh: 沿预先收集动作开放环预测不能反映策略偏移，成功示范数据也未必覆盖真实执行中的失败。
challenge.en: Open-loop prediction along recorded actions cannot represent policy-induced deviations, and successful demonstrations alone may not cover real execution failures.

method.zh: 按动作块生成多视角观察，结合动作派生视觉控制和潜在历史，并使用成功与失败执行轨迹训练。
method.en: PiL-World generates action-chunk-aligned multiview observations using action-derived visual controls, latent history and training trajectories containing both successes and failures.

result.zh: 作者在三项真实双臂任务中把世界模型估计成功率与真机成功率的误差从63.2%降至12.0%。
result.en: Across three real bimanual tasks, the authors reduce the discrepancy between simulated and real policy success rates from 63.2% to 12.0%.

2606.05773.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2609.38597.title_zh: PixelUMM：无需编码器的统一图像视频理解与生成

background.zh: 统一多模态模型常为理解和生成采用不同视觉表示，增加视觉上下文并使两类训练流程难以整合。
background.en: Unified multimodal models often use separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing context length and complicating shared training pipelines.

challenge.zh: 像素空间方法虽能省去视觉编码器或VAE，但扩展到视频时仍需兼顾表示粒度与联合任务性能。
challenge.en: Encoder-free pixel modeling removes separate visual modules, but video extensions must balance token granularity, decoder design and performance across tasks.

method.zh: 将图像patch和视频tubelet线性投影至共享骨干，用共享注意力及任务参数联合文本预测和像素流匹配。
method.en: PixelUMM projects image patches and video tubelets into a shared backbone, combining autoregressive text prediction with pixel-space flow matching.

result.zh: 作者报告图像视频理解与生成的竞争性结果，并通过解码器和时空patch消融分析设计选择。
result.en: The authors report competitive image and video understanding and generation results, supported by decoder and spatial-temporal patch-size ablations.

2609.38597.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2511.07399.title_zh: StreamDiffusionV2：动态交互视频生成的流式系统

background.zh: 生成式直播要求快速首帧、稳定输出节奏和实时交互，多GPU扩展还必须遵守端到端时延约束。
background.en: Generative live streaming requires rapid first frames, stable output pacing and responsive interactions, even when execution is distributed across GPUs.

challenge.zh: 去噪步骤、网络层和KV历史之间的依赖使流水安排复杂，单纯追求吞吐可能造成抖动与延迟。
challenge.en: Dependencies among denoising steps, network layers and KV history complicate pipelining, and throughput-focused execution can introduce jitter or excessive latency.

method.zh: 组合SLO感知batch与block调度、滚动KV和跨步跨层流水，并支持异构GPU与可配置去噪步数。
method.en: StreamDiffusionV2 combines SLO-aware batch and block scheduling, rolling KV management and pipelines across denoising steps and network layers.

result.zh: 作者在四张H100上报告14B模型58.28FPS与0.5秒内首帧，结果未使用TensorRT或量化。
result.en: On four H100 GPUs, the authors report 58.28 FPS for a fourteen-billion-parameter model and first frames within half a second without quantization.

2605.30351.title_zh: VideoMLA：用于分钟级自回归视频的低秩潜变量 KV 缓存

background.zh: 因果视频扩散多使用固定滑窗，但每个注意力头各自存储 KV 仍造成较大的持续显存与访问成本。
background.en: Causal video diffusion often uses fixed sliding windows, yet separate per-head KV storage still creates substantial persistent memory and access costs.

challenge.zh: 直接低秩分解预训练注意力并不充分，需要解释低秩瓶颈为何能经过训练保持视频质量。
challenge.en: A direct low-rank approximation of pretrained attention appears insufficient, requiring an explanation of how training adapts effectively to a compressed bottleneck.

method.zh: 用共享内容潜变量和解耦三维 RoPE 键替换逐头 KV，并研究不同初始化下的有效秩和训练适应。
method.en: VideoMLA replaces per-head KV with shared content latents and decoupled three-dimensional RoPE keys, studying effective rank and adaptation under different initializations.

result.zh: 作者报告每 token KV 减少 92.7%，短时质量相近、长时评测较强，并在单 B200 上提升 1.23 倍吞吐。
result.en: The authors report 92.7% less per-token KV memory, competitive video quality, and 1.23-fold higher throughput on a single B200 GPU.

2605.30351.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2609.34606.title_zh: WorldAttention：交互视频世界模型的高效注意力架构

background.zh: 交互视频世界模型需要长时间保持历史信息，但滑动窗口会遗忘场景，全历史注意力又成本高昂。
background.en: Interactive video world models need long-term history, but sliding windows forget past scenes and full-history attention incurs substantial computational and memory costs.

challenge.zh: 历史缓存增长会耗尽设备内存，单纯稀疏化还需保持全局信息，并将理论收益转化为真实执行效率。
challenge.en: Growing history caches exhaust device memory, while sparsification must preserve global information and translate theoretical savings into practical execution efficiency.

method.zh: 架构融合线性全局与逐头自适应稀疏注意力，以多层缓存组织语义页面，并配套专用执行内核。
method.en: The architecture combines linear global attention with head-adaptive sparse attention, organizes semantic cache pages across memory tiers, and provides specialized execution kernels.

result.zh: 长视频与交互基准报告较好的主体一致性和整体表现，展示注意力结构与缓存管理协同设计的效果。
result.en: Long-video and interaction benchmarks report strong subject consistency and overall performance, demonstrating the benefits of jointly designing attention structure and cache management.

2605.22718.title_zh: WorldKV：通过检索与压缩实现高效世界记忆

background.zh: 自回归视频模型需要在返回旧视角时重现一致场景，而全部保留历史会让实时生成越来越昂贵。
background.en: Autoregressive video models need consistent scenes when revisiting previous viewpoints, but retaining the complete history makes real-time generation increasingly expensive.

challenge.zh: 滑动窗口丢失长期记忆，全缓存注意力又增加存储和计算，因此需要选择性恢复与压缩历史信息。
challenge.en: Sliding windows discard long-term memory, whereas full-cache attention increases storage and computation, motivating selective recovery and compression of historical information.

method.zh: 框架按相机与动作对应关系检索已移出窗口的缓存，并依据关键相似性压缩片段内冗余标记。
method.en: The framework retrieves evicted cache chunks using camera and action correspondence and compresses redundant within-chunk tokens according to key similarity.

result.zh: 两个世界模型评估显示在更高吞吐下维持较好的重访一致性，方法无需额外微调但会改变历史读取。
result.en: Evaluations on two world models show strong revisit consistency at higher throughput, without additional fine-tuning but with changes to historical attention access.

2607.10389.title_zh: WorldMove：交互世界模型的精确状态弹性服务

background.zh: 交互世界模型持有大型持续变化的设备状态，活跃会话难以像无状态请求一样自由迁移和合并。
background.en: Interactive world models retain large, continuously changing device state, making active sessions difficult to migrate and consolidate like ordinary stateless requests.

challenge.zh: 迁移必须兼顾脏数据速率、带宽、校验成本和交互时限，且精确重现依赖受控的设备配置。
challenge.en: Migration must account for dirty-state rates, bandwidth, verification costs, and interaction deadlines, while exact reproduction depends on a controlled hardware configuration.

method.zh: 系统在片段边界迁移并校验完整状态，用准入条件与防汇聚拥塞控制约束传输，辅以无损压缩。
method.en: The system migrates and verifies full state at chunk boundaries, using admissibility conditions, incast-aware admission control, and lossless compression to regulate transport.

result.zh: 作者分别验证状态迁移与服务循环的效果及位级一致性，但明确二者在同一网络上的完整组合尚未实现。
result.en: The authors separately validate migration and serving-loop behavior with bit-identical state, while explicitly noting that their full composition on one fabric remains unimplemented.

2610.35529.title_zh: WorldPager：单消费级 GPU 上的长时世界模型分层内存

background.zh: 世界模型可通过历史缓存保持重访一致性，但长会话会同时触及主机容量与模型位置表示的范围限制。
background.en: World models preserve revisit consistency through historical caches, but long sessions encounter both host-memory capacity limits and the range of learned positional representations.

challenge.zh: 缓存工作集主要受容量而非带宽限制，需要利用提前可知的相机信息隐藏跨层读取并控制内存增长。
challenge.en: Cache working sets are primarily capacity-limited rather than bandwidth-limited, requiring advance camera information to hide tiered-memory reads and bound memory growth.

method.zh: 系统以量化缓存构建设备、主机和存储三级层次，结合姿态预测预取、后台写回与无需训练的位置处理。
method.en: The system stores quantized caches across GPU, host, and storage tiers, combining pose-based prefetching, background writeback, and training-free positional handling.

result.zh: 单消费级设备实验展示长时间稳定生成及恒定主机内存，量化在长间隔重访中仍存在可测质量代价。
result.en: Single-consumer-GPU experiments demonstrate prolonged generation with constant host memory, while quantization still incurs measurable quality costs on revisits after long temporal gaps.

2608.07408.title_zh: WorldTrace：为视频世界模型建立可寻址记忆

background.zh: 视频世界模型依赖历史缓存维持视觉持久性，但运行超出训练长度后可能无法正确读取已有记忆。
background.en: Video world models depend on historical caches for visual persistence, but may lose the ability to retrieve stored information beyond their training horizon.

challenge.zh: 时间位置超出分布会破坏检索，直接混合已经旋转的位置表示还会损坏压缩缓存的相位结构。
challenge.en: Out-of-distribution temporal positions impair retrieval, while directly averaging rotated positional representations can corrupt the phase structure of compressed cached memories.

method.zh: 框架为压缩槽分配训练范围内的独立虚拟位置，并分别构建连续历史压缩和场景转折记忆方案。
method.en: The framework assigns distinct in-distribution virtual positions to compressed slots and develops complementary approaches for continuous-history compression and scene-transition memory.

result.zh: 作者提出长途重访基准，并报告时间一致性与场景回忆改善，整个方法无需重新训练基础生成模型。
result.en: The authors introduce a long-detour revisit benchmark and report improved temporal consistency and scene recall without retraining the underlying video-generation model.

2604.20289.title_zh: X-Cache：少步自回归世界模型的跨片段块缓存

background.zh: 闭环驾驶世界模型需要及时响应新动作，少步视频扩散已减少去噪次数但仍具有较高计算成本。
background.en: Closed-loop driving world models must respond promptly to new actions, and few-step video diffusion remains computationally expensive despite reducing denoising iterations.

challenge.zh: 少步模型缺少足够步间冗余，未来控制条件尚不可知，而近似结果还可能污染持续保存的历史缓存。
challenge.en: Few-step models offer limited inter-step redundancy, future control conditions are unavailable, and approximations can contaminate the historical caches retained for later generation.

method.zh: 方法跨连续片段复用各块残差，用结构与动作指纹决定重算，并强制干净缓存更新前向完整执行。
method.en: The method reuses block residuals across consecutive chunks, gates recomputation using structural and action fingerprints, and fully executes forwards that update clean historical caches.

result.zh: 生产驾驶世界模型评估报告较高跳块率和实际加速，同时通过完整缓存更新限制近似误差的持续传播。
result.en: Evaluation on a production driving world model reports substantial block skipping and speedup, while complete cache updates limit persistent propagation of approximation errors.

2608.00337.title_zh: Armory：批量机器人策略服务中的动作块调度

background.zh: 多个机器人可以共享远端设备执行大型策略推理，但各机器人需要及时补充即将耗尽的动作序列。
background.en: Multiple robots can share remote accelerators for large-policy inference, but each robot needs timely replenishment of its remaining action sequence.

challenge.zh: 机器人消耗动作块的速度不同，使传统批处理启发式难以兼顾吞吐与闭环执行的连续性。
challenge.en: Robots consume action chunks at different rates, making conventional batching heuristics inadequate for balancing serving throughput against continuity of closed-loop execution.

method.zh: 系统跟踪机器人动作队列，以考虑未来消耗情况的调度算法选择推理批次，适配异构机器人需求。
method.en: The system tracks robot action queues and chooses inference batches using a scheduling algorithm that accounts for future consumption and heterogeneous robot demands.

result.zh: 作者在仿真与真实机器人集群中验证系统，报告异构动作消耗下相较朴素调度更高的吞吐。
result.en: Experiments with simulated and real robot fleets validate the system and report higher throughput than naive scheduling under heterogeneous action-consumption rates.

2610.05062.title_zh: 超越语言模型服务：具身智能中视觉语言动作负载的系统刻画

background.zh: 机器人策略需要在控制周期内完成推理，延迟超限会让机器人依据过时观测行动并影响任务成功。
background.en: Robot policies must complete inference within control periods, because deadline overruns cause actions based on stale observations and can reduce task success.

challenge.zh: 单机器人小批量执行与云端语言模型服务不同，设备架构和动作维度会改变计算、内存与能耗瓶颈。
challenge.en: Single-robot, batch-one execution differs from cloud language-model serving, with hardware architecture and action dimensionality shifting computation, memory, and energy bottlenecks.

method.zh: 论文在边缘服务器与板载设备上刻画四种视觉语言动作模型，结合频率调节和大量闭环任务评估。
method.en: The study characterizes four vision-language-action models on edge servers and onboard devices, combining frequency-scaling analysis with extensive closed-loop task evaluation.

result.zh: 结果揭示平台相关的延迟能耗取舍，且不存在跨所有服务目标都占优的推理与动作重叠配置。
result.en: Results reveal platform-dependent latency-energy tradeoffs and show that no inference-action overlap configuration dominates across every evaluated deployment service-level objective.

2609.34792.title_zh: D²-VLA：面向长时动态操作的双记忆双频率模型

background.zh: 长时机器人操作既需要记住已经离开视野的线索，也需要及时响应当前移动物体与环境变化。
background.en: Long-horizon manipulation requires remembering cues no longer visible while responding quickly to moving objects and changes in the current environment.

challenge.zh: 频繁刷新视觉语言上下文成本较高，而仅使用最新观测又无法兼顾长期记忆与快速动作重规划。
challenge.en: Frequently refreshing vision-language context is expensive, while using only the latest observation fails to combine long-term memory with rapid action replanning.

method.zh: 模型使用分块因果缓存和不同历史读取视图，通过门控适配器更新视觉特征，并以快速记忆队列重规划。
method.en: The model uses block-causal caches and separate historical read views, updating visual features through a gated adapter and replanning actions with a fast-memory queue.

result.zh: 作者在动态长时操作、真实机器人和通用操作基准中报告成功率改善，展示双频率记忆设计的价值。
result.en: Results on dynamic long-horizon manipulation, real robots, and general manipulation benchmarks report improved success rates, supporting the dual-frequency memory design.

2512.20188.title_zh: DuoCore-FS：用于全身机器人操作的异步快慢策略

background.zh: 全身机器人操作需要高频动作响应，而负责丰富语义推理的大型视觉语言模型通常更新较慢。
background.en: Whole-body robotic manipulation requires high-frequency action responses, while large vision-language models providing rich semantic reasoning typically update more slowly.

challenge.zh: 强制推理与动作专家同步运行会限制控制频率，在多关节和动态视角条件下损害响应与稳定性。
challenge.en: Forcing reasoning and action experts to run synchronously limits control frequency and can hurt responsiveness and stability with many joints and changing viewpoints.

method.zh: 框架以潜表示缓冲连接慢速语义推理和快速动作路径，结合全身动作标记化并保持端到端联合训练。
method.en: The framework connects slow reasoning and fast action pathways through a latent buffer, combining whole-body action tokenization with end-to-end joint training.

result.zh: 真实全身操作实验报告更高响应速度与任务成功率，并展示大型视觉语言骨干下的高频动作块生成。
result.en: Real-world whole-body manipulation experiments report better responsiveness and task success, demonstrating high-frequency action-chunk generation alongside a large vision-language backbone.

2506.01953.title_zh: FiS-VLA：将快速操作融入慢速推理的双系统基础模型

background.zh: 机器人基础策略需要利用视觉语言模型的常识能力，同时以足够高的频率产生精细操作动作。
background.en: Robot foundation policies need the commonsense capabilities of vision-language models while producing manipulation actions at sufficiently high execution frequencies.

challenge.zh: 独立快慢模型难以共享丰富预训练知识，统一频率执行又使动作路径受慢速语义推理限制。
challenge.en: Separate fast and slow models cannot fully share pretrained knowledge, while a unified execution frequency constrains actions by slower semantic reasoning.

method.zh: 方法通过部分参数共享把快速执行模块嵌入慢速模型，采用异步频率与双感知协同训练协调两条路径。
method.en: The method embeds fast execution within the slow model through partial parameter sharing, coordinating asynchronous pathways with a dual-aware co-training strategy.

result.zh: 仿真与真实机器人实验报告更高平均成功率和高频控制，展示共享模型内推理与执行协同的效果。
result.en: Simulation and real-robot experiments report higher average success rates and high-frequency control, demonstrating coordination between reasoning and execution within a shared model.

2605.11381.title_zh: Kairos：面向物理AI的可扩展服务系统

background.zh: 机器人基础模型反复交替进行推理与动作执行，任务完成时间由整个生成执行循环决定。
background.en: Robotic foundation models alternate inference with action execution, so task completion time depends on the entire generate-execute loop.

challenge.zh: 仅优化单次推理会忽略动作执行时段和下次调用的紧迫性，难以高效服务机器人群。
challenge.en: Optimizing isolated inference ignores execution intervals and the urgency of subsequent requests, limiting efficiency when serving fleets of robots.

method.zh: 将生成执行循环纳入调度，利用执行状态安排请求，并考虑动作执行时域与边云分流。
method.en: Kairos incorporates execution state into serving decisions, coordinating inference timing, action execution horizons and edge-cloud placement across robots.

result.zh: 在多种模型和机器人设置中，作者报告平均端到端任务延迟降低31.8%至66.5%。
result.en: Across evaluated models and robots, the authors report 31.8–66.5% lower average end-to-end task latency than existing digital-AI serving practices.

2605.11381.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2406.09246.title_zh: OpenVLA：开源视觉语言动作模型

background.zh: 预训练视觉语言模型结合多机器人示范，为通过微调学习新技能提供可共享的机器人策略基础。
background.en: Pretrained vision-language models and diverse robot demonstrations offer a shared policy foundation that can be adapted to new robotic skills.

challenge.zh: 新机器人和任务要求有效泛化，而大规模VLA训练、参数高效适配及推理部署仍需要开放实现。
challenge.en: New embodiments require effective generalization, while scalable training, parameter-efficient adaptation and deployment benefit from accessible and reproducible implementations.

method.zh: 以7B语言骨干和DINOv2、SigLIP视觉特征训练动作token策略，并研究低秩微调与量化部署。
method.en: OpenVLA trains a seven-billion-parameter action-token policy using language and visual backbones, and studies low-rank adaptation and quantized inference.

result.zh: 作者在多种机器人任务展示泛化及适配效果，并公开检查点、微调示例和支持大规模训练的代码。
result.en: The authors demonstrate generalization and adaptation across robotic tasks and release checkpoints, fine-tuning examples and code supporting large-scale training.

2609.12075.title_zh: Robion：机器人群的高效VLA管理与服务

background.zh: 机器人群共享服务器上的多个VLA时，视觉语言骨干和动作扩散阶段具有不同的执行与时延特征。
background.en: Robot fleets share multiple VLA models whose vision-language backbones and action-diffusion stages have different execution characteristics and latency requirements.

challenge.zh: 整体串行执行或直接共置难以同时提高batch效率与满足控制SLO，需要细粒度共享GPU资源。
challenge.en: Monolithic pipelines or uncontrolled colocation struggle to improve batching while meeting control SLOs, motivating fine-grained sharing of GPU resources.

method.zh: 把VLM和动作扩散放入独立流，结合动态SM分配、剩余SLO优先级和给定模型放置下的流量控制。
method.en: Robion separates VLM and action-diffusion streams, dynamically allocates SMs and combines remaining-SLO scheduling with placement-aware traffic control.

result.zh: 作者在四GPU八模型设置中服务最多64台机器人并保持98%SLO达成率，另比较不同服务基线。
result.en: In an evaluated four-GPU, eight-model configuration, Robion serves up to sixty-four robots while maintaining 98% SLO attainment.

2609.12075.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2607.01088.title_zh: ROSA：机器人群基础模型服务系统

background.zh: 机器人任务依赖多个模型组件与调用频率，共享服务器可改善推理能力、电池续航和GPU利用率。
background.en: Robot tasks invoke multiple model components at different frequencies, and shared serving can improve inference performance, battery life and GPU utilization.

challenge.zh: 逐请求时延最优并不等于工厂整体产出最优，还需协调模型放置、频率、批处理及失败接管。
challenge.en: Minimizing individual request latency does not maximize factory productivity, which also depends on placement, request rates, batching and failure handling.

method.zh: 提供机器人感知的声明式接口，以工厂目标联合规划服务，并连接Ray Serve与多种模型后端。
method.en: ROSA provides robotics-aware declarative abstractions and factory-objective scheduling, integrating Ray Serve orchestration with several model-execution backends.

result.zh: 作者在真实机器人和合成规模负载中报告工厂生产率最高提升12.06倍，比较对象为专用服务系统。
result.en: Evaluations on real robots and synthetic large-scale workloads report up to 12.06 times higher factory productivity than dedicated serving systems.

2607.01088.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2603.28565.title_zh: StreamingVLA：动作流匹配与自适应提前观察

background.zh: 机器人VLA常按动作块依次观察、生成和执行，阶段间等待会造成控制停顿并降低闭环响应速度。
background.en: Robotic VLA pipelines often observe, generate and execute action chunks sequentially, producing pauses and limiting responsiveness to environmental changes.

challenge.zh: 逐块去噪和固定观察时间限制阶段重叠，要实现连续执行需要同时调整动作建模和观察策略。
challenge.en: Chunkwise denoising and fixed observation timing restrict overlap, so continuous execution requires coordinated changes to action modeling and observation scheduling.

method.zh: 学习动作流轨迹而非逐块去噪，并按动作显著性自适应提前观察，以异步流水重叠各阶段。
method.en: StreamingVLA learns action flows rather than denoising separate chunks and uses action-saliency-aware early observations to overlap pipeline stages asynchronously.

result.zh: 作者报告2.4倍时延加速和6.5倍执行停顿减少，收益来自新的动作生成与观察机制。
result.en: The authors report 2.4-fold latency acceleration and 6.5-fold fewer execution halts using the proposed action-generation and observation mechanisms.

2603.28565.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2602.01100.title_zh: StreamVLA：以完成状态门控打破推理动作循环

background.zh: 长时机器人任务需要协调高层规划与低层控制，但逐时刻重复多模态推理会造成延迟和目标波动。
background.en: Long-horizon robot tasks need coordinated planning and control, yet repeating multimodal reasoning at every timestep increases latency and destabilizes goals.

challenge.zh: 需要识别何时真正发生子任务切换，并让稳定目标条件适应不同执行速度而不反复重规划。
challenge.en: The policy must identify genuine subtask transitions and maintain a stable goal that tolerates varying execution speeds without repeatedly replanning.

method.zh: 仅在检测到子任务切换时生成文本指令与视觉完成状态，执行期间锁定目标以条件化流匹配动作头。
method.en: StreamVLA generates instructions and visual completion states only at subtask transitions, locking those goals to condition a flow-matching action head during execution.

result.zh: 作者报告跳过多数时刻的慢推理，LIBERO 成功率达 98.5%，相对完整推理基线延迟降低 48%。
result.en: The authors bypass slow reasoning at most timesteps, report 98.5% LIBERO success, and reduce latency by 48% against full-reasoning baselines.

2602.01100.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2607.15621.title_zh: 以 5Hz 思考、20Hz 行动：闭环驾驶的快慢异步 VLA

background.zh: 大型视觉语言模型能理解驾驶指令，但其推理延迟通常高于车辆闭环控制允许的更新间隔。
background.en: Large vision-language models understand driving instructions, but their inference latency often exceeds the update interval required for closed-loop vehicle control.

challenge.zh: 跳帧重放动作忽略最新观察，异步复用旧语义缓存又存在训练和部署时新鲜度不匹配的问题。
challenge.en: Replaying actions between model calls ignores new observations, while asynchronous use of stale semantic caches creates a mismatch between training and deployment.

method.zh: 冻结慢速 VLM 暴露逐层 KV，快速动作专家每 tick 读取当前相机与旧缓存，并以随机陈旧度训练。
method.en: A frozen slow VLM exposes layerwise KV caches, while a fast action expert uses current frames and cached context, trained with randomized staleness.

result.zh: 作者在 CARLA 上报告更高路线完成率，每五十毫秒更新控制；单次模型成本约三十二毫秒。
result.en: CARLA evaluations report higher route completion with fresh control every fifty milliseconds and approximately thirty-two milliseconds of model computation per tick.

2607.15621.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2502.02175.title_zh: VLA-Cache：通过自适应 token 缓存加速机器人操作

background.zh: 相邻机器人观察通常只有部分区域变化，但 VLA 往往重复处理全部视觉 token，增加控制延迟。
background.en: Consecutive robot observations often change only in limited regions, but VLAs repeatedly process all visual tokens, increasing latency in closed-loop manipulation.

challenge.zh: 缓存静态内容不能忽略对任务敏感的细微变化，还需适应不同网络层的注意力集中程度。
challenge.en: Caching static content must preserve subtle task-relevant changes and account for how attention concentration varies across the model's decoder layers.

method.zh: 识别变化较小的视觉 token 复用 KV，重新计算关键区域，并依据层注意力动态调整复用比例。
method.en: VLA-Cache reuses KV for minimally changed visual tokens, recomputes task-critical regions, and adjusts reuse ratios according to layer-specific attention concentration.

result.zh: 作者报告最高 1.7 倍 CUDA 延迟加速及约 15% 控制频率提升，所测任务成功率损失较小。
result.en: The authors report up to 1.7-fold CUDA latency acceleration and about fifteen percent higher control frequency, with small measured task-success losses.

2502.02175.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

1910.02653.title_zh: Checkmate：通过最优张量重计算突破训练内存限制

background.zh: 神经网络训练需要保存大量中间张量，重计算可以用额外运算换取更低的设备内存需求。
background.en: Neural-network training retains many intermediate tensors, and recomputation can exchange additional arithmetic work for a lower device-memory requirement during execution.

challenge.zh: 复杂计算图中选择保存或重算哪些张量，需要同时考虑依赖关系、内存上限和硬件实际运算成本。
challenge.en: Choosing which tensors to save or recompute in complex graphs requires jointly considering dependencies, memory constraints, and hardware-specific execution costs.

method.zh: 系统将张量重计算调度表述为优化问题，结合混合整数规划、近似算法与设备实测成本模型。
method.en: The system formulates tensor-rematerialization scheduling as an optimization problem, combining mixed-integer programming, approximation algorithms, and accelerator-profiled execution-cost models.

result.zh: 作者展示在真实网络中降低训练成本并支持更大输入，且优化调度可在大量训练迭代中重复使用。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate lower training costs and support for larger inputs on real networks, with optimized schedules reused across many training iterations.

2604.04780.title_zh: CLEAR：释放统一多模态模型对退化图像的生成理解能力

background.zh: 统一多模态模型兼具生成与理解能力，有望利用视觉生成补足模糊、噪声和压缩导致的信息损失。
background.en: Unified multimodal models combine generation and understanding, offering a way to compensate for visual information damaged by blur, noise, and compression.

challenge.zh: 现有训练未教会模型在推理中调用生成能力，解码再编码的连接方式也妨碍端到端联合优化。
challenge.en: Existing training does not teach models to invoke generation during reasoning, and decoding then re-encoding creates an ineffective interface for joint optimization.

method.zh: 框架先学习生成后回答模式，再用潜表示桥连接两种能力，并以交错 GRPO 联合优化视觉与文本。
method.en: The framework teaches a generate-then-answer pattern, connects both capabilities through a latent representation bridge, and jointly optimizes visual generation and text using interleaved GRPO.

result.zh: 退化图像基准显示鲁棒性提升且干净图像性能得到保持，分析还揭示任务驱动优化对中间视觉质量的影响。
result.en: Degraded-image benchmarks show improved robustness while preserving clean-image performance, and analyses examine how task-driven optimization influences the quality of intermediate visual states.

2311.11822.title_zh: DP-ZeRO：具有差分隐私的零冗余分布式学习

background.zh: 大模型差分隐私训练需要逐样本梯度裁剪，同时还要通过分布式分片减少模型与优化器状态开销。
background.en: Differentially private large-model training requires per-sample gradient clipping while using distributed sharding to reduce model and optimizer-state memory requirements.

challenge.zh: 隐私优化与零冗余分布式机制的执行要求不同，直接组合可能引入额外计算、通信和内存负担。
challenge.en: Privacy-preserving optimization and zero-redundancy distribution impose different execution requirements, so directly combining them can add computation, communication, and memory overhead.

method.zh: 系统重新组织隐私优化与 ZeRO 的协作流程，支持大规模可训练参数、混合精度及分片执行。
method.en: The system reorganizes cooperation between private optimization and ZeRO, supporting large trainable parameter counts, mixed precision, and sharded distributed execution.

result.zh: 作者在大型隐私模型中展示扩展能力，并报告计算与通信效率接近标准 ZeRO 的实验结果。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate scalability on large differentially private models and report computation and communication efficiency approaching that of standard ZeRO training.

background.zh: 激活检查点通过按需重算中间结果降低训练内存，但静态计划往往依赖预先已知的计算图。
background.en: Activation checkpointing reduces training memory by recomputing intermediate results, but static plans often require the computation graph to be known in advance.

challenge.zh: 动态模型的执行路径难以离线预测，需要在线决定张量驱逐与恢复，同时避免过多重复计算。
challenge.en: Dynamic models have execution paths that are difficult to predict offline, requiring online eviction and restoration decisions without introducing excessive recomputation.

method.zh: 方法按轻量张量元数据运行贪心在线驱逐策略，在张量分配与算子调用层实现通用重计算机制。
method.en: The method uses lightweight tensor metadata for greedy online eviction, implementing general rematerialization by interposing on tensor allocation and operator calls.

result.zh: 理论给出链式网络的内存与计算界，仿真实验接近最优静态检查点，并提供 PyTorch 原型。
result.en: Theory establishes memory and computation bounds for chain networks, simulations approach optimal static checkpointing, and a PyTorch prototype demonstrates practical implementation.

fastdp-bk.title_zh: Book-Keeping：以较低开销优化大型差分隐私模型

background.zh: 差分隐私训练通过逐样本梯度裁剪保护数据，但朴素实现会显著增加大模型训练的时间与内存成本。
background.en: Differentially private training protects data through per-sample gradient clipping, but naive implementations substantially increase the time and memory costs of large-model training.

challenge.zh: 保存全部逐样本梯度代价高昂，而重复反向传播又会降低吞吐，限制大模型和高维输入训练。
challenge.en: Storing all per-sample gradients is expensive, while repeated backward passes reduce throughput and constrain training with large models and high-dimensional inputs.

method.zh: 方法利用反向传播中的记账与因子结构实现现有隐私优化器，减少逐样本裁剪所需的额外计算和存储。
method.en: The method uses bookkeeping and factor structure during backpropagation to implement existing private optimizers with reduced computation and storage for per-sample clipping.

result.zh: 复杂度分析及视觉、语言实验显示较小额外成本，并在保持隐私优化目标下接近普通训练效率。
result.en: Complexity analysis and vision-language experiments show small additional costs, approaching standard training efficiency while preserving the underlying private optimization objective.

flexrl.title_zh: FlexRL：通过高效负载平衡扩展视觉语言模型强化学习

background.zh: 视觉语言强化学习同时处理图像、视频和文本，输入准备与序列长度差异会形成显著系统瓶颈。
background.en: Vision-language reinforcement learning processes images, video, and text, creating substantial bottlenecks from input preparation and differences in sequence length.

challenge.zh: 集中解码造成处理器与内存长尾，混合短图文和长视频样本还会导致各设备计算负载不均。
challenge.en: Centralized decoding creates CPU and memory stragglers, while mixing short image-text prompts with long video contexts produces uneven computational loads across accelerators.

method.zh: 系统把视觉处理分散到工作节点并异步物化数据，再按成本动态划分子序列以平衡计算和内存。
method.en: The system distributes visual preprocessing across workers with asynchronous tensor materialization, then adaptively shards subsequences according to cost to balance computation and memory.

result.zh: 多种模型和数据集的大规模集群评估显示端到端吞吐提高，验证数据加载与序列负载平衡的联合价值。
result.en: Large-cluster evaluations across models and datasets show higher end-to-end throughput, validating the combined value of distributed data loading and sequence-level load balancing.

1506.02438.title_zh: 使用广义优势估计进行高维连续控制

background.zh: 策略梯度可直接优化累计奖励，但复杂连续控制常需要大量样本，且非平稳数据会影响稳定改进。
background.en: Policy gradients directly optimize cumulative reward, but complex continuous control often requires many samples and struggles with stable improvement under nonstationary data.

challenge.zh: 降低梯度方差通常需要引入价值估计偏差，因此必须控制偏差方差取舍与策略更新幅度。
challenge.en: Reducing gradient variance typically introduces bias through value estimates, requiring control over the bias-variance tradeoff and the magnitude of policy updates.

method.zh: 方法以指数加权时间差分残差构建广义优势估计，并对策略与价值网络采用信赖域优化。
method.en: The method constructs generalized advantage estimates from exponentially weighted temporal-difference residuals and applies trust-region optimization to both policy and value networks.

result.zh: 三维双足与四足运动任务展示较强学习效果，神经网络策略可从原始运动学状态直接输出关节力矩。
result.en: Experiments on three-dimensional bipedal and quadrupedal locomotion demonstrate strong learning results, with neural policies mapping raw kinematic states directly to joint torques.

2101.06983.title_zh: 显存受限条件下扩大深度对比学习批量

background.zh: 文本表示学习通过批内负样本改善对比学习效果，因此希望使用较大的训练批量。
background.en: Text representation learning benefits from large contrastive batches that supply many in-batch negative examples.

challenge.zh: 每个样本的损失依赖整批表示，普通反向传播需要同时保存整批编码器激活而受显存限制。
challenge.en: Each loss depends on representations from the full batch, forcing conventional backpropagation to retain memory-intensive encoder activations.

method.zh: 先缓存表示层梯度，再对小批样本重算编码器并反传，将对比损失与编码器反向传播解耦。
method.en: Gradient caching separates loss differentiation from encoder backpropagation, allowing encoder recomputation and gradient accumulation in smaller sub-batches.

result.zh: 该方法能够逐小批计算同一大批量目标的梯度，使编码器激活内存基本不随总批量增长。
result.en: The method computes gradients for the large-batch objective incrementally, keeping encoder activation memory approximately independent of the total batch size.

megascale-data.title_zh: MegaScale-Data：多来源基础模型训练的数据加载扩展

background.zh: 多来源基础模型训练需要按课程、模态和序列长度灵活组合数据，并持续向大规模训练集群供给样本。
background.en: Multisource foundation-model training must flexibly mix curricula, modalities, and sequence lengths while feeding large training clusters.

challenge.zh: 每个数据并行加载器重复维护数据源状态，会放大 CPU 内存与重复访问，并难以适应不同预处理成本。
challenge.en: Replicated source state across data-parallel loaders wastes CPU memory and accesses, while preprocessing costs differ across sources.

method.zh: 将数据源加载和样本构造分离，以声明式集中数据平面统一编排，并按成本自动分区和扩缩容。
method.en: MegaScale-Data separates source loading from data construction, with centralized declarative orchestration and cost-aware partitioning and scaling.

result.zh: 最新论文报告最高 4.5 倍端到端训练吞吐量和 13.5 倍 CPU 内存用量降低，不能与旧 OVERLORD 版本的 3.6 倍内存结果混用。
result.en: The latest version reports up to 4.5× training throughput and 13.5× lower CPU memory use; these figures supersede the earlier OVERLORD abstract.

megascale-data.review_note: 同一 arXiv ID 2504.09844 的早期标题为 OVERLORD，最新正式名称为 MegaScale-Data；复用已有 megascale-data 条目，不重复收录。

2606.01143.title_zh: PrefixFlow：RL训练中的调度级前缀复用

background.zh: 同一提示生成多条回答的RL更新会反复计算相同前缀，长检索上下文使冗余训练开销突出。
background.en: RL updates for multiple responses repeatedly compute shared prompts, making long retrieval contexts a substantial source of redundant training work.

challenge.zh: 训练缓存必须保留正确梯度，跨microbatch和并行布局共享前缀不能简单照搬推理缓存。
challenge.en: Training reuse must preserve gradients across microbatches and parallel layouts, so inference-style prefix caching cannot simply be reused unchanged.

method.zh: 前缀只前向一次，后缀训练累计KV梯度后统一反传前缀，并按生命周期卸载休眠激活。
method.en: PrefixFlow computes prefix states once, accumulates suffix KV gradients and performs one prefix backward pass, with optional dormant-activation offloading.

result.zh: 作者报告长前缀RAG任务端到端训练加速1.90倍，actor更新加速6.1倍，并保持BF16容差一致。
result.en: The authors report 1.90-fold end-to-end acceleration and 6.1-fold actor-update acceleration on a long-prefix RAG workload, matching BF16 tolerance.

2608.25683.title_zh: psRL：通过训练期前缀共享加速智能体训练

background.zh: 树状探索和逐步采样产生许多共享前缀轨迹，使智能体RL更新阶段重复处理相同上下文。
background.en: Tree-based exploration and stepwise sampling create trajectories with shared prefixes, causing repeated context computation during agentic RL updates.

challenge.zh: 分布式训练既要提高前缀复用率，也要平衡GPU工作量，并适应不同缓存块大小的内存需求。
challenge.en: Distributed training must simultaneously maximize reuse, balance GPU workloads and manage memory under varying prefix structures and cache-block requirements.

method.zh: 利用更新期数据全局可见且不变的特性，设计细粒度前缀共享调度和可变块KV缓存管理。
method.en: psRL exploits globally visible, immutable update data through fine-grained prefix-sharing schedules and a KV manager supporting adaptable block sizes.

result.zh: 作者使用生产轨迹评估，报告相对现有系统最高5.2倍吞吐提升，结果取决于前缀共享结构。
result.en: Evaluations using production traces report up to 5.2 times higher throughput than existing systems, depending on the workload's prefix-sharing structure.

background.zh: 通用VLM需要处理不同分辨率图像、长视频、文档和交互任务，同时维持语言模型原有能力。
background.en: General-purpose VLMs must process varied image resolutions, long videos, documents and interactive tasks while retaining strong language capabilities.

challenge.zh: 视觉token成本、时间定位与精细空间理解使统一建模困难，固定分辨率还可能丢失关键细节。
challenge.en: Visual token costs, temporal localization and fine spatial understanding complicate unified modeling, while fixed resolutions may discard important details.

method.zh: 结合动态分辨率、视频时间建模和视觉窗口注意力，提供不同规模的视觉语言基础模型。
method.en: Qwen2.5-VL combines dynamic resolution, video temporal modeling and windowed visual attention, offering several model sizes for different deployment settings.

result.zh: 作者报告文档、图表及视觉智能体任务的竞争性表现，并提供三种模型规模以覆盖不同部署需求。
result.en: The authors report competitive document, diagram and visual-agent performance and release three model sizes covering diverse computational requirements.

2608.14498.title_zh: Rollplex：VLM后训练的跨阶段GPU空间共享

background.zh: 同步VLM强化学习中，回答生成尚未完成时，一部分与回答无关的前缀训练计算已经可以执行。
background.en: In synchronous VLM reinforcement learning, some response-independent prefix computation can begin while rollout decoding is still in progress.

challenge.zh: 直接共置会扩大显存占用，而且生成与训练偏好的张量并行度及权重布局并不相同。
challenge.en: Naive colocation increases memory demand, and rollout and training often prefer different tensor-parallel degrees and physical weight layouts.

method.zh: 按阶段生命周期管理HBM，并在不同并行度间共享兼容权重布局，只重建不兼容部分。
method.en: Rollplex manages HBM according to phase lifetimes and shares layout-compatible weights across parallel configurations, reconstructing only incompatible tensors.

result.zh: 作者在32张H800上报告较串行共置加速1.23至1.30倍，同时保持同步RL更新协议。
result.en: On thirty-two H800 GPUs, the authors report 1.23–1.30-fold acceleration over serial colocation while preserving synchronous RL updates.

2608.12146.title_zh: RoutePack：回放引导的专家放置与RL轨迹调度

background.zh: MoE强化学习的路由回放提前提供专家需求信息，但完整轨迹分组仍可能造成专家负载峰值。
background.en: MoE reinforcement learning exposes expert demands through routing replay, but trajectory grouping can still create concentrated expert-load peaks.

challenge.zh: 只调整专家位置或只在数据并行组内装箱难以共同平衡负载，还必须保持前后向训练状态一致。
challenge.en: Independent expert placement or data-parallel packing cannot jointly balance demand, and training requires consistent placement throughout forward and backward passes.

method.zh: 联合规划轨迹microbatch和专家放置，在容量可行的固定步数内减少峰值并保持逻辑路由不变。
method.en: RoutePack jointly plans trajectory microbatches and expert placement under capacity constraints while preserving logical routing and a fixed microstep count.

result.zh: 作者在所测MoE训练区域报告较DP局部装箱吞吐提升4.44%至11.85%，并单独计算规划成本。
result.en: Within evaluated MoE training regions, the authors report 4.44–11.85% higher throughput than data-parallel local packing and separately account for planning costs.

1511.08486.title_zh: 通过充分因子广播进行分布式机器学习

background.zh: 许多矩阵参数模型的逐样本更新可写成两个向量的外积，直接传输完整梯度矩阵可能浪费带宽。
background.en: Many matrix-parameterized models produce per-sample rank-one updates, making transmission of full gradient matrices unnecessarily expensive in distributed learning.

challenge.zh: 分布式训练需要减少通信而不改变更新含义，并保证所有工作器能以较低成本重建所需矩阵。
challenge.en: Reducing communication must preserve update semantics and allow workers to reconstruct required matrices without introducing excessive additional costs.

method.zh: 广播构成秩一更新的充分因子，由各工作器本地恢复外积，使通信随矩阵维度线性增长。
method.en: SFB broadcasts the two sufficient factors of each rank-one update and reconstructs outer products locally, making communication linear in matrix dimensions.

result.zh: 论文给出收敛分析，并在四类矩阵参数模型上验证通信效率，同时保持相应更新的计算正确性。
result.en: The paper provides convergence analysis and evaluates four matrix-parameterized model families, demonstrating communication efficiency while preserving the corresponding update computations.

2610.16691.title_zh: StageBreaker：把视频RL调度从阶段边界细化到数据依赖

background.zh: 视频RL后训练包含奖励评估与策略训练，粗粒度阶段执行容易隐藏已经满足依赖的可提前计算工作。
background.en: Video RL post-training includes reward evaluation and policy optimization, but coarse stages hide computations whose dependencies are already satisfied.

challenge.zh: 阶段屏障会等待全部奖励，并在训练内部重复回放轨迹，增加计算开销和GPU负载不均。
challenge.en: Stage barriers wait for all rewards and trigger repeated trajectory replays, increasing redundant computation and imbalance across available GPUs.

method.zh: 利用奖励可分离训练重叠奖励与更新，以损失无关反传合并轨迹回放，并按真实数据依赖调度。
method.en: StageBreaker exploits reward-separable training and loss-independent backward computation to overlap stages, merge replays and schedule work by actual data dependencies.

result.zh: 作者报告相对阶段中心执行最高1.41倍加速，收益来自解除不必要屏障和更细粒度负载均衡。
result.en: The authors report up to 1.41-fold acceleration over stage-centric execution through reduced unnecessary barriers, fewer replays and finer-grained load balancing.

2610.05935.title_zh: ThunderSyncRL：智能体强化学习的无损加速

background.zh: 同步智能体训练需等待长轨迹和验证完成，学习器闲置明显；跨更新异步又会引入策略陈旧。
background.en: Synchronous agent training leaves learners idle during long rollouts and verification, while overlapping different updates asynchronously introduces stale-policy data into training.

challenge.zh: 需要识别梯度真正依赖哪些已完成输入，在保持原目标和同一策略版本的条件下提前开始学习。
challenge.en: Acceleration requires identifying which inputs each gradient actually depends on so computation can start early without changing objectives or policy versions.

method.zh: GRPO 在单轨迹奖励就绪后计算分数梯度，OPD 在工具等待期间对已获教师评分的回合提前反向。
method.en: ThunderSyncRL streams GRPO score gradients after individual rewards arrive and computes teacher-scored OPD turn gradients while external tool calls are still running.

result.zh: 论文证明恢复相同批同步更新，实验报告最高 1.9 倍训练加速，且不引入策略陈旧。
result.en: The paper proves equivalence to batch-synchronous updates and reports training acceleration up to 1.9 times without introducing policy staleness.
