2610.33581.title_zh: UltraFlash：加速百万像素级视觉合成

background.zh: 级联高分辨率生成不仅重复去噪，还反复经过 VAE 解码、像素缩放与编码，增加额外转换成本。
background.en: Cascaded high resolution generation repeats not only denoising but also VAE decoding, pixel resizing, and encoding, adding substantial representation-transition costs.

challenge.zh: 中间 RGB 往返和最终密集重叠块解码都很昂贵，需要降低转换成本而不引入明显边界伪影。
challenge.en: Intermediate RGB round trips and densely overlapping final decoding patches are costly, requiring faster transitions without introducing visible boundary artifacts.

method.zh: 用学习到的潜空间捷径近似解码缩放编码，并通过共享归一化统计减少最终块解码的重叠需求。
method.en: UltraFlash learns a latent shortcut for decode-resize-encode transitions and reuses normalization statistics to reduce overlap in final patch-based decoding.

result.zh: 作者在级联基线上报告 4K 生成延迟约减半且质量改善；潜空间捷径属于学习近似而非严格等价转换。
result.en: The authors report approximately halved 4K latency with improved quality on a cascade baseline; the learned shortcut approximates rather than exactly reproduces transitions.

2610.33581.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

background.zh: 大模型分布式训练通过流水线并行划分模型，但设备等待前后向依赖时会出现影响效率的执行气泡。
background.en: Large-model distributed training partitions models through pipeline parallelism, but devices experience efficiency-reducing bubbles while waiting for forward and backward dependencies.

challenge.zh: 同步训练要求梯度与优化器更新正确协调，内存上限又限制可以同时保留的中间状态和微批次数。
challenge.en: Synchronous training requires correct gradient and optimizer coordination, while memory limits constrain the intermediate state and number of simultaneously active microbatches.

method.zh: 方法分离输入梯度与参数梯度计算，重排两类反向任务，并根据模型和内存约束搜索流水线调度。
method.en: The method separates input-gradient and parameter-gradient computation, reorders these backward tasks, and searches pipeline schedules under model-specific and memory constraints.

result.zh: 作者报告相对标准一前一后流水的吞吐改善，并展示在适当条件下保持同步语义的零气泡执行。
result.en: The authors report throughput improvements over standard one-forward-one-backward pipelines and demonstrate zero-bubble execution under suitable conditions while preserving synchronous training semantics.

2605.19481.title_zh: C2CServe：利用 NVLink-C2C 在 MIG 上实现弹性无服务器语言模型服务

background.zh: 长尾模型调用需要弹性共享设备，但小型隔离分区往往缺少容纳现代语言模型权重的显存。
background.en: Long-tail model invocation benefits from elastic device sharing, but small isolated GPU partitions often lack enough memory to hold modern language-model weights.

challenge.zh: 设备共享与快速冷启动存在冲突，且从主机读取权重会让多个分区竞争同一高速互连带宽。
challenge.en: Device sharing conflicts with fast cold starts, and streaming weights from host memory causes multiple partitions to compete for the same high-bandwidth interconnect.

method.zh: 系统将权重保留在主机内存，以混合矩阵乘调整数据访问，并联合模型放置、输入分块和反馈控制。
method.en: The system retains weights in host memory, adapts access patterns with HybridGEMM, and coordinates model placement, input chunking, and feedback control.

result.zh: GH200 评估显示冷启动延迟降低，在互连竞争下仍能保持较高的首标记和输出标记服务目标达成率。
result.en: Evaluations on GH200 show lower cold-start latency while maintaining high attainment of first-token and inter-token latency objectives under interconnect contention.

2608.03537.title_zh: ComFuse：融合计算密集与复杂内存子图的自动 GPU 编译

background.zh: 深度学习计算图同时包含矩阵乘和大量逐元素、归约操作，融合可以减少数据搬运与启动开销。
background.en: Deep-learning graphs combine matrix multiplication with elementwise and reduction operations, creating opportunities for fusion to reduce data movement and kernel-launch overhead.

challenge.zh: 依赖丰富的内存操作子图难以与计算密集操作自动协调，传统融合模式也限制复杂计算图的覆盖范围。
challenge.en: Dependency-rich memory-operation subgraphs are difficult to coordinate automatically with compute-intensive operators, and conventional fusion patterns limit coverage of complex computational graphs.

method.zh: 编译系统联合融合计算与内存子图，支持连续矩阵乘模式，并自动将高层张量程序降低为优化内核。
method.en: The compiler jointly fuses compute- and memory-intensive subgraphs, supports back-to-back matrix multiplication, and automatically lowers high-level tensor programs into optimized GPU kernels.

result.zh: 作者在归一化及复杂算子场景中报告超过 TorchInductor 的内核表现，并展示更灵活的融合模式覆盖。
result.en: Experiments on post-normalization and complex operator workloads report kernels outperforming TorchInductor while supporting a broader range of flexible fusion patterns.

2608.14376.title_zh: CoRun：通过填充实现高效确定性语言模型推理

background.zh: 即使固定随机种子，动态批次仍可能改变 GPU 计算路径，从而影响语言模型输出的一致性。
background.en: Even with fixed random seeds, dynamic batching can change GPU computation paths and consequently alter the consistency of language-model outputs.

challenge.zh: 批次变化会改变分块和浮点归约顺序，而强制所有内核批次不变又可能牺牲推理性能。
challenge.en: Changing batch shapes alters tiling and floating-point reduction orders, while forcing every kernel to be batch-invariant can substantially reduce inference performance.

method.zh: 系统利用内核位置不变性，分离预填充并固定解码批次形状，再以 CUDA 图减少调度开销。
method.en: The system exploits kernel position invariance, isolates prefill, fixes decode-batch shapes, and uses CUDA graphs to reduce execution and scheduling overhead.

result.zh: 多种模型架构的实验显示可保持确定性，并相对批次不变内核方案改善吞吐及首标记与输出延迟。
result.en: Experiments across model architectures demonstrate deterministic outputs with improved throughput, first-token latency, and inter-token latency compared with batch-invariant-kernel approaches.

2604.10180.title_zh: Tessera：通过内核粒度分离执行释放异构 GPU 能力

background.zh: 异构设备具有不同计算与内存能力，而同一模型内部的内核也呈现不同资源需求与适合的硬件类型。
background.en: Heterogeneous GPUs offer different compute and memory capabilities, while kernels within one model exhibit distinct resource demands and hardware affinities.

challenge.zh: 粗粒度模型分离无法充分匹配资源，细粒度分配又必须处理依赖正确性、跨设备通信与运行变化。
challenge.en: Coarse-grained model disaggregation poorly matches resources, while finer allocation must preserve dependencies and account for cross-device communication and runtime workload changes.

method.zh: 系统从中间表示提取内核依赖，以流水执行重叠通信，并结合离线分析和轻量在线适配进行调度。
method.en: The system extracts kernel dependencies from intermediate code, overlaps communication through pipelined execution, and schedules work using offline analysis with lightweight online adaptation.

result.zh: 多种异构设备和模型架构实验报告吞吐与成本效率改善，并覆盖部分既有分离方法难以支持的模型。
result.en: Experiments across heterogeneous GPUs and model architectures report improved throughput and cost efficiency, including architectures unsupported by some existing disaggregation approaches.

2508.08448.title_zh: 面向大语言模型时代的高效实用 GPU 多任务处理

background.zh: 随着 GPU 算力增长和 AI 工作负载多样化，一块设备只运行一个任务越来越难充分利用资源。
background.en: Growing GPU capacity and increasingly diverse AI workloads make single-task execution an inefficient way to use accelerators.

challenge.zh: 现有共享方案难以同时处理异构资源需求、隔离与调度，因此多任务不能只依靠简单并发提交。
challenge.en: Existing sharing mechanisms struggle to reconcile heterogeneous resource demands, isolation and scheduling in practical multitasking deployments.

method.zh: 论文梳理现有方法的不足，并提出类似 CPU 操作系统的 GPU 资源管理层及其研究议程。
method.en: The paper analyzes prior approaches and outlines an operating-system-like resource management layer for GPU sharing and scheduling.

result.zh: 其主要产出是多任务系统的需求与设计方向，摘要未报告一个完整实现的统一加速结果。
result.en: The contribution is a set of requirements and design directions; the abstract does not report a unified speedup for a complete implementation.

grape.title_zh: Grape：动态深度神经网络的实用高效 GPU 图执行

background.zh: CUDA Graph 可以减少 CPU 提交开销，但动态形状和数据相关控制流使深度模型难以直接获益。
background.en: CUDA Graph execution reduces CPU launch overhead, but dynamic shapes and data-dependent control flow complicate its use in neural networks.

challenge.zh: 输入复制、大量图元数据和不受支持的动态分支，会分别带来数据搬移、显存和可表达性瓶颈。
challenge.en: Input copies, replicated graph metadata and unsupported branches create data movement, GPU memory and expressiveness bottlenecks.

method.zh: 通过别名预测消除冗余复制、压缩图元数据，并将控制流改写为保持语义的谓词执行。
method.en: Grape combines alias prediction, graph metadata compression and semantics-preserving predication rewriting for dynamic neural network execution.

result.zh: 相对直接使用 CUDA Graph 的比较方案，论文报告显存最多降低 36.43 倍、性能最高提升至 1.26 倍。
result.en: Against compared CUDA Graph approaches, the paper reports up to 36.43 times lower GPU memory consumption and 1.26 times performance.

2007.01277.title_zh: GPU 内核的自动水平融合

background.zh: 计算密集与访存密集内核会使用不同 GPU 资源，独立运行时可能留下可互补的执行空隙。
background.en: Compute-heavy and memory-heavy kernels use different GPU resources, leaving complementary execution opportunities when run separately.

challenge.zh: 传统垂直融合主要减少中间数据搬移，不能直接解决独立内核的指令延迟隐藏与资源互补问题。
challenge.en: Traditional vertical fusion primarily removes intermediate memory traffic and does not directly exploit complementary resources across independent kernels.

method.zh: HFuse 将不同内核分配到同一融合内核的线程区间，并保留各自同步语义以增加线程级并行。
method.en: HFuse assigns kernels to separate thread ranges within a fused CUDA kernel and preserves their synchronization while increasing thread-level parallelism.

result.zh: 论文报告所测内核运行加速 2.5%–60.8%，其中资源需求互补的内核组合尤其受益。
result.en: The evaluated kernel combinations achieve reported speedups of 2.5%–60.8%, with especially strong benefits for complementary resource demands.

mccs.title_zh: MCCS：多租户云中的集合通信服务

background.zh: 分布式训练依赖高效集合通信，但多租户云的物理拓扑和竞争负载通常对应用不可见。
background.en: Distributed training depends on efficient collective communication, but applications in multi-tenant clouds usually cannot observe physical topology or competing traffic.

challenge.zh: 由租户库独立选择通信算法难以协调共享网络，还需解决GPU缓冲区及策略更新的一致性。
challenge.en: Tenant-controlled communication libraries cannot coordinate shared networks effectively, while infrastructure integration must handle GPU buffers and consistent strategy updates.

method.zh: 将集合通信作为云基础设施服务，统一控制策略并支持动态算法、服务质量和流量工程。
method.en: MCCS exposes collective communication as a cloud service, centrally managing algorithms, quality-of-service policies and network-aware traffic engineering across tenants.

result.zh: 作者报告相对NCCL最高2.4倍集合通信性能提升，同时提供跨租户的网络管理能力。
result.en: The authors report collective communication performance up to 2.4 times higher than NCCL while providing additional network and tenant-management capabilities.

2609.13585.title_zh: mKernel：快速多GPU多节点融合内核

background.zh: 大模型分布式训练和推理需要频繁通信，传统独立kernel与stream只能隐藏其中部分传输时间。
background.en: Distributed model execution requires frequent communication, and separate kernels or streams hide only part of its overall cost.

challenge.zh: 跨节点传输、机内互联与计算粒度不一致，使只在NVLink域内优化的融合方案难以直接扩展。
challenge.en: Existing fused kernels mainly target single NVLink domains, leaving cross-node transfers and resource partitioning insufficiently coordinated with computation.

method.zh: 在persistent kernel内划分计算和通信SM，以tile粒度重叠NVLink及RDMA，并动态调整资源比例。
method.en: mKernel partitions persistent-kernel SMs into compute and communication roles, dynamically coordinating tile-level computation, NVLink traffic and RDMA transfers.

result.zh: 作者在H200集群上报告GEMM加AllReduce最高1.72倍加速，Ring Attention最高1.88倍加速。
result.en: On evaluated H200 clusters, the authors report up to 1.72-fold acceleration for GEMM plus AllReduce and 1.88-fold for Ring Attention.

venue.name: arXiv 预印本；未核实正式发表

2609.13585.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2512.22219.title_zh: MPK：将张量程序转化为Mega-Kernel的编译与运行时

background.zh: 模型推理由大量相互依赖的算子构成，逐算子kernel执行会限制跨算子的细粒度流水和融合。
background.en: Model inference consists of many dependent operators, and launching a separate kernel for each limits fine-grained cross-operator pipelining.

challenge.zh: 传统kernel边界难以表达SM级任务依赖，也限制通信与计算在单个持久执行环境中的重叠。
challenge.en: Conventional kernel boundaries poorly express SM-level dependencies and restrict computation-communication overlap within a shared persistent execution environment.

method.zh: 编译器生成SM级任务图，运行时在单个persistent mega-kernel中去中心化调度跨算子任务。
method.en: MPK compiles tensor programs into SM-level task graphs and executes them through decentralized scheduling inside a persistent mega-kernel.

result.zh: 作者报告相对逐算子LLM服务系统最高1.7倍端到端推理时延改善，并公开实现。
result.en: The authors report up to 1.7-fold lower end-to-end inference latency than kernel-per-operator LLM systems and release the implementation publicly.

orion.title_zh: Orion：干扰感知的细粒度GPU共享

background.zh: 深度学习算子具有不同的计算和访存需求，即使排除输入等待，单个应用仍常无法充分利用GPU。
background.en: Deep-learning operators have different compute and memory demands, so individual applications frequently underutilize GPUs even without input-processing stalls.

challenge.zh: 直接共置任务容易让尽力而为工作干扰高优先级推理，损害尾延迟及可预测的服务质量。
challenge.en: Uncontrolled colocation lets best-effort work interfere with high-priority inference, worsening tail latency and making service quality less predictable.

method.zh: 拦截并排队多个应用的GPU操作，根据算子的计算与内存需求以及优先级安排提交。
method.en: Orion intercepts GPU operations from multiple applications and schedules individual operators according to priority and profiled compute and memory requirements.

result.zh: 作者报告共置推理时最高7.3倍GPU吞吐提升，并在共置训练场景中降低训练成本。
result.en: The authors report up to 7.3 times higher inference throughput under colocation and reduced costs when sharing GPUs with training.

background.zh: 燃烧化学等科学计算存在不规则数据访问和大型工作集，传统统一数据并行kernel难以充分利用GPU。
background.en: Scientific workloads such as combustion chemistry contain irregular accesses and large working sets that challenge conventional uniform data-parallel GPU kernels.

challenge.zh: 不同子计算的资源需求不均，过大的工作集与寄存器压力会限制片上存储利用和并发执行。
challenge.en: Different subcomputations have uneven resource demands, while large working sets and register pressure restrict efficient use of on-chip storage.

method.zh: DSL编译器将子计算分配给不同warp，并以硬件named barrier构建细粒度生产者消费者同步。
method.en: Singe assigns subcomputations to specialized warps and generates fine-grained producer-consumer synchronization using hardware named barriers within thread blocks.

result.zh: 作者报告生成的warp特化代码比此前优化的数据并行GPU kernel最高快3.75倍。
result.en: The authors report generated warp-specialized kernels running up to 3.75 times faster than previously optimized data-parallel GPU implementations.

2610.07098.title_zh: T-CCL：利用张量内存加速器实现资源高效集合通信

background.zh: 多 GPU 大模型频繁使用集合通信，通信内核占用的 SM 资源会挤压并发计算的执行空间。
background.en: Large multi-GPU models frequently use collectives, whose SM resource footprint can limit the hardware available to computation running alongside communication.

challenge.zh: 仅追求独立通信带宽不足以优化重叠，需要减少通信线程占用，同时维持数据搬运和归约性能。
challenge.en: High standalone bandwidth is insufficient for effective overlap; communication must also consume fewer execution resources while maintaining data movement and reduction performance.

method.zh: 将节点内数据搬运和归约交给 TMA，以异步操作流水实现 AllReduce、AllGather 和 ReduceScatter。
method.en: T-CCL offloads intra-node movement and reduction to TMA, organizing AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter as pipelines of asynchronous operations.

result.zh: 作者报告多项集合通信与 GEMM 重叠收益，并在 vLLM 集成测试中获得最高 1.31 倍吞吐提升。
result.en: The authors report collective and GEMM-overlap gains, with integrated vLLM evaluations showing throughput improvements up to 1.31 times under tested workloads.

2610.07098.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

tacker.title_zh: Tacker：兼顾服务质量的 Tensor Core 与 CUDA Core 内核融合

background.zh: 同卡任务共享可提高 GPU 利用率，但传统调度主要关注 CUDA Core，未充分利用异构计算单元并行。
background.en: GPU co-location can improve utilization, but traditional scheduling focuses on CUDA cores and underuses parallel execution across different compute-unit types.

challenge.zh: 融合任务可能影响延迟敏感应用，需要预测融合时长并在吞吐收益与服务质量预算间做选择。
challenge.en: Fusing tasks can delay latency-critical applications, requiring duration prediction and decisions that balance throughput improvement against available quality-of-service headroom.

method.zh: 组合 Tensor-CUDA 内核融合器、融合时长预测器和服务质量感知管理器，动态选择融合或原始内核。
method.en: Tacker combines a Tensor-CUDA kernel fuser, fused-duration predictor, and QoS-aware manager that chooses between fused execution and the original kernels.

result.zh: 作者报告在满足延迟敏感任务服务质量的同时，尽力而为应用吞吐相对比较方案平均提高 18.6%。
result.en: The authors report an average 18.6% throughput improvement for best-effort applications over compared solutions while maintaining latency-critical quality-of-service requirements.

tacker.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2510.14719.title_zh: Tawa：基于异步引用的自动 warp 专门化

background.zh: 现代 GPU 具有专门计算和搬运单元，但传统 SIMT 编程难以直接表达高性能异步数据流。
background.en: Modern GPUs contain specialized compute and data-movement units, while conventional SIMT programming does not directly express efficient asynchronous dataflow execution.

challenge.zh: 手工安排生产消费 warp、同步与软件流水复杂且易错，需要让编译器从高层程序生成这些安排。
challenge.en: Manually coordinating producer-consumer warps, synchronization, and software pipelines is complex, motivating compiler generation from higher-level tile-based programs.

method.zh: 引入异步引用中间表示，自动划分生产者和消费者角色，生成通信与流水同步代码实现 warp 专门化。
method.en: Tawa introduces asynchronous-reference IR, automatically partitions producer-consumer roles, and generates the communication and synchronization needed for warp-specialized execution.

result.zh: 作者在 H100 测试中报告接近或超过部分手工优化内核的性能，同时显著减少开发者的低层代码负担。
result.en: H100 evaluations approach or exceed selected hand-optimized kernels while reducing the low-level programming effort required to produce high-performance specialized code.

2510.14719.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

turbobus.title_zh: TurboBus：通过扩展互联共享 PCIe 带宽

background.zh: LLM 卸载把瓶颈移到 GPU 与 CPU 传输，但任务的突发传输模式会让其他 PCIe 链路闲置。
background.en: LLM offloading shifts bottlenecks to GPU-CPU transfers, yet bursty workload phases can leave other PCIe links idle at the same time.

challenge.zh: 单条链路拥塞与整体带宽闲置同时存在，需要跨任务借用链路而不破坏隔离或占用过多中继显存。
challenge.en: Individual links can bottleneck while aggregate bandwidth remains unused, requiring cross-job sharing without violating isolation or consuming excessive relay-GPU memory.

method.zh: 通过邻接 GPU 中继池化 PCIe 带宽，结合细粒度分配、双向传输及兼顾公平和完成时间的调度。
method.en: TurboBus pools PCIe bandwidth through relay GPUs, using fine-grained allocation, bidirectional transfers, and size-aware scheduling that balances fairness with completion time.

result.zh: 作者报告模型加载首 token 延迟最高降低四成、卸载推理吞吐最高提升 1.6 倍，共驻开销低于 1%。
result.en: The authors report up to forty percent lower loading latency and 1.6-fold offloaded-inference throughput, with less than one percent overhead on co-located jobs.

turbobus.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2512.18134.title_zh: Twill：联合优化软件流水与 warp 专门化

background.zh: 张量核 GPU 需要协调通用核心、矩阵单元和搬运单元，高性能执行依赖精细的软件调度。
background.en: Tensor-core GPUs require coordination across general-purpose cores, matrix units, and data movement, making sophisticated scheduling essential for high hardware utilization.

challenge.zh: 软件流水与 warp 专门化相互影响，传统启发式或人工设计难以系统探索其组合调度空间。
challenge.en: Software pipelining and warp specialization interact, making their combined schedule space difficult to explore systematically with compilation heuristics or manual intuition.

method.zh: 将两种变换统一为资源约束优化问题，使用通用约束求解器为支持的循环程序生成最优调度。
method.en: Twill formulates both transformations as one constrained optimization problem and uses standard solvers to derive optimal schedules for supported iterative programs.

result.zh: 作者重现两代 GPU 上专家设计的 FlashAttention 调度并证明其模型内最优，保证受程序和资源模型限定。
result.en: The authors rediscover expert FlashAttention schedules on Hopper and Blackwell and prove optimality within the supported program class and resource model.

2512.18134.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

background.zh: 机器学习预测可以帮助统计分析减少标注需求，但最终推断仍需要可靠地反映真实数据的不确定性。
background.en: Machine-learning predictions can reduce labeling requirements in statistical analysis, but final inference must still reliably capture uncertainty about the underlying data.

challenge.zh: 固定或非自适应标注分配浪费有限预算，而按模型选择样本可能破坏传统置信区间的有效性。
challenge.en: Fixed or nonadaptive labeling wastes limited budgets, while selecting observations using a model can invalidate confidence intervals constructed without accounting for selection.

method.zh: 方法优先标注模型不确定的样本，并以预测辅助、采样概率校正的估计构造置信区间与检验。
method.en: The method prioritizes uncertain examples for labeling and combines prediction-assisted estimation with sampling-probability corrections to construct confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.

result.zh: 理论保证推断有效性，公共舆论、人口统计和蛋白质组学实验显示同等标注预算下更高统计效率。
result.en: Theory establishes valid inference, while experiments in public opinion, census analysis, and proteomics show improved statistical efficiency under the same labeling budget.

2311.14768.title_zh: AdaDiff：面向快速扩散模型的自适应步数选择

background.zh: 文本条件的复杂度不同，使用统一去噪步数会让简单生成请求承担不必要的扩散计算成本。
background.en: Text prompts differ in complexity, so assigning a fixed number of denoising steps can impose unnecessary diffusion computation on simpler generation requests.

challenge.zh: 按请求减少步数必须平衡推理时间与图像或视频质量，不能仅依赖统一的全局加速设置。
challenge.en: Reducing steps per request requires balancing inference time against image or video quality rather than relying solely on a universal acceleration setting.

method.zh: 方法以策略梯度训练轻量步数选择器，根据输入文本为每个实例选择适合的去噪步数。
method.en: The method trains a lightweight step-selection policy using policy gradients, selecting an instance-specific denoising budget conditioned on the input text.

result.zh: 图像与视频基准显示在接近固定步数基线质量时推理更快，并可结合其他扩散加速方法。
result.en: Image and video benchmarks show faster inference at quality close to fixed-step baselines, with additional gains when combined with other diffusion acceleration methods.

2610.22263.title_zh: 策略梯度估计中的基线与分数中心化

background.zh: 语言模型后训练常用重要性采样校正策略差异，但实际实现通常还会裁剪、截断或屏蔽概率比。
background.en: Language-model post-training uses importance sampling to correct policy differences, but practical implementations commonly clip, truncate, or mask the resulting probability ratios.

challenge.zh: 正则化概率比会破坏奖励平移不变性，使组均值基线和分数中心化的作用不再可以混同。
challenge.en: Regularizing probability ratios breaks reward-shift invariance, so group-mean baselines and score centering cannot be treated as interchangeable correction mechanisms.

method.zh: 论文将估计目标表述为奖励与加权分数的协方差，分别分析序列级和标记级重要性采样。
method.en: The paper expresses the estimand as covariance between rewards and importance-weighted scores, analyzing sequence-level and token-level importance sampling separately.

result.zh: 分析给出两类中心化的不同方差与偏差性质，并说明其是否应联合使用取决于采样粒度。
result.en: The analysis establishes distinct variance and bias properties for the two centering methods and shows that combining them depends on importance-sampling granularity.

2610.28409.title_zh: 让多轮智能体适应任意测试预算的奖励设计

background.zh: 多轮智能体需要在有限标记、工具调用或环境步数内完成任务，并根据用户预算分配交互资源。
background.en: Multi-turn agents must complete tasks within token, tool-call, or environment-step budgets and distribute interaction resources according to user-specified limits.

challenge.zh: 仅优化任务成功或依赖外部硬限制，不能确保智能体主动遵守预算并适应未见过的资源约束。
challenge.en: Optimizing only task success or imposing external limits does not ensure that agents voluntarily obey budgets or adapt to previously unseen resource constraints.

method.zh: 论文在统一训练流程中比较多种超支惩罚奖励，让单个策略在不同预算值下学习跨轮次资源分配。
method.en: The paper compares multiple overspending penalties in a shared training pipeline, teaching individual policies to allocate resources across turns under varying budget values.

result.zh: 实验显示预算内成功与自然合规改善，但不同惩罚在成功率、超支频率和幅度之间存在取舍。
result.en: Experiments show improved within-budget success and natural compliance, while different penalties trade off task success against the frequency and magnitude of overspending.

2609.32444.title_zh: CIS：重新审视语言模型强化学习中的训练推理不一致

background.zh: 强化学习的生成引擎与训练引擎可能对相同标记分配不同概率，影响使用轨迹进行策略更新的准确性。
background.en: Rollout and training engines can assign different probabilities to identical tokens, affecting the accuracy of policy updates computed from generated reinforcement-learning trajectories.

challenge.zh: 常规重要性采样可能具有较大方差，而统一裁剪又会对不同置信度的标记引入不均衡偏差。
challenge.en: Standard importance sampling can have large variance, while uniform clipping introduces uneven bias across tokens with different levels of model confidence.

method.zh: 方法以对数几率位移刻画引擎差异，按标记置信度校准截断阈值，并分析其误差与偏差。
method.en: The method characterizes engine differences through log-odds displacement, calibrates truncation according to token confidence, and analyzes the resulting error and bias.

result.zh: 多个混合专家模型与数学基准显示更好的平均表现，诊断分析表明低置信度标记的截断偏差较小。
result.en: Evaluations across mixture-of-experts models and math benchmarks report stronger average performance, with diagnostics showing reduced truncation bias for low-confidence tokens.

2503.14476.title_zh: DAPO：大规模开源语言模型强化学习系统

background.zh: 强化学习能够激发语言模型复杂推理能力，但关键训练细节缺失使高水平结果难以稳定复现。
background.en: Reinforcement learning can elicit complex language-model reasoning, but missing implementation and training details make strong results difficult to reproduce reliably.

challenge.zh: 大规模优化中的裁剪、采样、损失归一化和长输出处理相互作用，影响探索效率及训练稳定性。
challenge.en: Clipping, sampling, loss normalization, and long-response handling interact during large-scale optimization, affecting exploration efficiency and the stability of reinforcement-learning training.

method.zh: 方法结合解耦裁剪、动态采样、标记级策略损失与长输出奖励处理，并公开训练代码和整理数据。
method.en: The method combines decoupled clipping, dynamic sampling, token-level policy loss, and long-response reward handling, releasing training code and curated data.

result.zh: 作者以公开基础模型在数学竞赛基准上报告较强成绩，并提供支撑复现的大规模强化学习组件。
result.en: The authors report strong mathematical-competition benchmark results from an openly available base model and release components supporting reproducible large-scale reinforcement-learning experiments.

2305.13301.title_zh: 使用强化学习训练扩散模型

background.zh: 扩散模型通常按似然相关目标训练，但用户更关心图像美感、提示一致性等下游任务目标。
background.en: Diffusion models are usually trained with likelihood-related objectives, while users care about downstream goals such as aesthetic quality and prompt-image alignment.

challenge.zh: 许多目标难以通过提示或监督数据直接表达，简单奖励加权似然也未充分利用逐步去噪结构。
challenge.en: Many objectives are difficult to express through prompts or supervised data, and simple reward-weighted likelihood does not fully exploit the sequential denoising process.

method.zh: 论文将去噪建模为多步决策问题，提出扩散策略优化，用策略梯度直接优化最终生成结果的奖励。
method.en: The paper formulates denoising as a multi-step decision process and introduces diffusion-policy optimization to directly optimize rewards on the final generated output.

result.zh: 实验实现压缩性、美感和视觉语言反馈驱动的提示一致性优化，展示无需额外人工标注的目标适配能力。
result.en: Experiments optimize compressibility, aesthetics, and prompt alignment using vision-language feedback, demonstrating adaptation to downstream objectives without requiring additional human annotation.

2601.18543.title_zh: GenAgent：通过智能体多模态推理扩展文本到图像生成

background.zh: 图像生成往往需要多轮检查和修改，视觉语言模型可以负责理解目标并调用专门的生成工具。
background.en: Image generation often requires repeated inspection and revision, allowing vision-language models to interpret goals and invoke specialized image-generation tools during refinement.

challenge.zh: 静态提示改写难以适应输出质量变化，而直接统一理解与生成又可能增加训练成本并引入能力取舍。
challenge.en: Static prompt rewriting cannot adapt to changing output quality, while fully unified understanding and generation can increase training costs and introduce capability tradeoffs.

method.zh: 框架先监督学习工具调用与反思，再结合最终图像和反思奖励进行智能体强化学习，支持多轮自主改进。
method.en: The framework first learns tool use and reflection through supervision, then applies agentic reinforcement learning with image-quality and reflection rewards for autonomous multiround improvement.

result.zh: 图像生成基准显示基础生成器表现提升，实验还展示跨工具泛化、多轮扩展和任务自适应推理。
result.en: Image-generation benchmarks show improved performance from the underlying generator, with experiments also demonstrating cross-tool generalization, multiround scaling, and task-adaptive reasoning.

2605.17969.title_zh: Generation Navigator：状态感知的图像生成智能体框架

background.zh: 准确实现用户图像意图常需要多轮试错，智能体应依据当前生成结果选择下一步引导动作。
background.en: Faithfully realizing image-generation intent often requires multiple attempts, motivating agents that choose their next steering action from the current generation state.

challenge.zh: 仅按单个状态或终局质量奖励整条轨迹，难以区分有效改进、质量退化与无收益的重复尝试。
challenge.en: Rewarding a whole trajectory from one state or final quality cannot distinguish useful improvements from degradation and repeated attempts that make no progress.

method.zh: 框架将生成视作状态条件动作决策，并用峰值、质量保持与效率组成的轨迹奖励训练多轮策略。
method.en: The framework treats generation as state-conditioned action selection and trains multiround policies with trajectory rewards for peak quality, retention, and efficiency.

result.zh: 多个生成与推理基准报告表现改善，说明同时衡量最佳结果、后续保持和轮次成本能改善生成引导。
result.en: Generation and reasoning benchmarks report improved performance, indicating benefits from jointly rewarding the best result, its subsequent retention, and efficient use of turns.

greensmith-variance-reduction.title_zh: 强化学习梯度估计的方差降低技术

background.zh: 部分可观测环境中的策略梯度需要依靠轨迹估计长期回报梯度，而样本方差会影响学习效率。
background.en: Policy gradient learning in partially observable environments estimates long-run reward gradients from trajectories whose variance can hamper learning.

challenge.zh: 常用平均回报基线或真实价值函数并不一定使梯度估计方差最小，需要明确其优化目标。
challenge.en: An average-reward baseline or true value-function critic need not minimize gradient-estimation variance, motivating a more precise analysis.

method.zh: 用控制变量统一分析 baseline 与 actor–critic，并结合样本规模及系统混合性质推导误差界和最优选择。
method.en: The authors analyze baselines and actor–critic methods as control variates, deriving error bounds and optimal choices using sampling and mixing properties.

result.zh: 理论说明常用基线和真实价值 critic 也可能次优，并给出估计最优基线与近似价值函数的方法。
result.en: The analysis shows that conventional baselines and even a true value-function critic can be suboptimal, and develops alternatives for variance reduction.

horvitz-thompson.title_zh: 有限总体不放回抽样的一般化方法

background.zh: 调查抽样常利用辅助信息，以不相等的入样概率从有限总体中不放回地选择观测对象。
background.en: Survey sampling often uses auxiliary information to select observations without replacement from a finite population with unequal inclusion probabilities.

challenge.zh: 直接对非均匀样本求和会偏向容易入样的对象，同时还需要估计抽样误差。
challenge.en: Unweighted aggregation favors frequently included units, while reliable inference also requires estimating sampling uncertainty.

method.zh: 利用已知入样概率的倒数加权构造总体量估计，并研究相应方差与两种具体抽样设计。
method.en: The method weights observed units by inverse inclusion probabilities and studies variance estimation together with two concrete sampling designs.

result.zh: 在所需入样概率条件下可得到无偏总体量估计，文中抽样设计也支持无偏的方差估计。
result.en: Under the required inclusion-probability conditions, the approach provides unbiased population-total estimation, with unbiased variance estimation for the discussed designs.

2503.05696.title_zh: 多保真控制变量策略梯度估计

background.zh: 真实环境或高精度仿真的交互样本昂贵，而简化仿真可以低成本提供大量相关但有偏的数据。
background.en: Real environments and high-fidelity simulators provide expensive interaction samples, while simplified simulators offer abundant, correlated but potentially biased data.

challenge.zh: 直接用低保真数据优化可能偏离目标环境，策略梯度又容易因高保真样本少而方差过大。
challenge.en: Direct optimization on low-fidelity data can miss the target environment, and scarce high-fidelity samples make policy-gradient estimates noisy.

method.zh: 把低保真梯度构造成控制变量，与有限目标环境数据组合，形成无偏且降低方差的策略梯度估计。
method.en: MFPG constructs a control variate from low-fidelity gradients and combines it with target-environment samples to obtain unbiased, variance-reduced policy-gradient estimates.

result.zh: 论文给出收敛分析，并在机器人基准中展示高保真样本效率及面对有害低保真数据的鲁棒性。
result.en: The paper provides convergence analysis and robotics experiments demonstrating improved high-fidelity sample efficiency and robustness when low-fidelity data becomes harmful.

2610.02505.title_zh: 多保真策略梯度稳定稀缺数据强化学习

background.zh: 高成本目标环境中稀少的真实轨迹使actor-critic梯度噪声较大，需要可靠利用便宜仿真数据。
background.en: Actor-critic learning with expensive target environments faces noisy gradients from scarce trajectories, motivating reliable use of inexpensive simulated experience.

challenge.zh: 把原始多保真估计直接移植到PPO可能破坏跨保真相关性，甚至让控制变量反而增加方差。
challenge.en: Naive extensions of multi-fidelity estimation to PPO can destroy cross-fidelity correlation or increase variance instead of reducing it.

method.zh: 重新设计采样、优势估计和控制变量，监测估计不确定性，并按固定预算分配高低保真样本。
method.en: MFPG-PPO redesigns sampling, advantage estimation and control variates, monitors uncertainty and allocates a fixed budget between high- and low-fidelity samples.

result.zh: 作者在最难仿真任务的小预算设置中匹配16倍高保真数据的PPO，并用每次更新4条真机轨迹学习。
result.en: On the hardest low-budget simulation setting it matches PPO using sixteen times more high-fidelity data, and learns with four real-robot episodes per update.

2606.01985.title_zh: MT-EditFlow：流匹配多轮图像编辑的强化学习

background.zh: 实际图像编辑包含多次连续指令，前一轮错误会改变后续观察并影响整条编辑轨迹的成功。
background.en: Practical image editing involves successive instructions, so errors in earlier rounds affect later observations and overall trajectory success.

challenge.zh: 只为单轮优化的模型容易产生错误传播，奖励聚合还会受到VLM偏差、方差及奖励投机影响。
challenge.en: Single-turn optimization struggles with error propagation, while reward aggregation introduces concerns about evaluator bias, variance and reward exploitation.

method.zh: 联合多种编辑奖励，并把整条轨迹的聚合优势广播给各轮流匹配更新以连接局部编辑与全局目标。
method.en: MT-EditFlow combines editing rewards and broadcasts trajectory-level aggregated advantages across turns, connecting local updates to overall multi-turn task success.

result.zh: 作者报告FLUX.1-Kontext-dev第三轮综合表现提升6.85分，并在多种基础模型上改善多轮编辑。
result.en: The authors report a 6.85-point improvement in third-turn overall performance for FLUX.1-Kontext-dev and improvements across several base models.

2507.06961.title_zh: 不可忽略缺失数据下的离策略评估

background.zh: 离策略评估使用历史策略采集的数据估计目标策略价值，但现实日志常存在与执行过程相关的缺失。
background.en: Off-policy evaluation estimates a target policy from logged behavior-policy data, but practical logs often contain execution-related missing observations.

challenge.zh: 若缺失概率与未观察信息有关，简单删除缺失记录会产生价值偏差，并影响估计的不确定性。
challenge.en: When missingness depends on unobserved information, discarding incomplete records can bias policy values and invalidate uncertainty estimates derived from them.

method.zh: 分析单调缺失下的可忽略与不可忽略机制，构造逆概率加权价值估计并提供统计推断。
method.en: The paper analyzes monotone missingness and constructs an inverse-probability-weighted value estimator with statistical inference under informative missing-data mechanisms.

result.zh: 理论区分了两类缺失机制的偏差，数值实验显示加权估计在缺失数据下提供更可靠的价值推断。
result.en: Theoretical results distinguish missingness-induced bias, and numerical experiments show more reliable policy-value inference with the proposed weighted estimator.

2609.36830.title_zh: PACE：异步RL中的生成池感知陈旧度控制

background.zh: 完全异步RL重叠生成与策略更新以提高利用率，但轨迹在生成和等待期间都会累积策略陈旧度。
background.en: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning overlaps generation with optimization, but trajectories accumulate policy lag during both generation and subsequent queueing.

challenge.zh: 只统计跨越的版本数会过度惩罚长轨迹或中断轨迹，固定拒收规则也忽略完成池的拥塞变化。
challenge.en: Raw version counts can unfairly penalize long or interrupted trajectories, while fixed rejection rules ignore changes in completed-rollout pool pressure.

method.zh: 区分生成与等待陈旧度，按前缀和池状态估计有效滞后，并自适应分配拒收预算与轨迹优先级。
method.en: PACE separates generation and waiting staleness, estimates effective lag with prefix information and adapts rejection budgets to pool conditions.

result.zh: 作者报告相同时间预算下准确率优于未过滤异步RL，并以少47.1%的GPU时间匹配同步RL表现。
result.en: The authors report improved accuracy over unfiltered asynchronous RL and matching synchronous performance with 47.1% less GPU time in evaluated settings.

background.zh: 策略梯度通过环境交互更新策略，但每批数据的利用效率、实现复杂度和优化稳定性需要共同权衡。
background.en: Policy-gradient methods learn through interaction, requiring a balance between sample reuse, implementation complexity and the stability of policy updates.

challenge.zh: 传统方法常对每个样本只更新一次，而信赖域方法虽控制更新幅度，却引入较复杂的优化流程。
challenge.en: Standard methods often update once per sample, while trust-region approaches control update size through comparatively complicated optimization procedures.

method.zh: PPO采用受约束的代理目标，以概率比裁剪或KL惩罚支持同一批数据上的多轮小批量优化。
method.en: PPO uses constrained surrogate objectives, implemented through probability-ratio clipping or KL penalties, to support multiple minibatch optimization epochs per rollout batch.

result.zh: 作者在机器人运动和Atari任务上展示较好的样本效率、实现简洁性与训练时间平衡。
result.en: Experiments on robotic locomotion and Atari tasks demonstrate a favorable balance of sample efficiency, implementation simplicity and wall-clock training time.
