reinforce.title_zh: 连接主义强化学习的统计梯度跟随算法

background.zh: 包含随机单元的神经网络需要仅凭动作反馈学习策略，即使奖励函数本身不能直接进行微分。
background.en: Neural networks containing stochastic units need learning rules driven by action feedback, even when the reward function itself is not differentiable.

challenge.zh: 学习规则必须把随机输出与回报联系起来，使局部权重调整在期望上朝改善奖励的方向移动。
challenge.en: Local weight changes must connect stochastic outputs to rewards so that expected updates improve the objective without differentiating environmental feedback.

method.zh: REINFORCE建立基于随机单元输出和奖励的梯度跟随算法族，并讨论与反向传播结合的方式。
method.en: REINFORCE develops a family of statistical gradient-following rules using stochastic-unit outputs and rewards, including integration with ordinary backpropagation.

result.zh: 论文证明适用即时奖励及部分延迟奖励任务的期望更新性质，奠定后续策略梯度方法的基础。
result.en: The paper establishes expected-update properties for immediate and selected delayed-reward settings, providing foundations for subsequent policy-gradient learning algorithms.

2511.08991.title_zh: 主动统计推断中的稳健采样

background.zh: 主动统计推断根据模型不确定性选择人工标注或高成本样本，以提高有限采样预算的估计效率。
background.en: Active statistical inference uses uncertainty estimates to allocate expensive labels or measurements and improve estimation under a limited sampling budget.

challenge.zh: 不准确的不确定性分数可能使主动采样方差高于均匀采样，导致本应节省样本的方法反而不稳。
challenge.en: Poor uncertainty scores can make active sampling noisier than uniform sampling, undermining the reliability of an otherwise sample-efficient procedure.

method.zh: 通过稳健优化在均匀与主动采样之间自适应插值，并让混合程度依赖不确定性估计的质量。
method.en: The paper uses robust optimization to interpolate between uniform and active sampling according to the quality of uncertainty estimates.

result.zh: 论文给出不劣于均匀采样的估计保证，并在社会科学和调查研究数据上展示实际收益。
result.en: It provides guarantees relative to uniform sampling and demonstrates practical benefits on datasets from computational social science and survey research.

2610.22282.title_zh: 在线扩散强化学习的路由策略优化

background.zh: 在线扩散RL需要生成不同候选探索奖励空间，但传统随机采样和策略优化可能带来较高训练成本。
background.en: Online diffusion RL needs diverse candidates to explore reward space, but conventional stochastic sampling and optimization can be computationally expensive.

challenge.zh: 训练阶段引入的随机性需要提供有效梯度，同时避免要求推理阶段继续保留同样的稀疏路由。
challenge.en: Training-time randomness must provide useful gradients without requiring inference to retain the same sampled sparse-attention routing structure.

method.zh: 将注意力路由作为探索动作，使用共享提示和初始噪声的成对rollout奖励差，并优化稠密速度代理。
method.en: RPO explores through sampled attention routes and controlled paired rollouts, using shared prompts and initial noise to construct reward-difference advantages.

result.zh: 作者在图像和视频任务中报告质量改善与接近四倍训练效率，推理恢复稠密注意力和原确定性采样。
result.en: The authors report improved image and video quality with nearly fourfold training efficiency, while inference restores dense attention and deterministic sampling.

2610.22282.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2609.14636.title_zh: STRIDE：何时停止、从何重启多轮智能体在线蒸馏

background.zh: 在线策略蒸馏依赖学生 rollout，复杂多轮交互使自回归生成成本随轨迹长度快速增加。
background.en: On-policy distillation depends on student rollouts, and autoregressive generation becomes increasingly expensive as multi-turn interactive trajectories grow longer.

challenge.zh: 教师信号的可靠性随前缀和错误动作变化，固定截断预算无法有效保留最有价值的监督。
challenge.en: Teacher-signal reliability varies across prefixes and after erroneous actions, so fixed truncation budgets may discard useful supervision or retain uninformative continuation.

method.zh: 根据累计教师对数概率提前停止低可靠轨迹，缓存优质前缀并从最弱正确回合重新展开。
method.en: STRIDE stops unreliable rollouts using cumulative teacher log-probability and reuses strong prefixes to restart generation at the weakest correct turn.

result.zh: 作者在多轮任务与数学补充测试中报告保持或改善蒸馏效果的同时加速，但方法会改变采样与停止协议。
result.en: Agentic and supplementary mathematics evaluations retain or improve distillation performance while accelerating training, with changes to rollout sampling and stopping behavior.

2609.14636.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2606.11119.title_zh: TRACE：高效智能体强化学习的统一 rollout 预算分配

background.zh: 可验证奖励强化学习依赖成功失败对比，过易或过难提示及整轨迹终局奖励可能提供很弱训练信号。
background.en: Verifiable-reward learning needs contrasting outcomes, but very easy or difficult prompts and trajectory-level rewards can provide weak policy-update signals.

challenge.zh: 只在提示层分配预算忽略了不同回合前缀的信息量，需要把有限采样投入更有区分度的继续生成。
challenge.en: Allocating budget only across prompts overlooks informative intermediate turns, requiring selective continuation from prefixes likely to produce contrasting terminal outcomes.

method.zh: 预测根提示与回合前缀的条件成功率，将 rollout 预算分配给更可能产生混合奖励的树形展开。
method.en: TRACE predicts conditional success at prompts and turn prefixes, allocating rollout budgets to tree expansions expected to yield mixed terminal rewards.

result.zh: 作者在相同采样成本下报告多项智能体收益，Qwen3-14B 多跳问答平均准确率较比较基线提高 2.8 点。
result.en: At equal sampling cost, the authors report agentic-task gains, including a 2.8-point average multi-hop QA accuracy improvement for Qwen3-14B over compared baselines.

2606.11119.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2410.01679.title_zh: VinePPO：改进语言模型强化学习的信用分配

background.zh: 复杂推理通常在多步之后才获得奖励，正确判断中间步骤贡献对于有效强化学习十分重要。
background.en: Complex reasoning often receives rewards only after many decisions, making accurate attribution of intermediate-step contributions important for effective reinforcement learning.

challenge.zh: PPO 的价值网络可能无法可靠区分候选推理步骤，其估值误差会影响学习信号和泛化。
challenge.en: PPO value networks can struggle to distinguish alternative reasoning steps reliably, and their estimation errors may weaken learning signals and generalization.

method.zh: 利用语言环境可从前缀继续采样的特点，以无偏蒙特卡洛回报估计改进步骤信用分配。
method.en: VinePPO exploits the ability to continue language trajectories from intermediate prefixes, using unbiased Monte Carlo return estimates for more accurate credit assignment.

result.zh: 作者在 MATH 和 GSM8K 上报告更好的准确率与训练效率，并在相同训练准确率下获得更强测试泛化。
result.en: On MATH and GSM8K, the authors report better accuracy and training efficiency, with stronger test generalization at comparable training accuracy levels.

2410.01679.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

2609.25297.title_zh: 纠正优先经验回放中的组内自选择偏差

background.zh: 优先经验回放集中学习高误差转移，但随机环境中同一状态动作可能产生不同概率的真实结果。
background.en: Prioritized experience replay focuses learning on high-error transitions, but identical state-action pairs can produce outcomes with different probabilities in stochastic environments.

challenge.zh: 按已实现误差选择样本会扭曲同组结果频率，从而改变贝尔曼目标均值并影响学习效率。
challenge.en: Selecting transitions by realized error can distort within-group outcome frequencies, altering mean Bellman targets and consequently affecting the efficiency of learning.

method.zh: 方法分离组间优先分配与组内结果选择，以均匀同组采样、目标平均或经验结果模型校正偏差。
method.en: The method separates group-level priority allocation from within-group outcome selection, correcting bias through uniform sibling sampling, target averaging, or empirical outcome models.

result.zh: 实验显示校正有助于包含稀有大幅结果的学习任务，但调参会缩小部分差距，近似分组也有适用边界。
result.en: Experiments show benefits in tasks with rare high-magnitude outcomes, while matched tuning narrows some differences and approximate grouping introduces practical applicability limits.

accuracy-congestion.title_zh: 服务拥塞下的判断准确性

background.zh: 服务人员收集更多信息可以改善判断，但额外时间也会延迟队列中其他客户获得服务。
background.en: Collecting more information can improve a provider's judgment, but the additional time delays service for other customers waiting in the queue.

challenge.zh: 系统必须动态权衡单次判断的准确性收益与拥塞成本，而两者关系可能随信息质量变化。
challenge.en: The system must dynamically balance the accuracy gains of individual decisions against congestion costs, with interactions that change as information quality varies.

method.zh: 论文将判断建模为连续获取概率线索的过程，研究拥塞相关的最优停止策略与简单启发式。
method.en: The paper models judgment as sequential acquisition of probabilistic cues and analyzes congestion-dependent optimal stopping policies alongside simpler decision heuristics.

result.zh: 理论结果表明最优线索上限随拥塞增加而下降，并揭示信息更准确未必改善系统整体表现。
result.en: The analysis shows that optimal cue limits decrease with congestion and identifies cases where more accurate information does not improve overall system performance.

accuracy-congestion.review_note: Venue not independently confirmed from a publication record; retain the source record without inferring acceptance.

akella-kumar.title_zh: 易故障制造系统中的最优生产速率控制

background.zh: 易故障生产设备需要在持续需求下管理库存，同时承担产品积压与缺货产生的不同成本。
background.en: Failure-prone manufacturing equipment must manage inventory under constant demand while incurring different costs for excess stock and unmet customer requirements.

challenge.zh: 随机设备故障与连续库存动态共同作用，使无限时间范围的最优生产控制具有不连续和奇异性。
challenge.en: Random equipment failures interact with continuous inventory dynamics, introducing discontinuities and singular behavior into the infinite-horizon optimal production-control problem.

method.zh: 论文将系统写成带跳变马尔可夫扰动的控制模型，通过构造候选策略并严格验证获得最优解。
method.en: The paper models production as a controlled system with jump-Markov disturbances and derives an optimal policy through constructive analysis followed by rigorous verification.

result.zh: 最优策略由一个库存阈值决定，分别选择停止、最大速率或恰好满足需求，并给出阈值表达式。
result.en: The optimal policy uses one inventory threshold to choose zero production, maximum production, or demand-matching production, with an explicit expression for the threshold.

dai-lin-max-pressure-2005.title_zh: 随机处理网络中的最大压力策略

background.zh: 制造、通信与服务系统需要把长期容量规划转化为能应对随机到达和离散作业的日常资源分配。
background.en: Manufacturing, communication, and service systems must translate long-term capacity planning into operational resource allocation that handles random arrivals and discrete jobs.

challenge.zh: 线性规划给出的容量目标本身不提供在线策略，而真实网络还可能具有多条路径与复杂服务约束。
challenge.en: Capacity targets obtained from linear programming do not themselves specify online policies, especially in networks with alternative routes and complex service constraints.

method.zh: 论文按本地及直接下游队列的压力动态分配服务容量，无需预先知道各类任务的到达速率。
method.en: The paper dynamically allocates service capacity using pressure from local and immediately downstream buffers, without requiring prior knowledge of task arrival rates.

result.zh: 在规定网络假设下证明最大吞吐性质，并给出部分网络中非抢占、不可分处理版本仍最优的条件。
result.en: Under stated network assumptions, the paper proves throughput optimality and identifies conditions where nonpreemptive, non-processor-splitting variants retain that guarantee.

dai-lin-max-pressure-2008.title_zh: 随机处理网络中最大压力策略的渐近最优性

background.zh: 随机处理网络在高负载下不仅需要保持稳定，还需要控制系统工作量和队列积压产生的成本。
background.en: Heavily loaded stochastic processing networks need not only stability but also control of total workload and costs associated with accumulated queue contents.

challenge.zh: 吞吐最优并不自动意味着持有成本最优，需要刻画重流量极限下多维队列的实际动态行为。
challenge.en: Throughput optimality does not automatically imply minimum holding cost, requiring analysis of multidimensional queue dynamics in the heavy-traffic limit.

method.zh: 论文在完全资源池化条件下证明状态空间塌缩和重流量极限定理，分析最大压力策略的优化性质。
method.en: Under complete resource pooling, the paper proves state-space collapse and heavy-traffic limit results to characterize the optimization properties of maximum-pressure policies.

result.zh: 结果证明工作量渐近最小，并为每种二次持有成本给出可渐近最小化该成本的最大压力策略。
result.en: The results establish asymptotic workload minimization and identify a maximum-pressure policy that asymptotically minimizes each specified quadratic holding-cost objective.

2012.11702.title_zh: 具有依赖图的协同流调度

background.zh: 数据并行任务通过多阶段协同流传输中间结果，后续计算必须等待具有依赖关系的传输完成。
background.en: Data-parallel jobs transfer intermediate results through multistage coflows, and subsequent computation depends on completion of the required communication stages.

challenge.zh: 只优化独立协同流会忽略任务级依赖，而一般有向无环依赖图使加权完成时间调度更加困难。
challenge.en: Optimizing isolated coflows ignores job-level dependencies, while general directed acyclic dependency graphs make scheduling for weighted completion time substantially harder.

method.zh: 论文为一般依赖图设计具有近似保证的多项式算法，并针对根树结构给出更强的近似结果。
method.en: The paper develops a polynomial-time scheduling algorithm with approximation guarantees for general dependency graphs and stronger guarantees for rooted-tree structures.

result.zh: 理论分析给出问题难度与最优性差距，真实流量轨迹仿真显示相比已有方案更短的任务完成时间。
result.en: Theoretical analysis establishes hardness and optimality gaps, while simulations using real traffic traces show shorter job completion times than prior approaches.

erlang-r.title_zh: Erlang-R：支持医疗人员配置的时变重入排队模型

background.zh: 患者可能在一次就诊中多次返回服务环节，而医疗需求随时间变化，因此人员配置需考虑重复服务。
background.en: Patients may return to service repeatedly during one visit, while healthcare demand varies over time, requiring staffing models that account for reentrant service.

challenge.zh: 稳态下可近似普通排队系统，但时变环境忽略重入过程会造成过度配置或服务水平下降。
challenge.en: Although steady-state behavior resembles simpler queues, ignoring reentrance under time-varying demand can cause excessive staffing or poor service levels.

method.zh: 论文建立两站开放排队网络，利用时变流体与扩散近似提出基于修正负载的平方根人员配置策略。
method.en: The paper develops a two-station open queueing network and uses time-varying fluid and diffusion approximations to derive staffing from modified offered load.

result.zh: 急诊常态与大规模伤亡场景验证模型价值，并给出人员配置策略在不同系统规模下的性能保证。
result.en: Validation in routine emergency care and mass-casualty settings demonstrates the model's value, with performance guarantees for staffing policies across different system sizes.

feng-liu-scheduling.title_zh: 具有输入误差与端到端截止期限的实时任务调度

background.zh: 实时应用可以把任务分成必需与可选计算，通过牺牲部分结果精度满足端到端时限。
background.en: Real-time applications can divide tasks into mandatory and optional computation, trading some output precision for the ability to meet end-to-end deadlines.

challenge.zh: 前序组件输出不精确可能增加后续计算时间，使各组件预算与最终误差之间形成相互依赖。
challenge.en: Imprecise outputs from earlier components can increase later processing times, creating dependencies between component time budgets and the final output error.

method.zh: 论文采用两层调度，先给组合任务分配处理时间，再在组件链内部优化预算以减少最终输出误差。
method.en: The paper uses two-level scheduling, first allocating processor time to composite tasks and then distributing each budget across components to minimize output error.

result.zh: 算法为带输入误差传播的组合任务提供预算分配方法，将端到端时限与结果精度纳入统一调度框架。
result.en: The algorithms provide budget allocation for composite tasks with propagated input error, integrating end-to-end deadlines and output precision within one scheduling framework.

johnson-flow-shop.title_zh: 包含准备时间的最优两阶段与三阶段生产排序

background.zh: 多道串行工序的作业顺序影响机器空闲与整批完工时间，是生产流水调度的经典问题。
background.en: Production jobs traverse ordered machines, making their sequence important for machine idleness and the overall time required to finish a batch.

challenge.zh: 作业须依次通过固定机器，仅优化单台机器的局部次序并不一定缩短全局完工时间。
challenge.en: Choosing locally short jobs does not necessarily minimize completion time when all jobs must follow the same fixed sequence of machines.

method.zh: 将准备时间纳入加工时间，建立两机器排序规则，并推广到满足特定条件的三机器情形。
method.en: The paper incorporates setup times into processing times and derives optimal sequencing rules for two machines and restricted three-machine cases.

result.zh: 论文证明相应模型中的最优排序结果，结论取决于机器数、处理时间和阶段顺序假设。
result.en: It establishes optimal sequencing results within specific production models, with applicability depending on machine counts, processing times and stage-order assumptions.

partial-predictions-scheduling.title_zh: 带部分预测的非预知调度

background.zh: 学习增强调度可借助作业长度预测，但现实中获取全部作业的可靠预测可能受到成本与数据限制。
background.en: Learning-augmented schedulers can exploit job-size predictions, but obtaining predictions for every job may be limited by cost or available data.

challenge.zh: 只拥有部分预测时，算法既要利用准确预测，也要避免预测错误破坏最坏情况下的表现。
challenge.en: With only partial predictions, algorithms must benefit from accurate advice without sacrificing robustness when the available predictions are wrong.

method.zh: 研究n个作业中只有B个长度预测的情形，构建下界及兼顾稳健性、一致性和平滑性的算法。
method.en: The paper studies schedules with predictions for only B of n jobs and develops bounds and algorithms balancing robustness, consistency and smoothness.

result.zh: 论文给出准确预测下的近最优界，并揭示有限预测预算造成的一致性与平滑性权衡。
result.en: It establishes near-optimal bounds under perfect predictions and identifies a consistency-smoothness tradeoff arising from the restricted prediction budget.

2509.19662.title_zh: 带进度条反馈的非预知调度

background.zh: 实际调度器通常无法事先知道作业时长，但运行过程中可能持续获得任务已完成比例的估计。
background.en: Practical schedulers rarely know job durations in advance, but may continuously receive estimates of how much work each job has completed.

challenge.zh: 进度反馈可能带有误差甚至具有对抗性，需要在不可靠信息下仍保证调度表现和渐近效率。
challenge.en: Progress feedback may be inaccurate or adversarial, requiring algorithms that retain performance guarantees while exploiting useful information when available.

method.zh: 把进度条形式化为持续反馈，分别研究对抗和随机模型，并设计调度算法组合的方法。
method.en: The paper formalizes continuous progress-bar feedback, studies adversarial and stochastic models and develops a general method for combining schedulers.

result.zh: 论文证明竞争界、改进部分学习增强调度保证，并在随机进度模型下给出渐近最优算法。
result.en: It proves competitive bounds, improves some learning-augmented scheduling guarantees and establishes an asymptotically optimal algorithm under its stochastic progress model.

production-of-service.title_zh: 服务的生产：从工作量角度分析互补与替代

background.zh: 多工位服务系统的质量投入既影响处理时间，也改变返工概率，因此局部省时未必减少总工作量。
background.en: Quality effort in multistation service systems affects both processing time and rework probability, so local speedups need not reduce total workload.

challenge.zh: 需要联合决定各工位质量目标，并刻画投入互补性、成本和容量约束对最优分配的影响。
challenge.en: Optimal coordination requires joint quality targets and a characterization of how complementarity, operating costs, and capacity limits affect effort allocation.

method.zh: 用布朗命中时间连接质量和处理时间，构建可达工作量区域，再求解双工位系统的努力成本最小化。
method.en: The model connects quality targets to Brownian hitting times, characterizes attainable workloads, and minimizes effort costs in a two-station rework network.

result.zh: 论文划分单站和双站最优区间，并用维护统计校准展示成本收益及参数误设鲁棒性；结论受模型假设约束。
result.en: The analysis identifies single-station and network regimes, with maintenance-based calibration demonstrating cost savings and robustness within the specified modeling assumptions.

production-of-service.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息已核对所列会议或期刊页面。

when-to-use-speedup.title_zh: 何时应该加快服务：具有返回需求的服务系统分析

background.zh: 服务人员可以在拥塞时加快处理速度，但较快服务可能增加返工和客户再次返回的概率。
background.en: Service providers can accelerate processing during congestion, but faster service may increase rework and the probability that customers require additional service later.

challenge.zh: 眼前队列缩短未必降低长期负载，系统状态、加速策略与返回概率之间可能形成不稳定反馈。
challenge.en: Shortening the current queue does not necessarily reduce long-term load, because system state, acceleration decisions, and return probabilities can create adverse feedback.

method.zh: 论文建立状态相关排队网络，以流体模型分析不同过载定义下加速服务对长期行为的影响。
method.en: The paper develops a state-dependent queueing network and uses fluid analysis to study how alternative overload definitions affect the long-term consequences of accelerated service.

result.zh: 分析给出适合临时加速及不应使用加速的条件，并揭示某些设置中两个平衡状态并存的现象。
result.en: The analysis identifies conditions favoring temporary acceleration and conditions where acceleration should be avoided, including settings with two coexisting equilibrium states.

2304.13705.title_zh: 利用低成本硬件学习精细双臂操作

background.zh: 精细双臂操作依赖视觉反馈与精确动作协调，传统实现通常需要昂贵机器人和高精度传感设备。
background.en: Fine-grained bimanual manipulation requires visual feedback and precise coordination, traditionally relying on expensive robots, accurate sensors, or carefully calibrated hardware.

challenge.zh: 低成本硬件存在精度限制，而模仿学习还面临动作误差累积和人类示范时序不一致的问题。
challenge.en: Low-cost hardware has limited precision, while imitation learning suffers from compounding action errors and temporal inconsistencies in human demonstrations.

method.zh: 系统结合低成本双臂遥操作平台与动作分块 Transformer，从真实示范学习连续动作序列的生成模型。
method.en: The system combines an affordable bimanual teleoperation platform with Action Chunking with Transformers, learning a generative model of action sequences from demonstrations.

result.zh: 作者在六类真实精细操作任务中展示较高成功率，说明少量示范可以支持低成本硬件执行复杂操作。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate strong success across six real-world fine-manipulation tasks, showing that limited demonstrations can enable complex behavior on low-cost hardware.

2209.07753.title_zh: Code as Policies：将语言模型程序用于具身控制

background.zh: 代码语言模型能够根据自然语言生成程序，可借助既有感知接口与控制原语组织机器人行为。
background.en: Code-capable language models can generate programs from natural language, allowing robot behavior to be composed from existing perception interfaces and control primitives.

challenge.zh: 机器人指令包含空间关系、反馈逻辑和含糊参数，仅把语言映射为固定技能序列难以完整表达。
challenge.en: Robot instructions contain spatial relations, feedback logic, and ambiguous parameters that are difficult to express through fixed sequences of predefined skills alone.

method.zh: 方法通过少样本示例生成可执行策略代码，并递归补齐辅助函数，调用数值库完成空间与几何推理。
method.en: The method generates executable policy code from few-shot examples, recursively defines helper functions, and uses numerical libraries for spatial and geometric reasoning.

result.zh: 多个真实机器人平台展示新指令泛化、反应式控制与精确参数设定，实际能力仍依赖底层感知和动作接口。
result.en: Demonstrations across real robot platforms show instruction generalization, reactive control, and precise parameter selection, with capabilities grounded in the available perception and action interfaces.

2609.14858.title_zh: Dream-RSI：通过演化的搜索世界实现递归自我改进

background.zh: 自动程序发现需要在候选分支之间分配有限尝试预算，而历史搜索记录包含可用于改进探索策略的信息。
background.en: Automated program discovery must allocate limited attempts across candidate branches, while historical search records contain information that can improve subsequent exploration strategies.

challenge.zh: 直接在线测试元策略成本高昂，离线回放又只能观察已记录分支，无法凭空验证未探索的结果。
challenge.en: Testing exploration strategies online is expensive, while offline replay can inspect only recorded branches and cannot validate outcomes of unexplored alternatives.

method.zh: 方法把历史发现组织为可回放搜索树，让固定模型修改探索调度代码，再将筛选后的策略部署回在线搜索。
method.en: The method organizes discoveries into replayable search trees, uses a fixed model to revise exploration code, and deploys selected strategies back into online search.

result.zh: 算法、数学和内核任务中报告更少发现调用及更好的预算效率，改进对象是搜索策略而非模型权重。
result.en: Algorithm, mathematics, and kernel tasks show fewer discovery calls and improved budget efficiency, with improvements targeting exploration strategies rather than model weights.

2602.15922.title_zh: DreamZero：世界动作模型也是零样本策略

background.zh: 视觉语言动作模型具有语义泛化能力，但在新环境中执行未见物理运动仍是机器人控制的重要难题。
background.en: Vision-language-action models generalize semantically, but performing unseen physical motions in new environments remains a major challenge for robot control policies.

challenge.zh: 多样机器人数据缺少重复示范，联合视频与动作建模还会引入实时闭环控制难以承受的推理开销。
challenge.en: Diverse robot data lacks repeated demonstrations, and jointly modeling video and actions introduces inference costs that can obstruct real-time closed-loop control.

method.zh: 模型以预训练视频扩散骨干联合预测未来世界状态和动作，并通过模型与系统优化加速闭环执行。
method.en: The model jointly predicts future world states and actions using a pretrained video-diffusion backbone, with model and system optimizations accelerating closed-loop execution.

result.zh: 真实机器人实验报告新任务泛化及跨本体迁移改善，并展示大型世界动作模型的实时控制能力。
result.en: Real-robot experiments report improved new-task generalization and cross-embodiment transfer, while demonstrating real-time control with a large world-action model.

2603.16666.title_zh: Fast-WAM：世界动作模型在测试时需要想象未来吗

background.zh: 世界动作模型通过视频建模学习物理演化，但许多方法在执行动作前还需昂贵地生成未来画面。
background.en: World-action models learn physical evolution through video modeling, but many methods also generate future observations at substantial computational cost before executing actions.

challenge.zh: 训练时的视频监督与测试时的显式未来生成作用混杂，使推理开销是否必要缺少受控实验证据。
challenge.en: Video supervision during training and explicit future generation during inference are intertwined, leaving limited controlled evidence about whether inference-time imagination is necessary.

method.zh: 方法保留视频协同训练而跳过测试时未来预测，并构建多种变体分别比较两项因素的贡献。
method.en: The method retains video co-training while skipping future prediction at inference, constructing variants that separately measure the contributions of both factors.

result.zh: 仿真和真机实验显示省略未来生成仍具竞争力，而移除视频训练损失更大，并显著降低推理延迟。
result.en: Simulation and real-robot experiments show competitive performance without future generation, larger losses when video training is removed, and substantially reduced inference latency.

background.zh: 流生成模型能够表达复杂连续动作分布，但将其用于强化学习通常需要处理难计算的动作似然。
background.en: Flow-based generative models represent complex continuous action distributions, but reinforcement-learning optimization typically faces difficulties computing the required action likelihoods.

challenge.zh: 把训练绑定到特定扩散采样器限制灵活性，精确概率比计算也妨碍将流策略接入常用策略优化。
challenge.en: Binding training to a particular diffusion sampler reduces flexibility, while exact probability-ratio computation complicates integration with commonly used policy-optimization algorithms.

method.zh: 方法用条件流匹配损失构造优势加权比例代理，并结合 PPO 式裁剪，使训练不依赖特定采样器。
method.en: The method constructs an advantage-weighted ratio surrogate from conditional flow-matching losses and applies PPO-style clipping without binding training to a specific sampler.

result.zh: 连续控制与人体跟踪实验展示多模态动作建模优势，尤其适合欠充分条件；代理比例并非精确动作概率比。
result.en: Continuous-control and human-tracking experiments show benefits from multimodal actions, especially under limited conditioning, while the surrogate ratio remains distinct from an exact likelihood ratio.

gaponet.title_zh: GAPONet：通过学习非线性算子弥合人形机器人动力学仿真现实差距

background.zh: 仿真与真实人形机器人的关节动力学存在偏差，负载变化会进一步影响轨迹跟踪和动作控制精度。
background.en: Joint dynamics differ between simulated and real humanoid robots, and changing payloads further affect trajectory tracking and action-control accuracy.

challenge.zh: 简单固定修正难以覆盖历史状态、关节类型与不同负载共同决定的非线性动力学误差。
challenge.en: Simple fixed corrections struggle to capture nonlinear dynamics errors determined jointly by historical states, joint identity, and differing payload conditions.

method.zh: 方法基于非线性算子网络处理历史关节状态、目标和载荷，预测叠加到名义控制上的动作修正。
method.en: The method uses a nonlinear operator network over joint histories, targets, and payloads to predict action corrections added to nominal control commands.

result.zh: 留出动作与多负载评估显示关节跟踪改善，证据集中于指定平台的控制任务，尚非通用具身策略验证。
result.en: Held-out motion and payload evaluations show improved joint tracking, with evidence concentrated on the specified platform rather than validation of a general embodied policy.

gaponet.review_note: Public author manuscript is available; submission labeling alone does not establish acceptance.

2609.05588.title_zh: GE-Act 2.0：机器人操作世界动作模型的预训练与扩展

background.zh: 世界动作模型利用未来视觉状态指导动作，但其控制表示、预训练数据规模和跨本体扩展仍需系统研究。
background.en: World-action models guide actions through predicted future visual states, but their control representations, pretraining scale, and cross-embodiment scaling require systematic investigation.

challenge.zh: 生成的合理未来未必与示教动作兼容，过度视觉压缩也可能丢失控制和指令相关信息。
challenge.en: A plausible generated future may be incompatible with demonstrated actions, and aggressive visual compression can discard information needed for control and instruction grounding.

method.zh: 模型结合控制导向编码器、单步视觉规划器和逆动力学，并按动作兼容性筛选未来状态进行联合优化。
method.en: The model combines a control-oriented autoencoder, single-step visual planner, and inverse dynamics, selecting action-compatible predicted futures during joint optimization.

result.zh: 两个机器人本体的真实任务评估显示数据扩展带来零样本任务表现提升，同时展示跨本体迁移与指令遵循。
result.en: Real-task evaluations on two robot embodiments show improved zero-shot performance as training data scales, alongside cross-embodiment transfer and instruction-grounding capabilities.

2412.08442.title_zh: GEA：从多模态语言模型到通用具身智能体的方法与经验

background.zh: 多模态语言模型具备视觉语义知识，但机器人、游戏和界面控制需要将这些知识映射为不同动作空间。
background.en: Multimodal language models provide visual-semantic knowledge, but robotics, games, and interface control require mapping that knowledge into different embodiment-specific action spaces.

challenge.zh: 跨领域观测与连续、离散动作难以统一，单一领域监督也不足以训练具有广泛迁移能力的策略。
challenge.en: Cross-domain observations and continuous or discrete actions are difficult to unify, and single-domain supervision is insufficient for broadly transferable control policies.

method.zh: 模型采用跨本体动作标记器，在多领域成功轨迹上监督学习，再结合交互模拟器中的在线强化学习。
method.en: The model uses a cross-embodiment action tokenizer, learns from successful trajectories across domains, and incorporates online reinforcement learning in interactive simulators.

result.zh: 多种具身、游戏和界面基准显示跨域训练与在线交互的价值，但结果不等于任意真机零样本控制。
result.en: Embodied, game, and interface benchmarks demonstrate benefits from cross-domain training and online interaction, without establishing zero-shot control of arbitrary real robots.

2410.04444.title_zh: Gödel Agent：递归自我改进的自指智能体框架

background.zh: 大语言模型智能体能执行复杂任务，但其工作流与优化规则通常仍由开发者预先固定。
background.en: Large language model agents perform complex tasks, but developers commonly fix their workflows and optimization rules in advance.

challenge.zh: 固定组件限制了可搜索的智能体设计空间，使系统难以根据高层目标修改自身的推理与执行逻辑。
challenge.en: Fixed components restrict the searchable agent-design space and limit adaptation of reasoning and execution logic to high-level objectives.

method.zh: 允许语言模型在目标引导下递归修改自身逻辑和行为，以自指式程序演化替代固定优化流程。
method.en: Gödel Agent uses language models to recursively revise its own logic and behavior under high-level objectives instead of a fixed optimization routine.

result.zh: 论文在多个任务领域报告性能、效率和泛化改进，实验中的自我改进不等于全局最优保证。
result.en: Multi-domain experiments report improved performance, efficiency and generalization, demonstrating empirical self-improvement rather than a guarantee of global optimality.

2604.14268.title_zh: HY-World 2.0：生成、重建与仿真的多模态三维世界模型

background.zh: 三维世界建模需要把文本、图像或视频转换成可探索、可重建并可用于仿真的场景表示。
background.en: Three-dimensional world modeling converts text, images or video into explorable scenes that support reconstruction and simulation.

challenge.zh: 高质量外观、跨视角几何一致性和可交互渲染需要贯通，单独的视频生成难以直接满足这些要求。
challenge.en: Visual quality, cross-view geometric consistency and interactive rendering must work together beyond what standalone video generation provides.

method.zh: 串联全景生成、轨迹规划、带记忆的世界扩展与三维合成，并用 WorldLens 支持 3DGS 渲染和交互。
method.en: The framework connects panorama generation, trajectory planning, memory-based world expansion and 3D composition, with WorldLens providing interactive 3DGS rendering.

result.zh: 论文报告多个基准中达到开源方法领先水平、可比 Marble 的效果，并释放权重、代码和技术细节。
result.en: The paper reports leading results among open-source methods on several benchmarks and performance comparable to Marble, alongside released models and code.

2606.01458.title_zh: LEGS：在具身高斯泼溅世界中微调无需遥操作的VLA

background.zh: 人形机器人移动操作的遥操作示范成本高，真实感仿真可提供更容易扩展的策略训练数据。
background.en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires expensive teleoperation demonstrations, motivating photorealistic simulation as a scalable source of training data for visual policies.

challenge.zh: 合成数据的视觉差异影响真实部署，场景与物体外观变化也会削弱示范训练策略的表现。
challenge.en: Visual differences impair transfer from synthetic demonstrations, while changing object appearances and scene backgrounds further challenge policy robustness.

method.zh: 在3D高斯泼溅环境自动生成示范，将机器人运动与场景外观解耦，以便重新渲染和增强数据。
method.en: LEGS automatically generates demonstrations in Gaussian-splatting environments and separates recorded motion from appearance, enabling re-rendering and augmentation across scene conditions.

result.zh: 作者报告覆盖新场景的成本低逾15倍，增强数据训练的策略在联合外观变化下仍保持成功。
result.en: The authors report over fifteenfold lower cost for covering new scenes and maintained task success under combined object and scene changes.

2606.01458.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2601.21998.title_zh: 用于机器人控制的因果世界建模

background.zh: 视频世界模型可以学习动作与视觉动态的联系，为机器人提供不同于语言预训练的能力基础。
background.en: Video world models learn relationships between actions and visual dynamics, offering robot learning a foundation distinct from vision-language pretraining.

challenge.zh: 未来视觉生成和动作预测必须同时兼顾因果关系与实时反馈，开放环执行容易积累偏差。
challenge.en: Future-frame generation and action prediction must respect temporal causality while incorporating fresh feedback, because open-loop execution can accumulate environmental mismatch.

method.zh: LingBot-VA用共享视觉动作潜空间和混合Transformer联合预测帧与动作，并采用闭环异步推理。
method.en: LingBot-VA jointly predicts frames and actions through a shared visual-action latent space and Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with asynchronous closed-loop inference.

result.zh: 论文在仿真和真实操作中展示长时任务、后训练数据效率与新配置泛化，并开放模型和代码。
result.en: Simulation and real-world evaluations demonstrate long-horizon manipulation, efficient post-training and generalization to novel configurations; model weights and code are released.

2601.21998.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2607.08639.title_zh: 面向可泛化机器人控制的原生视频动作预训练

background.zh: 视频动作模型常改造面向内容生成的骨干，但机器人需要语义理解、动作精度和高频反馈。
background.en: Video-action models often adapt content-generation backbones, whereas robot control requires semantic understanding, accurate actions and frequent incorporation of environmental feedback.

challenge.zh: 重建式视觉编码和双向预训练不完全符合因果物理过程，后续改造也可能造成能力遗忘。
challenge.en: Reconstruction-oriented tokenizers and bidirectional pretraining do not fully match causal physical processes, and later adaptation can forget previously acquired capabilities.

method.zh: 采用语义视觉动作tokenizer、从头因果预训练、稀疏MoE与接入最新观测的异步推理方案。
method.en: LingBot-VA2 combines semantic visual-action tokenization, causal pretraining from scratch, sparse experts and asynchronous inference grounded in the latest observations.

result.zh: 作者通过真实机器人部署展示复杂操作的少样本泛化，收益对应整套表示、模型和训练设计。
result.en: The authors demonstrate few-shot generalization on complex real-world manipulation tasks using the complete representation, model architecture and training design.

2607.08639.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

background.zh: 世界模型的长时预测需要较深计算，但直接增加网络深度会扩大参数成本并积累预测误差。
background.en: World models need substantial computation for long-horizon prediction, but directly increasing network depth expands parameter costs and can compound prediction errors.

challenge.zh: 固定深度为所有预测支付相同开销，难以根据环境状态复杂度灵活分配单步推理计算。
challenge.en: Fixed-depth models spend comparable computation on every prediction, limiting their ability to adapt inference effort to the complexity of individual states.

method.zh: 通过共享参数的Transformer模块反复更新环境潜状态，按预测复杂度自适应调整循环深度。
method.en: Looped World Models repeatedly refine latent environment states through a parameter-shared Transformer block and adapt computational depth to prediction complexity.

result.zh: 作者报告最高百倍参数效率并展示自适应潜空间计算，具体结论应限定于所评测的世界建模任务。
result.en: The authors report up to one hundredfold parameter efficiency and adaptive latent computation within the world-modeling tasks evaluated in the paper.

2606.18208.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2608.30821.title_zh: Lucida：可组合真实到仿真场景建模

background.zh: 机器人仿真需要把真实室内场景恢复成完整、可编辑且位置准确的独立对象资产集合。
background.en: Robot simulation benefits from reconstructing real indoor scenes as complete, editable object assets that preserve the observed arrangement.

challenge.zh: 解析、生成和放置的串行流程容易累积误差，前端要求完整几何也妨碍缺失部分的恢复。
challenge.en: Parsing, generation and placement pipelines can accumulate errors, while demanding complete geometry at the outset complicates recovery of unseen object parts.

method.zh: 先从视频建立含多视角证据的场景图，再生成对象资产，由VLM通过多轮GUI交互完成放置。
method.en: Lucida builds evidence-rich scene graphs, generates complete object assets and uses a vision-language policy for closed-loop, multi-turn GUI placement.

result.zh: 作者报告CA-1M姿态指标由57.8%提升至83.4%，并在检测和场景重建指标上获得改善。
result.en: The authors report CA-1M pose performance increasing from 57.8% to 83.4%, alongside improvements in object detection and scene reconstruction.

2608.30821.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2502.13130.title_zh: Magma：多模态AI智能体基础模型

background.zh: 多模态模型需要从图像和语言理解进一步扩展到数字界面与物理世界中的计划和行动。
background.en: Multimodal models must extend image and language understanding toward planning and action in both digital interfaces and physical environments.

challenge.zh: 普通视觉语言数据缺少动作落点和时序计划结构，直接混合不同智能体任务难以统一学习。
challenge.en: Standard vision-language data lacks explicit action grounding and temporal planning structure, complicating unified learning across diverse agent tasks.

method.zh: 以Set-of-Mark表达动作定位，用Trace-of-Mark组织动作计划，结合跨数字与物理场景数据预训练。
method.en: Magma uses Set-of-Mark for action grounding and Trace-of-Mark for planning, combining data from digital and physical environments during pretraining.

result.zh: 作者报告界面导航与机器人操作上的领先结果，并在图像和视频理解任务上保持有竞争力表现。
result.en: The authors report leading results on interface navigation and robotic manipulation while retaining competitive performance on image and video understanding tasks.

2609.06396.title_zh: MetaRSI：递归改进系统自身的元递归自改进

background.zh: 自我改进系统已能修改程序和生成训练数据，但现有证据主要来自可自动验证的封闭任务。
background.en: Self-improving systems can modify programs and generate training data, but existing evidence largely concerns closed tasks with automatically checkable outcomes.

challenge.zh: 数据、执行框架和模型参数的修改彼此影响，需要明确可组合操作与评价边界以组织改进循环。
challenge.en: Changes to data, execution scaffolds and model parameters interact, requiring explicit compositional rules and evaluation boundaries for organizing improvement loops.

method.zh: 将Data-RSI、Harness-RSI和Model-RSI建成统一循环上的三种操作，并联合调节操作次序和提案策略。
method.en: MetaRSI places Data-RSI, Harness-RSI and Model-RSI operators within one loop, jointly adapting their execution order and proposal policies.

result.zh: 作者在代码与封闭科学任务中评估无需外部教师的改进流程，开放领域能力仍是待检验方向。
result.en: The authors evaluate teacher-free improvement on coding and closed-form scientific tasks; broader open-domain capability remains a direction requiring further validation.

2609.06396.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

background.zh: 复杂机器人拥有高自由度与接触机制，需要准确且高效的仿真来支持控制与策略训练。
background.en: High-degree-of-freedom robots require accurate, efficient simulation of intricate dynamics and contacts to support policy learning and control.

challenge.zh: 纯解析模拟难以适应真实动力学偏差，现有神经模拟也常受长时稳定性和跨任务泛化限制。
challenge.en: Analytical simulators struggle with real-world mismatch, while neural alternatives face limitations in long-horizon stability and generalization across tasks.

method.zh: NeRD用以机器人为中心且空间不变的状态表示，替换解析模拟器中的低层动力学与接触求解器。
method.en: NeRD replaces low-level dynamics and contact solvers with neural models using robot-centric, spatially invariant state representations inside an existing simulator.

result.zh: 作者展示超过千步的稳定预测、跨场景泛化和纯神经引擎策略学习，并用真实数据微调缩小差距。
result.en: Experiments demonstrate stable thousand-step simulation, cross-configuration generalization, neural-engine policy learning and adaptation from real-world data to reduce simulation mismatch.

2508.15755.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2509.02322.title_zh: OmniActor：统一二维界面与三维具身世界的智能体

background.zh: 通用智能体需要在图形界面与物理环境间执行任务，但两类数据的表示与动作空间差异明显。
background.en: Generalist agents must act across graphical interfaces and physical environments, whose representations and action spaces differ substantially.

challenge.zh: 直接混合GUI和具身数据可能发生负迁移，浅层共享与深层冲突需要不同的参数处理方式。
challenge.en: Simply mixing GUI and embodied data can cause negative transfer because shallow representations benefit from sharing while deeper features conflict.

method.zh: 采用分层异构MoE共享浅层而分离深层参数，并统一动作空间、汇集跨场景训练数据。
method.en: OmniActor shares shallow layers and separates deeper parameters through heterogeneous experts, while unifying action spaces and collecting cross-domain training data.

result.zh: 作者报告OmniActor优于只训练单一场景的智能体，数据整合对GUI任务尤其带来改善。
result.en: The authors report improvements over agents trained on either domain alone, with particularly strong gains on graphical-interface tasks.

2509.02322.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2502.19645.title_zh: 微调VLA：联合优化推理速度与任务成功

background.zh: VLA通常需要适配新机器人与任务，但微调时的动作表示、解码方式和目标函数存在多种选择。
background.en: Vision-language-action models require adaptation to new robots and tasks, with many choices for action representation, decoding and learning objectives.

challenge.zh: 沿用预训练方案不一定兼顾高频控制与操作成功，逐token动作生成还可能限制推理吞吐。
challenge.en: Reusing pretraining recipes may compromise control frequency or success, and autoregressive action-token generation can restrict inference throughput.

method.zh: OFT结合并行动作解码、动作分块、连续动作表示与L1回归目标，系统比较各项设计。
method.en: OFT combines parallel action decoding, action chunking, continuous representations and an L1 regression objective, supported by systematic design comparisons.

result.zh: 作者报告LIBERO平均成功率由76.5%提升至97.1%，动作生成吞吐提高26倍，并验证真实双臂操作。
result.en: The authors report LIBERO success increasing from 76.5% to 97.1% and twenty-sixfold higher action throughput, alongside real-world bimanual evaluations.

2610.07922.title_zh: OpenWAM：可组合世界动作模型的开放框架

background.zh: 世界动作模型同时预测未来视觉与机器人动作，但现有方法常同时改变骨干、监督和推理流程。
background.en: World-action models predict future observations and robot actions, but existing approaches often change backbone, supervision and inference procedure simultaneously.

challenge.zh: 多个设计维度一起变化使方法难以公平比较，也不易分析反事实数据对正向和逆向动力学的价值。
challenge.en: Coupled design changes hinder fair comparisons and obscure how counterfactual data affects forward and inverse dynamics learning.

method.zh: 以共同因果视频骨干和混合Transformer支持联合、视频先行、动作先行及解耦生成方式。
method.en: OpenWAM uses a common causal video foundation and Mixture-of-Transformers architecture supporting joint, video-first, action-first and decoupled generation.

result.zh: 作者在四个留出LIBERO任务报告局部逆动力学平均成功率84%，并展示反事实监督的预测收益。
result.en: The authors report 84% mean success for local inverse dynamics on four held-out LIBERO tasks and benefits from counterfactual supervision.

2610.07922.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2509.15965.title_zh: RLinf：通过宏观到微观流转换实现高效RL训练

background.zh: 推理RL和具身RL具有不同组件与通信模式，训练框架需要同时支持灵活工作流和高资源效率。
background.en: Reasoning and embodied RL involve different components and communication patterns, requiring frameworks that combine flexible workflows with efficient resource utilization.

challenge.zh: 高层组合接口容易隐藏时空执行机会，而为每个场景手工重写并行计划又会降低可扩展性。
challenge.en: High-level composition hides temporal and spatial optimization opportunities, while manually redesigning parallel plans for every workload limits flexibility.

method.zh: M2Flow把高层工作流分解并重组为优化执行流，结合上下文切换、弹性流水和画像引导调度。
method.en: RLinf transforms macro workflows into optimized micro execution flows using context switching, elastic pipelines, adaptive communication and profiling-guided scheduling.

result.zh: 作者在推理与具身任务中报告端到端训练吞吐加速1.07至2.43倍，覆盖多种RL执行模式。
result.en: Across reasoning and embodied RL evaluations, the authors report end-to-end training throughput improvements ranging from 1.07 to 2.43 times.

2602.07837.title_zh: RLinf-USER：真实机器人在线策略学习的统一系统

background.zh: 真实环境在线学习需要同时协调机器人交互、经验存储和策略更新，并支持不同硬件与训练算法。
background.en: Real-world online policy learning must coordinate robot interaction, experience storage and policy updates across heterogeneous hardware and learning algorithms.

challenge.zh: 异构机器人和云边通信造成系统碎片化，长时间异步训练还需要可靠的持久数据管理。
challenge.en: Robot heterogeneity and cloud-edge communication fragment implementations, while prolonged asynchronous training requires reliable persistence and management of collected experience.

method.zh: 提供机器人硬件抽象、自适应通信、完全异步训练和持久缓存感知回放，并开放奖励及策略接口。
method.en: USER combines robot hardware abstractions, adaptive communication, fully asynchronous training and persistent cache-aware replay with extensible reward and policy interfaces.

result.zh: 作者在仿真和真机展示多机器人协同、异构机械臂、云边大模型训练及长时间异步运行。
result.en: Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate multi-robot coordination, heterogeneous manipulators, cloud-edge large-model training and sustained asynchronous policy-learning operation.

2607.14187.title_zh: RxBrain：联合语言视觉推理与想象的具身认知模型

background.zh: 具身规划需要把高层语言推理与未来物理状态联系起来，单独理解或生成难以完整表达行动计划。
background.en: Embodied planning connects high-level linguistic reasoning to future physical states, requiring more than isolated multimodal understanding or generation capabilities.

challenge.zh: 视频示范缺少统一的文本视觉计划监督，模型还需同时保持理解、生成和目标分解能力。
challenge.en: Video demonstrations lack aligned textual-visual planning supervision, and models must preserve understanding and generation while learning coherent subgoal decomposition.

method.zh: 把视频分解为规划步骤并对齐视觉状态转换，联合训练文本视觉计划，构建RxBrain-Bench评价。
method.en: RxBrain decomposes videos into planning steps aligned with visual transitions, jointly trains textual-visual plans and introduces a dedicated evaluation benchmark.

result.zh: 作者展示耦合文本推理与世界状态预测的计划，并在缺少大规模动作预训练时探索连续真机动作生成。
result.en: The authors demonstrate coupled reasoning and state-prediction plans and explore continuous real-robot action generation without large-scale action-data pretraining.

2607.14187.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2502.05171.title_zh: 以循环深度扩展测试时潜在推理计算

background.zh: 语言模型通常通过生成更多推理token增加测试时计算，而潜空间循环提供另一种计算扩展方式。
background.en: Language models often increase test-time computation by generating more reasoning tokens, while recurrent latent computation offers an alternative scaling mechanism.

challenge.zh: 显式思维链依赖较长文本上下文和特定训练数据，部分推理过程也未必容易用自然语言表达。
challenge.en: Explicit reasoning chains require longer text contexts and specialized supervision, and some reasoning processes may not be naturally expressed in words.

method.zh: 让模型重复执行共享循环模块，在测试时展开不同深度，从而以潜在状态迭代增加推理计算。
method.en: The model repeatedly applies a shared recurrent block, allowing different inference depths to increase computation through iterative latent-state processing.

result.zh: 作者训练3.5B参数和800B token模型，并报告随着循环计算增加，多项推理基准表现得到改善。
result.en: The authors train a 3.5-billion-parameter model on 800 billion tokens and report improved reasoning-benchmark performance as recurrent computation increases.

2303.17651.title_zh: Self-Refine：利用自反馈进行迭代改进

background.zh: 语言模型首次生成往往存在可改进之处，测试时反馈与重写可在不训练新模型的情况下提升输出。
background.en: Language models often produce imperfect first attempts, motivating feedback and revision at inference time without training a separate improvement model.

challenge.zh: 外部监督或额外奖励模型提高使用门槛，需要让同一模型同时承担生成、批评与修订任务。
challenge.en: External supervision or reward models increase implementation requirements, so one model must perform generation, critique and revision effectively.

method.zh: 让模型先生成答案，再产生自然语言反馈并按反馈重写，重复这个循环直到达到停止条件。
method.en: Self-Refine repeatedly generates an answer, produces natural-language feedback and revises the answer using that feedback until the specified stopping condition.

result.zh: 作者在七类任务上报告相对单次生成平均约20个百分点的性能改善，评价包含人工偏好和自动指标。
result.en: Across seven task families, the authors report approximately twenty percentage points of average improvement over single-pass generation using human and automatic evaluations.

2509.09674.title_zh: SimpleVLA-RL：通过强化学习扩展VLA训练

background.zh: VLA依赖大量人工机器人示范，监督微调在新任务和分布偏移下的泛化能力仍受数据限制。
background.en: Vision-language-action models rely on expensive human demonstrations, while supervised fine-tuning remains limited under task changes and distribution shifts.

challenge.zh: 扩展具身RL需要协调轨迹采样、多环境渲染、并行执行和动作策略损失，而非直接复用文本RL流水。
challenge.en: Scaling embodied RL requires coordinated trajectory sampling, environment rendering, parallel execution and policy losses beyond an unchanged text-RL pipeline.

method.zh: 基于veRL实现VLA专用采样、可扩展并行和损失优化，并加入增强探索的训练策略。
method.en: SimpleVLA-RL extends veRL with VLA-specific sampling, scalable parallelism, multi-environment rendering, optimized losses and exploration-enhancing training strategies.

result.zh: 作者在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实任务中报告改善，并观察到策略发现训练示范中未出现的动作模式。
result.en: The authors report improvements on LIBERO, RoboTwin and real tasks, and observe policies discovering action patterns absent from their demonstration training.

2509.09674.review_note: 未核实正式会议或期刊归属；原摘要中的结果为作者报告，不代表本目录复现。

2203.14465.title_zh: STaR：通过自生成推理进行自我教学

background.zh: 逐步推理示例能提高语言模型表现，但人工编写大量高质量推理过程需要显著标注投入。
background.en: Step-by-step rationales improve language-model reasoning, but collecting large numbers of high-quality human-written explanations requires substantial annotation effort.

challenge.zh: 模型自行生成的理由可能对应错误答案，若直接用于训练会积累错误而无法稳定提升推理能力。
challenge.en: Self-generated rationales may lead to incorrect answers, so indiscriminate training on them risks reinforcing errors rather than improving reasoning.

method.zh: 循环生成理由与答案，错误时借正确答案重试，再用最终答对的推理过程微调模型并重复。
method.en: STaR generates rationales, retries incorrect cases conditioned on correct answers and repeatedly fine-tunes on rationales that ultimately produce correct responses.

result.zh: 作者在多个数据集上优于只训练最终答案的模型，并在CommonsenseQA上接近更大模型的微调表现。
result.en: The authors outperform answer-only fine-tuning on multiple datasets and approach the performance of a much larger fine-tuned model on CommonsenseQA.

2310.02304.title_zh: STOP：递归改进程序的自学优化器

background.zh: 语言模型可以编写调用自身的优化程序，使改进算法也成为可由程序搜索和反馈继续改进的对象。
background.en: Language models can write optimization programs that invoke the model itself, making the improvement procedure another target for iterative code refinement.

challenge.zh: 直接修改基础模型代价较高，而框架程序的自修改需要检验是否真正改善下游任务表现。
challenge.en: Changing foundation-model weights is costly, while modifying surrounding programs requires evidence that self-editing actually improves downstream optimization performance.

method.zh: 先构造优化候选程序的种子改进器，再让它修改自身代码，探索搜索、遗传算法和退火等策略。
method.en: STOP starts with a seed code improver and lets it modify itself, producing strategies including search, genetic algorithms and simulated annealing.

result.zh: 作者在少量下游任务上展示更好的程序优化，并明确语言模型权重未改变，不属于完整递归模型改进。
result.en: The authors demonstrate improved program optimization on a small task set, while explicitly retaining unchanged language-model weights rather than full model self-improvement.

background.zh: 前馈 Transformer 可并行处理序列，但在超出训练长度的复制和逻辑任务中可能缺少循环归纳偏置。
background.en: Feedforward transformers process sequences in parallel but can lack recurrent inductive biases needed for copying and reasoning beyond observed training lengths.

challenge.zh: 需要兼顾全局感受野、并行训练与迭代计算，并允许不同位置根据问题难度获得不同计算深度。
challenge.en: The architecture must combine global attention and parallel training with iterative computation, while allowing different positions to receive different computational depths.

method.zh: 在深度方向循环使用共享自注意力变换，并加入逐位置动态停止机制，自适应决定更新次数。
method.en: Universal Transformers repeatedly apply shared self-attentive transformations across depth and use per-position adaptive halting to determine how many updates to execute.

result.zh: 作者在算法、语言理解和翻译任务上报告优于标准 Transformer；图灵完备性结论依赖论文给定假设。
result.en: The authors improve on standard transformers across algorithmic, language, and translation tasks, while the Turing-completeness result depends on stated assumptions.

1807.03819.review_note: 四句依据存档原始摘要；正式发表信息尚未在本轮核验。

2605.01352.title_zh: VUDA：打破 CUDA 与 Vulkan 隔离以共享 GPU 图形和计算资源

background.zh: 具身模拟、游戏和虚拟现实同时需要图形渲染与模型计算，共享设备有望改善整体资源利用率。
background.en: Embodied simulation, games, and virtual reality require both rendering and model computation, creating opportunities to improve utilization by sharing GPU resources.

challenge.zh: 原生计算与图形运行时处于不同调度域，常规计算分区控制无法统一管理图形流水线的资源竞争。
challenge.en: Native compute and graphics runtimes occupy separate scheduling domains, and conventional compute partitioning cannot jointly regulate contention involving the graphics pipeline.

method.zh: 系统把计算通道引导至图形调度域并保留独立地址空间，利用前端控制实现可动态调整的空间分区。
method.en: The system redirects compute channels into the graphics scheduling domain while preserving separate address spaces, using front-end controls for adjustable spatial resource partitioning.

result.zh: 多个平台和应用实验显示并发吞吐改善，并在感知渲染场景中降低推理超时而维持目标画面帧率。
result.en: Experiments across platforms and applications show improved concurrent throughput and reduced inference deadline misses while sustaining the target rendering frame rate.

2603.22078.title_zh: 世界动作模型是否比视觉语言动作模型更能泛化：鲁棒性研究

background.zh: 世界动作模型利用未来预测与视频预训练知识，常被认为比视觉语言动作模型具有更强环境泛化能力。
background.en: World-action models use future prediction and video-pretraining knowledge, motivating claims that they generalize more robustly than vision-language-action policies across environments.

challenge.zh: 不同模型的训练数据与目标存在差异，必须通过明确扰动基准比较鲁棒性，避免把架构差异直接当因果结论。
challenge.en: Models differ in training data and objectives, requiring explicit perturbation benchmarks rather than treating architectural differences alone as causal evidence of robustness.

method.zh: 论文在两个机器人基准的视觉与语言扰动设置中，对代表性世界动作和视觉语言动作策略进行比较。
method.en: The study compares representative world-action and vision-language-action policies under visual and language perturbations in two robotic manipulation benchmark suites.

result.zh: 结果显示所测世界动作模型具有较强鲁棒性，部分视觉语言动作模型也能在特定任务上取得相近表现。
result.en: Results show strong robustness from the evaluated world-action models, while some vision-language-action policies achieve comparable performance on particular tasks and perturbations.

2608.01880.title_zh: 实时世界动作模型：通过异步部署实现平滑执行的实证研究

background.zh: 世界动作模型通过迭代去噪产生固定长度动作块，较高推理延迟会导致机器人暂停和动作不连续。
background.en: World-action models generate fixed-horizon action chunks through iterative denoising, and high inference latency can cause pauses and discontinuities during robot execution.

challenge.zh: 异步重叠必须准确对齐观测、预测与已执行动作，简单动作混合不能修复持久的时间对齐错误。
challenge.en: Asynchronous overlap must align observations, predictions, and executed actions accurately, because simple action blending cannot repair persistent errors in temporal alignment.

method.zh: 论文比较同步、异步切换、不同动作混合、速度引导及前缀条件生成，并结合离线轨迹与在线双臂实验。
method.en: The paper compares synchronous execution, asynchronous switching, blending variants, velocity guidance, and prefix-conditioned generation using offline trajectories and online bimanual experiments.

result.zh: 实验显示正确时间对齐是前提，前缀条件生成在任务表现、执行速度与轨迹平滑之间取得较好综合平衡。
result.en: Experiments identify correct alignment as essential and find prefix-conditioned generation offers the strongest overall balance of task performance, execution speed, and trajectory smoothness.

background.zh: 世界动作模型把未来预测用于动作选择，相关研究同时采用视频生成、语言和视觉语言等不同基础架构。
background.en: World-action models make future predictions available for action selection, with related research using video-generation, language, and vision-language backbones and representations.

challenge.zh: 快速扩展的研究混淆世界模型、动作条件视频与机器人策略边界，也缺少可比较的统一分类维度。
challenge.en: Rapidly expanding research blurs boundaries among world models, action-conditioned video, and robot policies, while lacking common dimensions for meaningful comparison.

method.zh: 综述按生成未来的形式和模型组成建立互补分类，讨论因果性、持久性、物理合理性及数据评估问题。
method.en: The survey organizes methods by the form of generated futures and model components, examining causality, persistence, physical plausibility, data, and evaluation.

result.zh: 综述归纳表示丰富度与计算、内存、延迟及动作标注成本的取舍，指出减少不必要未来生成的共同趋势。
result.en: The survey synthesizes tradeoffs between representation richness and computation, memory, latency, and action-label cost, identifying a trend toward generating less unnecessary future content.

2511.14759.title_zh: π0.6*：从真实经验中学习的视觉语言动作模型

background.zh: 机器人基础策略可以从真实部署中不断积累成功、失败与专家纠正数据，为强化学习改进提供来源。
background.en: Robot foundation policies accumulate successes, failures, and expert corrections during real deployment, providing diverse experience for improvement through reinforcement learning.

challenge.zh: 示范、当前策略采样和遥操作干预具有不同质量，需要在同一训练流程中有效利用并避免简单模仿失误。
challenge.en: Demonstrations, on-policy experience, and teleoperated interventions differ in quality, requiring a unified training process that learns from them without simply imitating mistakes.

method.zh: RECAP 以优势条件策略结合离线预训练与机器人在线采集，将异构经验和执行中的专家纠正纳入改进。
method.en: RECAP uses advantage-conditioned policies with offline pretraining and on-robot collection, incorporating heterogeneous experience and expert corrections provided during autonomous execution.

result.zh: 真实家庭与操作任务展示性能改善，在部分困难任务中任务吞吐提高、失败率下降，支持部署驱动学习。
result.en: Real-home and manipulation tasks demonstrate improved performance, with higher throughput and lower failure rates on some difficult tasks, supporting deployment-driven policy improvement.

2604.15483.title_zh: π0.7：具有可引导能力的通用机器人基础模型

background.zh: 通用机器人模型需要在未见环境中遵循不同任务策略，并利用示范、失败和非机器人数据提升适应能力。
background.en: Generalist robot models must follow diverse task strategies in unseen environments and learn from demonstrations, failures, and non-robot data to improve adaptability.

challenge.zh: 单一语言目标不足以表达执行方式，混合质量和来源的数据也难以通过普通指令条件进行精确利用。
challenge.en: A single language goal does not fully describe execution strategy, and ordinary instruction conditioning inadequately uses data with varied quality and provenance.

method.zh: 模型在训练中加入任务表现元数据、子目标图像等多模态上下文，让用户在推理时精确引导执行策略。
method.en: The model incorporates performance metadata, subgoal images, and other multimodal context during training, allowing more precise steering of execution strategies at inference.

result.zh: 多平台实验展示语言遵循、复杂任务组合与跨本体泛化能力，部分任务无需专项强化学习即可达到较强表现。
result.en: Experiments across robot platforms demonstrate language following, compositional tasks, and cross-embodiment generalization, with strong performance on some tasks without specialized reinforcement-learning fine-tuning.

2510.25889.title_zh: πRL：基于流的视觉语言动作模型在线强化学习微调

background.zh: 流匹配视觉语言动作模型具有较强机器人控制能力，但直接在线强化学习受到动作概率难计算的限制。
background.en: Flow-matching vision-language-action models provide strong robot control, but applying online reinforcement learning is hindered by the difficulty of computing action probabilities.

challenge.zh: 连续流生成过程缺少简单的动作对数似然，探索噪声与环境交互还需与策略优化目标保持一致。
challenge.en: Continuous flow generation lacks a simple action log-likelihood, while exploration noise and environment interaction must remain compatible with the policy-optimization objective.

method.zh: 方法分别采用可学习噪声的离散去噪决策过程，以及常微分转随机微分的两层交互决策建模。
method.en: The method offers a discrete denoising decision process with learnable noise and a two-level interaction formulation using conversion from ordinary to stochastic differential equations.

result.zh: 多个机器人基准显示强化学习微调改善分布内与分布外表现，展示流式动作模型的在线策略优化能力。
result.en: Evaluations on multiple robotics benchmarks show improved in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance after reinforcement-learning fine-tuning of flow-based action models.

2608.16885.title_zh: τ0-VLA：世界模型引导测试时计算的分层机器人基础模型

background.zh: 长时机器人操作需要可靠执行基本技能，同时根据历史进展选择连贯的后续子任务与行动顺序。
background.en: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires reliable execution of individual skills and coherent selection of subsequent subtasks based on the history of task progress.

challenge.zh: 单次前向的高层决策无法给困难或影响较大的选择分配额外计算，限制复杂长任务的成功率。
challenge.en: Single-forward high-level decisions cannot allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices, limiting performance on complex long-horizon manipulation tasks.

method.zh: 高层策略结合执行记忆与世界模型搜索候选子任务，低层跨本体策略负责执行所选指令。
method.en: The high-level policy combines execution memory with world-model-guided search over candidate subtasks, while a low-level cross-embodiment policy executes the selected instructions.

result.zh: 分布内外实验显示增加测试计算可改善下一子任务预测，并转化为长时闭环机器人任务的更高成功率。
result.en: In-domain and shifted-distribution experiments show that additional test-time computation improves next-subtask prediction and translates into higher success in long-horizon closed-loop manipulation.

2606.01027.title_zh: τ0-WM：面向机器人操作的统一视频动作世界模型

background.zh: 机器人策略不仅要生成可执行动作，还需要在真实执行前预测候选动作的后果并判断任务进展。
background.en: Robot policies must generate executable actions while predicting candidate consequences and evaluating task progress before committing to physical execution in the environment.

challenge.zh: 视频预测、动作生成和评估常彼此分离，异构数据监督与测试时候选选择也难以在统一模型中协调。
challenge.en: Video prediction, action generation, and evaluation are often separate, complicating unified learning from heterogeneous supervision and candidate selection during test-time computation.

method.zh: 模型共享视频扩散骨干，联合生成视频动作或模拟动作条件未来，并用一致性排名和模拟器纠正候选。
method.en: The model shares a video-diffusion backbone for joint video-action generation and action-conditioned simulation, ranking candidates by consistency and rectifying weak candidates through simulation.

result.zh: 长时与精细操作实验报告优于所比较基线的任务表现，展示统一预测接口支持测试时动作选择的价值。
result.en: Experiments on long-horizon and fine-grained manipulation report stronger performance than evaluated baselines, demonstrating the value of unified prediction interfaces for test-time action selection.

2603.11101.title_zh: 面向云端具身智能基础设施的千卡训练与优化方案

background.zh: 具身模型训练同时面对海量机器人数据、复杂输入处理与大规模分布式计算，需要贯通全栈基础设施。
background.en: Embodied-model training combines large robot datasets, complex input processing, and distributed computation, requiring infrastructure that coordinates the complete training pipeline.

challenge.zh: 数据流、序列冗余、注意力计算和存储通信之间的瓶颈相互影响，单点优化难以支撑千卡扩展。
challenge.en: Bottlenecks in data flow, sequence redundancy, attention, storage, and communication interact, making isolated optimizations insufficient for scaling training to a thousand GPUs.

method.zh: 报告重构数据管线，结合序列打包、变长注意力及低精度优化，并协调高速存储、网络和弹性数据管理。
method.en: The report restructures data pipelines, combines sequence packing, variable-length attention, and low-precision optimization, and coordinates high-performance storage, networking, and elastic data management.

result.zh: 作者报告千卡平台和多个具身模型的训练加速，所列收益分别对应不同模型、配置与优化机制。
result.en: The authors report training acceleration on a thousand-GPU platform and multiple embodied models, with reported gains corresponding to different models, configurations, and optimization mechanisms.

2608.01150.title_zh: Zellige：面向图像与视频混合 DiT 训练的可塑序列放置

background.zh: 多 GPU 图像与视频混合 DiT 训练包含长度差异很大的序列，需要同时满足计算与显存约束。
background.en: Mixed image-video DiT training must distribute widely varying sequence lengths across GPUs under compute and memory constraints.

challenge.zh: 固定且互不重叠的 DP/CP 分组难以兼顾组间负载均衡与短序列通信开销。
challenge.en: Fixed disjoint DP/CP groups trade inter-group load balance against unnecessary communication for short sequences.

method.zh: 联合选择各序列的并行配置与参与 GPU，以重序列规划、轻序列填充和合并注意力执行支持重叠放置。
method.en: A two-stage planner selects parallel configurations and ranks per sequence, while coalesced attention executes whole sequences beside distributed shards.

result.zh: 作者报告相对 KnapFormer 在 16 张 A800 上加速 1.12–1.48 倍，在 32 张 A6000 上加速 1.27–1.54 倍。
result.en: The authors report 1.12–1.48× speedups over KnapFormer on 16 A800s and 1.27–1.54× on 32 A6000s.

2608.01150.review_note: 背景、挑战、方法与结果依据论文原文；共同一作、通讯作者与单位依据作者块；未核实正式会议或期刊。

2609.19242.title_zh: CSBP：面向长上下文扩散语言模型训练的块并行

background.zh: 块扩散语言模型需要同时处理共享干净上下文与多个受扰动目标块，长上下文训练受到通信和显存限制。
background.en: Block diffusion language models train multiple corrupted target blocks against shared clean context, making communication and activation memory bottlenecks at long context.

challenge.zh: 传统上下文并行连同块专有的受扰动 K/V 一起跨卡传输，而独立块执行又会重复构建干净前缀。
challenge.en: Conventional context parallelism communicates block-local corrupted K/V, while independent block execution can replicate clean-prefix computation.

method.zh: 把完整目标块交给各 rank，并对共享干净上下文分片，结合两端配对分配与梯度汇总保持原训练语义。
method.en: CSBP assigns complete target blocks to ranks while sharding shared clean context, using paired block placement and gradient aggregation to preserve training semantics.

result.zh: 作者在 16 张 H200、256K 上下文的监督微调中报告相对最强基线 1.18–1.45 倍吞吐，峰值显存持平或降低。
result.en: The authors report 1.18–1.45× throughput over the strongest baseline for supervised fine-tuning at 256K context on 16 H200s, with equal or lower peak memory.

2609.19242.review_note: 原文明确前三位共同贡献并为通讯作者；性能数字限于所列监督微调设置，非视频模型结果。

2605.18739.title_zh: LongLive-2.0：面向长视频生成的 NVFP4 并行基础设施

background.zh: 长视频自回归生成需要训练长时教师强制序列，并在推理时持续处理增长的历史与视频解码。
background.en: Long-video autoregressive generation requires long teacher-forced training sequences and efficient history handling and video decoding at inference.

challenge.zh: 干净历史与带噪目标的布局、VAE 准备和跨卡执行不匹配，会与高精度计算及缓存开销共同限制效率。
challenge.en: Mismatches among clean/noisy layouts, VAE preparation, and parallel execution compound the cost of high-precision computation and caching.

method.zh: 以 Balanced SP 配对 clean/noisy 时间块，结合分片 VAE、NVFP4 训练推理、量化 KV 与异步流式解码。
method.en: Balanced SP pairs clean and noisy temporal chunks, combined with sharded VAE work, NVFP4 training and inference, quantized KV, and asynchronous streaming decoding.

result.zh: 作者报告整套方案训练最高加速 2.15 倍、推理最高 1.84 倍，5B 模型达到 45.7 FPS，不能将整体收益仅归于 SP。
result.en: The full stack reports up to 2.15× training and 1.84× inference speedups, with 45.7 FPS for the 5B model; these gains are not attributable to SP alone.

2605.18739.review_note: 原文前四位明确共同贡献；项目负责人不自动视为通讯作者；各性能数字均为作者报告。

2505.13211.title_zh: MAGI-1：大规模自回归视频生成

background.zh: 交互式视频生成需要逐段接收提示、保持时间一致性，并在视频持续变长时维持可控的推理成本。
background.en: Interactive video generation must accept chunk-level prompts, preserve temporal consistency, and keep inference cost manageable as video length grows.

challenge.zh: 整段同时去噪难以自然流式输出，而异长序列与复杂注意力掩码增加大规模训练和部署成本。
challenge.en: Whole-video denoising complicates streaming, while variable sequence lengths and heterogeneous attention masks increase training and deployment costs.

method.zh: 使用块因果 Transformer 与逐块递增噪声训练，配合分布式 packing、MagiAttention、蒸馏及 KV 复用实现流式生成。
method.en: A block-causal Transformer learns with chunk-wise increasing noise, supported by distributed packing, MagiAttention, distillation, and KV reuse for streaming.

result.zh: 最大 24B 模型支持 400 万 token 上下文，作者报告 Physics-IQ 视频条件分数 56.02，并展示流式与逐块可控生成。
result.en: The largest 24B model supports 4M-token context; the authors report a video-conditioned Physics-IQ score of 56.02 and demonstrate controllable streaming generation.

2505.13211.review_note: 按报告集体署名记录关键作者，不将字母排序贡献名单推断为共同一作；99% packing容量填充率未改写为GPU利用率。

2511.00062.title_zh: Cosmos-Predict2.5：以视频基础模型进行物理 AI 世界模拟

background.zh: 机器人和自主系统需要可控的未来视觉模拟与合成数据，以补充昂贵且覆盖有限的真实环境采集。
background.en: Robotics and autonomous systems need controllable future-world simulation and synthetic data beyond costly, limited real-world collection.

challenge.zh: 世界生成既要遵循文字、图像或视频条件，又要保持物理相关的视觉质量，并适应机器人与驾驶等领域。
challenge.en: World generation must follow text, image, or video conditions while maintaining physically relevant visual quality across robotics and driving domains.

method.zh: 统一三种条件的流匹配生成模型，结合 Cosmos-Reason1 文本表征、领域微调、模型合并与强化学习后训练，并扩展到 Transfer2.5。
method.en: A unified flow-based generator combines Cosmos-Reason1 text representations, domain fine-tuning, model merging, and RL post-training, with a Transfer2.5 extension.

result.zh: 作者发布 2B/14B 模型并报告较 Predict1 更好的质量与指令对齐，Transfer2.5 以约前代 1/3.5 的规模提高转换保真度。
result.en: Released 2B and 14B models improve quality and prompt alignment over Predict1, while Transfer2.5 improves translation fidelity with about 3.5× fewer parameters than its predecessor.

2511.00062.review_note: 官方页面称technical report；CoRL期间发布不等于CoRL正式论文；使用封面集体署名NVIDIA。

2504.08685.title_zh: Seaweed-7B：视频生成基础模型的低成本训练

background.zh: 高质量视频基础模型通常依赖大规模算力，Seaweed-7B 探索中等模型在受限训练预算下的设计空间。
background.en: High-quality video foundation models often require substantial compute; Seaweed-7B explores a mid-sized model under a constrained training budget.

challenge.zh: 混合图像视频的异长负载、激活存储与重计算会降低效率，仅靠参数规模或 FLOPs 难以保证成本效果。
challenge.en: Variable image-video workloads, activation storage, and recomputation reduce efficiency, so parameter count or FLOPs alone do not determine cost effectiveness.

method.zh: 结合数据筛选、渐进训练与后训练，并用实测运行时间查表配平、分层激活 checkpoint 和融合算子优化训练。
method.en: Data curation, progressive training, and post-training are paired with runtime-table load balancing, multi-level activation checkpointing, and fused kernels.

result.zh: 7B 模型使用 66.5 万 H100 GPU 小时从头训练，报告具竞争力的视频质量与 38% 训练 MFU，后者是整套优化结果。
result.en: The 7B model is trained from scratch in 665,000 H100 GPU-hours and reports competitive quality and 38% training MFU, reflecting the combined optimization stack.

2504.08685.review_note: 正文封面署名ByteDance Seed，arXiv列完整贡献名单；不把团队成员的排列位置等同于贡献排序；未核实正式会议。

2506.09113.title_zh: Seedance 1.0：探索视频生成模型的能力边界

background.zh: 文本和图像条件的视频生成需要兼顾复杂提示、多镜头叙事、运动合理性和可接受的生成时延。
background.en: Text- and image-conditioned video generation must balance complex prompts, multi-shot narratives, plausible motion, and practical latency.

challenge.zh: 视觉质量、指令遵循与运动一致性难以同时优化，高分辨率长序列还带来训练与推理成本。
challenge.en: Visual quality, instruction following, and motion coherence compete, while high-resolution sequences impose substantial training and inference costs.

method.zh: 用多源数据和原生多镜头联合训练构建视频 DiT，结合多维奖励 RLHF、多阶段蒸馏及训练推理系统优化。
method.en: A video DiT combines multi-source data and native multi-shot joint training with multi-reward RLHF, multi-stage distillation, and training/inference system optimizations.

result.zh: 作者报告蒸馏与系统优化合计约 10 倍推理加速，在 NVIDIA L20 上以 41.4 秒生成 5 秒 1080p 视频。
result.en: The authors report roughly 10× combined inference acceleration from distillation and systems work, generating five seconds of 1080p video in 41.4 seconds on an NVIDIA L20.

2506.09113.review_note: 官方Seed论文页面Venue明确为arXiv；封面为集体署名ByteDance Seed，不把贡献名单首位推为个人第一作者。

2510.10620.title_zh: DCP：以动态上下文并行应对长上下文训练的输入变化

background.zh: 长上下文训练的样本长度和注意力掩码不断变化，使固定上下文并行配置难以适应实际负载。
background.en: Long-context training varies in both sequence length and attention pattern, challenging fixed context-parallel configurations.

challenge.zh: 只按序列静态切分会产生无效通信，并使计算量与显存占用在设备间失衡。
challenge.en: Static sequence partitions cause avoidable communication and uneven computation and memory use across devices.

method.zh: 将数据块与注意力计算块分别划分和映射，按样本的注意力关系动态规划设备分工。
method.en: DCP separately partitions and maps data blocks and attention-computation blocks to adapt device assignments to each attention pattern.

result.zh: 作者报告注意力算子显著加速，但端到端因果掩码为 0.94–1.16 倍、稀疏掩码为 1.00–1.46 倍，部分配置并未加速。
result.en: Reported end-to-end speedups are 0.94–1.16× for causal masks and 1.00–1.46× for sparse masks, so attention-level gains do not always improve full training.

2510.10620.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

2605.17923.title_zh: AdaptiveLoad：面向高效视频 DiT 训练的自适应负载优化

background.zh: 视频 DiT 混合训练包含分辨率和时长差异很大的样本，等 token 分桶不能保证各 GPU 用时接近。
background.en: Mixed video-DiT training contains widely varying resolutions and durations, so equal-token buckets need not take equal time.

challenge.zh: 自注意力计算随长度非线性增长，单独限制 token 或显存会留下长序列瓶颈。
challenge.en: Nonlinear attention cost leaves long-sequence bottlenecks when batching considers only token count or memory.

method.zh: 联合限制批次计算量与显存，并通过融合 LayerNorm–Modulate CUDA 算子降低归一化和调制开销。
method.en: AdaptiveLoad constrains both batch compute and memory and fuses LayerNorm–Modulate in a CUDA kernel.

result.zh: 作者在 Wan 2.1 上报告整体训练吞吐提高 27.2%、计算不均衡率从 39% 降至 18.9%，收益包含负载优化与算子融合。
result.en: On Wan 2.1, the combined system reports 27.2% higher throughput and reduces computational imbalance from 39% to 18.9%.

2605.17923.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

2609.34318.title_zh: HyDra：面向生产规模训练的负载驱动动态上下文并行

background.zh: 生产级长上下文训练使用动态 CP 分摊长序列，但按显存需求选并行度仍会留下明显流水线空泡。
background.en: Production long-context training uses dynamic CP, yet memory-driven parallel degrees can leave substantial pipeline bubbles.

challenge.zh: 相近 token 数对应的注意力计算量并不相近，扩展调度规模还会增加全局搜索成本。
challenge.en: Similar token counts can hide very different attention work, while global scheduling scans become expensive at scale.

method.zh: 用统一计算负载目标和惰性堆分配序列，并将内层 Ulysses 与浅层外环结合以支持更高 CP 度。
method.en: HyDra combines a shared compute-load target and lazy-heap placement with inner Ulysses groups inside a shallow outer ring.

result.zh: 作者在 2,048 GPU 生产任务中报告相对 Mcore DCP 平均吞吐提高 1.25 倍，流水线空泡从 36% 降至 14%。
result.en: On a 2,048-GPU production job, the authors report 1.25× average throughput over Mcore DCP and reduce pipeline bubbles from 36% to 14%.

2609.34318.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

2510.18121.title_zh: DistCA：通过核心注意力分离执行加速长上下文语言模型训练

background.zh: 长上下文训练中核心注意力计算增长快于其他层，造成数据并行和流水线并行的慢任务。
background.en: Core attention grows faster than other layers at long context, creating stragglers in data and pipeline parallel training.

challenge.zh: 模型层固定共置使注意力负载难以独立均衡，搬移计算还必须控制通信和临时显存成本。
challenge.en: Fixed co-location prevents independent attention balancing, while moving work introduces communication and transient-memory costs.

method.zh: 将无参数核心注意力拆成 token 级任务，在独立资源池重新组批，并以乒乓重叠和原地执行控制开销。
method.en: DistCA partitions parameter-free core attention into token-level tasks, rebatches them on an independent pool, and uses ping-pong overlap and in-place execution.

result.zh: 正式论文在 512 张 H200、最高 512K 上下文下报告相对已有负载均衡方法最高 1.35 倍、相对 Megatron-LM 最高 1.9 倍吞吐。
result.en: The published paper reports up to 1.35× throughput over existing balancing methods and 1.9× over Megatron-LM on 512 H200s with contexts up to 512K.

2510.18121.review_note: 标题、作者顺序与结果优先采用 MLSys 2026 正式页面；arXiv首次公开日期保留为2025-10-20。

2412.01523.title_zh: FlexSP：以灵活序列并行加速大语言模型训练

background.zh: 长上下文 LLM 训练依赖序列并行，但真实语料的序列长度通常呈长尾分布。
background.en: Long-context LLM training relies on sequence parallelism, but real corpora have long-tailed sequence lengths.

challenge.zh: 对所有样本使用同一种静态切分策略会让短序列承担额外通信，并浪费异构负载下的计算资源。
challenge.en: A single static scattering strategy wastes communication and compute capacity when sequence workloads differ.

method.zh: 按每个训练步的长度分布联合选择序列切分策略，将规划建模为线性优化并提供自适应并行执行。
method.en: FlexSP models per-step scattering-strategy selection as linear optimization and executes the resulting adaptive parallel plan.

result.zh: 作者报告相对所比较训练框架最高 1.98 倍加速，收益取决于长度分布与并行配置。
result.en: The authors report up to 1.98× speedup over compared training frameworks, with gains depending on sequence lengths and parallel configurations.

2412.01523.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

2412.07894.title_zh: Hydraulis：联合设计并行策略与数据分配以均衡大模型训练

background.zh: 大型 Transformer 训练中的采样和序列打包都会改变每个模型副本的工作量。
background.en: Sampling and sequence packing both change the workload assigned to each model replica during Transformer training.

challenge.zh: 采样造成长度分布不均，而线性显存与二次注意力时间的差异使等容量打包仍不等耗时。
challenge.en: Uneven sampling and the mismatch between linear memory and quadratic attention time make memory-balanced packs computationally imbalanced.

method.zh: 随迭代内外的长度变化调整异构并行策略，再通过两阶段数据分配同时平衡副本内与副本间负载。
method.en: Hydraulis adjusts heterogeneous parallel strategies and uses two-stage assignment to balance workloads both within and across replicas.

result.zh: 作者报告相对所比较系统提高 1.32–2.66 倍训练性能，验证并行策略与数据分配协同优化的收益。
result.en: The authors report 1.32–2.66× training-performance gains over compared systems from jointly optimizing parallel strategies and data assignment.

2412.07894.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

2502.21231.title_zh: ByteScale：面向百万 token 上下文的超大规模 LLM 训练

background.zh: 长短序列混合的大规模 LLM 训练需要同时进行样本间分配和单样本内部切分。
background.en: Large-scale mixed-length LLM training needs both inter-sample placement and intra-sample partitioning.

challenge.zh: 将数据并行和上下文并行固定为静态网格，会造成短序列冗余通信与不同设备计算失衡。
challenge.en: Treating data and context parallelism as a static mesh causes redundant communication for short sequences and imbalanced computation.

method.zh: 以动态网格的混合数据并行统一两类切分，结合数据感知通信、选择性卸载和并行感知数据分配。
method.en: ByteScale unifies both forms of partitioning through dynamic-mesh hybrid data parallelism, data-aware communication, selective offloading, and parallelism-aware assignment.

result.zh: 作者在 7B–141B 模型、256K–2048K 上下文的大集群实验中报告最高 7.89 倍加速，具体收益依赖配置。
result.en: Across 7B–141B models and 256K–2048K contexts, the authors report up to 7.89× speedup, depending on the evaluated configuration.

2502.21231.review_note: arXiv标题保留“More Than 12,000 GPUs”；SIGCOMM官方摘要报告16384 GPU，卡片不混用两个版本的规模数字。

2309.14509.title_zh: DeepSpeed Ulysses：支持超长序列 Transformer 训练的系统优化

background.zh: 超长序列 Transformer 训练需要沿上下文维度扩展，常规数据、张量和流水线并行并不能独立解决这一问题。
background.en: Extreme-length Transformer training needs context-dimension scaling beyond conventional data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism.

challenge.zh: 已有序列并行的激活显存和通信成本会随上下文增长限制扩展。
challenge.en: Activation-memory and communication costs limit the scalability of existing sequence-parallel approaches.

method.zh: 先按序列切分，再通过 all-to-all 将注意力输入转换为按头切分，让各设备对完整上下文的一部分注意力头计算后还原布局。
method.en: Ulysses uses all-to-all exchanges to switch from sequence shards to attention-head shards, computes full-context attention per head subset, and restores the layout.

result.zh: 作者报告相对所比较基线训练速度提高 2.5 倍并支持 4 倍更长序列；官方实现展示 64 张 A100 上的百万 token 训练。
result.en: The authors report 2.5× faster training and fourfold longer sequences versus their baseline, with the official implementation demonstrating million-token training on 64 A100s.

2309.14509.review_note: 中英文卡片依据所列原始论文和官方发表页面；第一作者依据署名顺序核实，不推断共同一作或通讯作者。

scalefusion.title_zh: ScaleFusion：面向高分辨率长视频生成的时空扩散 Transformer 可扩展推理

background.zh: 高分辨率长视频生成的时空 DiT 推理计算量很大，需要扩展到多台 GPU 服务器。
background.en: High-resolution long-video generation makes spatial-temporal DiT inference expensive and motivates scaling across GPU servers.

challenge.zh: 相邻空间与时间注意力的重分片通信形成串行依赖，使现有序列并行难以充分隐藏跨机传输。
challenge.en: Resharding between spatial and temporal attention creates serial dependencies that prevent existing sequence parallelism from hiding inter-server transfers.

method.zh: 利用时空注意力在另一维度上的独立性，将切片计算与层内、层间 all-to-all 通信流水重叠。
method.en: The engine exploits spatial-temporal independence to pipeline sliced attention computation with intra-layer and inter-layer all-to-all communication.

result.zh: 官方摘要报告从 8 张扩至 32 张 A100 获得 3.60 倍强扩展，相对比较方法平均加速 1.36 倍、最高 1.58 倍。
result.en: The official abstract reports 3.60× strong scaling from 8 to 32 A100s and 1.36× average speedup over compared methods, up to 1.58×.

scalefusion.review_note: Results follow the official abstract (1.36×); the introduction gives 1.40×. This is inference, not training. Publication precision is the conference year.
